research.subject: Exam-wide facts and policy: 116學年度 大學學科能力測驗 (學測/GSAT), plus copyright, terminology and free-resource landscape
research.scope_summary:
Research date: 2026-11-15. The next sitting is confirmed by 大考中心 (CEEC) as the 116學年度學測, held 116/1/22 (Fri) to 1/24 (Sun), i.e. 2027-01-22 to 2027-01-24. Primary sources: the CEEC 116學年度考試簡章 (first edition 115/8/4), the CEEC press release of 115/10/23, the CEEC 學測考試說明 (111學年度起適用, with an English-subject version for 115起 updated 113/7/29), and the MOE 116學年度大學多元入學手冊 (published 115/8).

Exam structure: 6 subjects with free choice: 國文 (國綜 + 國寫, sat as two sessions), 英文, 數學A, 數學B, 社會, 自然. Scores are in 級分, max 15 per subject, or a 60-級分 version when used for 分發入學 採計.

Scope is 部定必修 only under the 108課綱. 數學A/B cover the 10th-grade required course plus the 11th-grade A or B track. 社會 covers required 歷史, 地理 and 公民與社會 at roughly equal weight. 自然 covers required 物理, 化學, 生物 and 地球科學 (including 探究與實作) at roughly equal weight. 國文 and 英文 are listed simply as 必修. 加深加廣選修 belongs only to the 分科測驗. CEEC also says 學測 items may draw on 國中 content as background, which justifies bridging modules.

Recent and upcoming changes:
- 116: much stricter anti-cheating rules. Carrying smart glasses means the session scores zero, and detectors may be used.
- 115: 英文 篇章結構 moved from 4選4 to 5選4.
- 117: the 申請入學 first-stage screening ratio rises from at most 3x to 4x.
- 118: changes to the 青儲 pathway.

I found no CEEC announcement of 117 format changes or computer-based testing.

Copyright:
- The CEEC 考試說明 PDFs allow non-profit use with attribution; commercial use needs written consent.
- CEEC claims ownership of all exam materials.
- Whether past 學測 papers fall under 著作權法 §9(1)(5) is unresolved: 智慧局 declined to rule and referred the question to the MOE.
- 課綱 are issued as attachments to an 教育部令. That makes §9(1)(1) plausible, but I found no official ruling. NAER's open-data declaration licenses its site content anyway, with attribution required.

Terminology: 樂詞網 provides 教科書名詞 datasets (高中以下: 數學, 物理學, 化學, 生命科學, 地球科學, 地理學, 資訊) under NAER's open-data declaration. It has no 歷史 or 公民 textbook-term sets, and I found no official MOE subject-vocabulary list.

Free platforms:
- 均一: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 TW, strong at 國中. Its 高中 math and science content was still being built as of late 2025.
- 因材網: run under the MOE, needs a login, has 高中數學 resources, and states no license.
- 高中學科中心 materials have moved to the NTNU 學科資源平臺, which was unreachable when I tried it.

Units are intentionally empty for this exam-wide topic. My web-search budget ran out before I could fully check 2026 news on 課綱微調 and 117 changes.
research.exam_format:
116學年度學測 (2027-01-22 to 01-24). Six subjects, chosen freely; 7 sessions over 3 days. All bells refer to Taiwan local time. Each session has a preparatory bell 5 minutes before the start. Late entry is barred 20 minutes after the start, and no one may leave in the first 60 minutes.

Day 1 (Fri 1/22):
- 數學A 09:20–11:00 (100 min)
- 自然 12:50–14:40 (110 min)

Day 2 (Sat 1/23):
- 英文 09:20–11:00 (100 min)
- 國文(一) 國語文綜合能力測驗 (國綜) 12:50–14:20 (90 min)
- 國文(二) 國語文寫作能力測驗 (國寫) 15:20–16:50 (90 min)

Day 3 (Sun 1/24):
- 數學B 09:20–11:00 (100 min)
- 社會 12:50–14:40 (110 min)

Question types:
- 選擇題: 單選 or 多選.
- 選填題: 數學A and 數學B only.
- 非選擇題 or 混合題: a 題組 that mixes choice/fill-in items with written items.
- 國寫 is entirely non-choice.

Answer sheet and marking:
- One A3 卷卡合一 answer sheet per subject, with a signature box.
- 2B pencil for choice items and drawings; black ink for written answers.

Scoring:
- 單選: all or nothing.
- 多選 with n options: each option judged separately; k wrong options earn (n−2k)/n of the item's points, floored at 0.
- 選填: every blank must be correct; no penalty for wrong answers.
- Example: the 115 數學A paper had 選擇(填) worth 85 points (6 單選, 6 多選, 5 選填) and one 混合題組 worth 15 points. Formulas and reference values (log values, square roots) were printed at the end.

國文: 國綜 is out of 100 and 國寫 out of 50; each counts 50%. Raw score = 國綜 × 0.5 + 國寫.

級分:
- L = (average raw score of the top 1% of examinees) / 15.
- k 級分 means (k−1)L < X ≤ kL; a raw score of 0 is 0 級分; the maximum is 15.
- A 60-級分 version (L/60) is used for 分發入學 採計.

Five 標準 percentiles: 頂標 88th, 前標 75th, 均標 50th, 後標 25th, 底標 12th.

Calculators and any device with computing, communication or AI functions are banned. Rulers may carry only measurement scales.

key_facts.claim: The 116學年度學測 is held 116年1月22日(五) to 1月24日(日), i.e. 2027-01-22 to 2027-01-24. Registration runs 115/10/27 to 115/11/10. Individual registrants paying at convenience stores must pay by 11/07.
key_facts.evidence: CEEC press release dated 115.10.23 states the exam dates, the registration window and the convenience-store payment deadline (11月07日). The 116 簡章 cover and its 重要行事曆 match.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 新聞稿 115.10.23

key_facts.claim: Subjects: 國文, 英文, 數學A, 數學B, 社會 and 自然, six in all, chosen freely. 國文 is sat in two sessions: 國文(一) 國語文綜合能力測驗 (國綜) and 國文(二) 國語文寫作能力測驗 (國寫).
key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 貳、學科能力測驗 一(二). The 116 MOE handbook adds that the exam has 6 subjects, 7 sessions and 3 days.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章 (115/8/4 初版)

key_facts.claim: Timetable: 1/22 數學A 09:20–11:00 and 自然 12:50–14:40. 1/23 英文 09:20–11:00, 國綜 12:50–14:20 and 國寫 15:20–16:50. 1/24 數學B 09:20–11:00 and 社會 12:50–14:40. Durations: 國綜 and 國寫 90 min each; 英文, 數學A and 數學B 100 min each; 社會 and 自然 110 min each.
key_facts.evidence: 日程表 in both the 116簡章 (p.3) and the press release. Each session's preparatory bell rings 5 min before the start; entry closes after 20 min; examinees may leave only after 60 min.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章

key_facts.claim:
測驗範圍 (108課綱, all 部定必修):
- 國文: 必修國文.
- 英文: 必修英文.
- 數學A: 10年級必修數學 + 11年級必修數學A類.
- 數學B: 10年級必修數學 + 11年級必修數學B類.
- 社會: 必修歷史, 必修地理, 必修公民與社會, in roughly equal score proportion.
- 自然: 必修物理, 化學, 生物 and 地球科學, including 探究與實作, in roughly equal proportion.
加深加廣選修 is NOT in 學測.
key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 二、測驗範圍及題型 table and notes 1–3. The CEEC 學測考試說明總說明 labels the scope column '測驗範圍：部定必修'.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章; 學測考試說明 總說明 (111學年度起適用)

key_facts.claim:
By contrast, the 分科測驗 (116/7/10–7/11, 8 subjects, 80 min each) tests 部定必修 plus 部定加深加廣選修. Examples:
- 數學甲類 and 數學乙類.
- 物理: 力學一, 力學二與熱學, 波動、光及聲音, 電磁現象一, 電磁現象二與量子現象.
- 化學: 物質與能量 through 有機化學與應用科技.
- 生物: 細胞與遺傳 through 生態、演化及生物多樣性.
- 歷史, 地理 and 公民 each have three 加深加廣 courses.
key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 叁、分科測驗 二(一) 測驗範圍 table.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章

key_facts.claim: CEEC states that 學測 items may use 國中 learning content as material or as background knowledge needed to answer. However, 國中 knowledge is not the main object of item design.
key_facts.evidence: 學測考試說明 總說明 參、測驗範圍, paragraph after 表二 (paraphrased).
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 學測考試說明 總說明 (108年9月)

key_facts.evidence: 總說明 壹、測驗目標 lists these four items. They are based on 108課綱 學習內容 and 學習表現.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 學測考試說明 總說明

key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 二(二) 題型. 總說明 伍 explains that 混合題型 and the new answer sheet were introduced from 111.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章; 學測考試說明 總說明

key_facts.claim:
Scoring rules:
- 單選: all or nothing.
- 多選 with n options: options are judged independently; k wrong options earn (n−2k)/n of the item's points, with a floor of 0.
- 數學 選填: every blank must be correct; wrong answers are not penalized.
key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 三、成績計算 (一)2–3, with worked example tables.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章

key_facts.claim: 國文 subject score: 國綜 is out of 100 and 國寫 out of 50; each counts 50%. Raw total = 國綜 × 0.5 + 國寫. 國寫 grades are A/B/C/0, with separate descriptors for 知性的統整判斷 and 情意的感受抒發. 國寫 must be written in Traditional Chinese (正體中文).
key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 三(一)4 and 附錄三 國寫成績說明. The CEEC 國文考試說明 gives the same formula.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章; 學測國文考科考試說明

key_facts.claim:
級分 system:
- Maximum 15 per subject.
- L = (average raw total of the top 1% of examinees in that subject) / 15.
- k 級分 corresponds to (k−1)L < X ≤ kL; a raw score of 0 is 0 級分.
- For 分發入學 採計, a 60-級分 scale (L/60) is used. Each 15-level grade maps to four 60-level values; for example, 15 maps to 57–60.
- 60-級分 lookup opens 116/04/08.
key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 三(二)–(三), formulas and mapping table; 拾壹 二.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章

key_facts.claim: Five 成績標準 (absent examinees excluded): 頂標 = 88th percentile, 前標 = 75th, 均標 = 50th, 後標 = 25th, 底標 = 12th.
key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 拾壹 六(一).
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章

key_facts.claim:
Post-exam dates:
- Each paper is posted on the CEEC site after its session ends.
- Choice and fill-in reference answers are posted at 19:00 the next day (116/1/23 to 1/25).
- Objections close 116/1/27; final answers are published 116/2/17.
- Scores are released 116/2/25 and score slips mailed 2/26.
- Score re-check runs 2/26 to 3/4, with results 3/11.
key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 拾、拾壹、拾貳 and 重要試務日期 table.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章

key_facts.claim:
How 學測 scores are used:
- 繁星推薦: 檢定 and 比序.
- 申請入學: stage-1 檢定, 倍率篩選 and 同級分超額比序; stage-2 採計.
- 分發入學: 檢定 or 採計.
繁星 and 申請 each use at most 4 學測 subjects. 分發入學 counts 3 ≤ (學測 + 分科 + 術科) ≤ 5 subjects, with 學測 ≤ 4 and 分科 ≥ 1. Scores are also used by 科技校院四技申請, 中央警察大學 and 軍校.
key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 IV and 附錄十. The 116 大學多元入學手冊 pp.6–7, 12–13 and 22 cover usage, and Q&A 2 covers the stage uses.
key_facts.source_name: 教育部 116學年度大學多元入學手冊 (115年8月)

key_facts.claim:
申請入學 details:
- Each applicant may apply to at most 6 校系.
- In the final 甄選總成績, 學測 counts for at most 50% and 綜合學習表現 P (= P1 學習歷程 + P2 校系甄試) for at least 50%.
- Stage-2 reviewers cannot see 學測 scores (rule since 99學年度).
繁星推薦 details:
- 在校學業成績 covers 高一, 高二 and 高三上 (5 semesters).
- There are 8 學群.
key_facts.evidence: 116 handbook pp.6–7, 12–13, 30 and Q&A 41.
key_facts.source_name: 教育部 116學年度大學多元入學手冊

key_facts.claim: 學測 scores are valid only within the same 學年度's admission cycle and cannot be carried to the next year. CEEC keeps them 5 years only for issuing score certificates. Taking only the 分科測驗 limits a student to 分發入學 校系 that do not use 學測.
key_facts.evidence: 116 handbook Q&A 4 and 6; table 考試及入學管道關係表 (p.27).
key_facts.source_name: 教育部 116學年度大學多元入學手冊

key_facts.claim:
108課綱 總綱 (111學年度實施 version), 普通型高中 部定必修 credits (表6):
- 國語文 20: 16 in years 1–2 and 4 in year 3; includes 中華文化基本教材 2.
- 英語文 18: 16 in years 1–2 and 2 in year 3.
- 數學 16: 8 in year 1 and 8 in year 2. Year 2 is split into two 分類課程 and students choose one.
- 社會 18: 歷史, 地理 and 公民與社會 6 each.
- 自然科學 12: each subject 2–4, at least 2 each.
The grade allocation for each 領域 follows the 領域綱要 and school plans.
key_facts.evidence: 表6 普通型高級中等學校領域/科目及學分數 and its notes 1–4 (read from text extraction; table layout).
key_facts.source_name: 國家教育研究院 十二年國教課程綱要總綱 (111學年度實施)
key_facts.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/288/(111學年度實施)十二年國教課程綱要總綱.pdf

key_facts.claim: The current 總綱 was amended by 教育部令 dated 110年3月15日 (臺教授國部字第1100016363B號). It is implemented year by year from 111學年度. It was originally issued 103年11月 (教育部發布令 103/11/28).
key_facts.evidence: Scanned 教育部令 PDF; NAER 課綱 page lists the 103/11/28, 106/5/10 and 110/3/15 orders.
key_facts.source_name: 教育部令 110.3.15 (hosted by NAER)

key_facts.claim:
New for 116 (簡章 重要編輯說明 四):
- Examinees consent at registration to electronic and metal-detection checks.
- Carrying smart glasses to the seat counts as cheating whether or not they are used; that session scores zero.
- Phones and other wearables carried to the seat cost 3 學測級分, even if switched off.
- 確認報名資料期間 is renamed 報名結果檢核期間.
- New rules for medical devices and assistive aids.
key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 p.III 重要編輯說明 and 違規處理辦法 第8條.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章

key_facts.claim: From 115學年度, the 學測英文 篇章結構 item type changed from 4選4 to 5選4, with MOE approval. CEEC published a separate 英文考科考試說明 (115學年度起適用), marked updated 113.07.29. As of 115-11-12, every other 學測 考試說明 is still the 111學年度起適用 version.
key_facts.evidence: CEEC 考試說明 page lists the 115 English spec (113.07.29更新); 聯合報 2024-07-29 reports 5選4 and MOE approval.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 考試說明 page; 聯合報

key_facts.claim: From 117學年度, the 申請入學 first-stage screening ratio cap rises from 3x to 4x. 招聯會 voted 38 to 25 to start in 117 rather than 115.
key_facts.evidence: 聯合報 2025-06-20 report on the 招聯會 vote.
key_facts.source_name: 聯合報

key_facts.claim: Under the 青儲方案, the 四技二專甄選入學 and 大學申請入學 routes run only through 117學年度. From 118, those routes are gone, so a reserved original 學測 score cannot be used for them.
key_facts.evidence: 116 handbook Q&A 5.
key_facts.source_name: 教育部 116學年度大學多元入學手冊

key_facts.claim: In July 2024, Minister of Education 鄭英耀 said there is no '118課綱' and the 108課綱 will not be overhauled; adjustments (e.g., AI in the technology domain) will happen within the 108 framework. In Nov 2024, new NAER president 林從一 took charge of 微調108課綱, including 資訊素養 and 生成式AI.
key_facts.source_name: 中央社; 聯合報

key_facts.claim: The CEEC 學測考試說明 PDFs state that copyright belongs to CEEC; use is allowed for non-profit purposes only, and reproduction must credit the source. Commercial use requires CEEC's prior written consent.
key_facts.evidence: Cover box of the 總說明 and the 國文考科 考試說明 PDFs (paraphrased).
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 學測考試說明 總說明

key_facts.claim: The 116簡章 states that all materials used in or produced by the exams belong to CEEC, including 試題本, 答題卷 and the content of answers. By registering, examinees grant CEEC the IP in their answer content.
key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 拾壹 十.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章

key_facts.claim: The past-papers page (一般試題, 189 entries, 83 to 115學年度) carries only a generic '版權所有' site footer. The 115 數學A paper and its 評分原則 PDFs contain no reuse terms. I found no dedicated CEEC terms-of-use page for past papers.
key_facts.evidence: Opened the 一般試題 listing page, the 115 數學A paper PDF and the 非選擇題評分原則 PDF.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 學測 歷年試題 一般試題

key_facts.claim:
著作權法第9條 excludes from copyright:
- §9(1)(1): 憲法、法律、命令或公文;
- §9(1)(5): 依法令舉行之各類考試試題及其備用試題.
§9(2) defines 公文 to include documents drafted by civil servants in their official duties.
key_facts.evidence: Statute text on 全國法規資料庫.
key_facts.source_name: 全國法規資料庫 著作權法第9條

key_facts.claim: 智慧財產局 (e-mail interpretation 1090203b, 109-02-03) explains that '依法令舉行' means held under ROC law. It declined to confirm whether 國中基測 or 大學學測 papers qualify, because it does not administer those laws, and referred the question to the MOE or the exam administrator. It also noted that 第46條 allows school teaching reproduction within reasonable scope with attribution.
key_facts.evidence: TIPO interpretation page (summarized).
key_facts.source_name: 經濟部智慧財產局 解釋資料 電子郵件1090203b

key_facts.claim: The NAER website's 政府網站資料開放宣告 grants a free, non-exclusive, irrevocable, sublicensable license, with no time or territory limit, to copyrighted site content. Users must credit the source and respect moral rights. Third-party-owned or specially marked works are excluded. This covers NAER-hosted 課綱 PDFs to the extent NAER owns rights.
key_facts.evidence: NAER PageDoc fid=324 (summarized).
key_facts.source_name: 國家教育研究院 政府網站資料開放宣告

key_facts.claim: 樂詞網 (terms.naer.edu.tw) is run by NAER. It holds about 1.93 million 學術名詞 entries in 206 categories, about 20,000 雙語詞彙 entries in 21 announced categories, and about 60,000 辭書 entries in 9 dictionaries. It began in 2001, was renamed 樂詞網 in 2022, and adds or revises about 30,000 entries a year.
key_facts.evidence: 樂詞網 關於我們 page.
key_facts.source_name: 國家教育研究院 樂詞網

key_facts.evidence: terms.naer.edu.tw/download/4/ listing.
key_facts.source_name: 樂詞網 下載專區 教科書名詞

key_facts.claim: 樂詞網 content falls under the same NAER 政府網站資料開放宣告: free, non-exclusive, irrevocable reuse including commercial value-added use, with attribution required. NAER datasets on data.gov.tw (for example 教育學學術名詞) carry 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版.
key_facts.evidence: terms.naer.edu.tw/mysite/about/2/; data.gov.tw/dataset/6319.
key_facts.source_name: 樂詞網 政府網站資料開放宣告

key_facts.claim: 均一教育平台 course content is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 TW unless otherwise marked. This covers videos, interactive exercises, assessments and handouts. Breaching the license terminates it automatically.
key_facts.evidence: Junyi licence page.
key_facts.source_name: 均一教育平台 授權

key_facts.claim:
均一 coverage per its official site (figures as of Dec 2025):

key_facts.claim:
CEEC publishes free official support material for each year's paper:
- 非選擇題 參考答案與評分原則;
- detailed scoring explanations and common errors in its 選才電子報 (for example, 115 數學A pointed to issue 351 of 4/15).
 It also sells an annual '學科能力測驗試題與解析' book; the 115 edition was announced 115-06-30.

key_facts.claim: Math 非選擇題 grading needs clear reasoning and a correct answer for full marks. Partial credit depends on how complete the solution concept is. No process, a wrong inference, or using data that contradicts the problem scores zero.
key_facts.evidence: 115 數學A 評分原則 intro (paraphrased).
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 115學測數學A 非選擇題評分原則

key_facts.claim: Banned at the seat: calculators, and any device with transmission, memory, scanning, camera, translation, computing or AI-generation functions. Rulers, set squares, protractors and compasses are allowed; rulers may show only a brand logo and measurement scales, so formula rulers are banned. The 數學 paper prints reference formulas and values at the end, e.g. log 2 ≈ 0.3010 and √2 ≈ 1.414.
key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 試場規則 一(二)(四), 附錄八; 115 數學A paper p.7.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章; 115學測數學A試卷

key_facts.claim: 高中英語聽力測驗 (英聽) is a separate exam with two sittings in the 116 cycle: 115/10/17 and 115/12/12, best result counts. Scope is 第10、11年級必修英文. It has 40 multiple-choice items, results are graded A/B/C/F, and universities use it as a 檢定 threshold.
key_facts.evidence: 116簡章 壹、高中英語聽力測驗.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章

common_misconceptions.misconception: 學測 covers everything in 高中, including 選修 and 高三 content.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: 學測 tests only 108課綱 部定必修. 數學 is limited to the 10th-grade required course plus the 11th-grade A or B track. 加深加廣選修 appears only in the 分科測驗.

common_misconceptions.misconception: 級分 cut-offs are fixed raw scores, e.g. 15級分 means 90+ points.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The 級距 L is recomputed every year from the average raw score of the top 1% of examinees in each subject, divided by 15. 15級分 means a raw score above 14L.

common_misconceptions.misconception: One wrong option on a 多選題 gives zero for that item.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Options are scored independently. With n options and k wrong, the item earns (n−2k)/n of its points, floored at 0.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Wrong answers on 數學 選填題 are penalized.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: 選填 earns credit only if every blank is correct, and wrong answers are not penalized (答錯不倒扣).

common_misconceptions.misconception: 國寫 is a separate subject with its own 級分.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: 國寫 is the second session of the 國文 subject. 國綜 (out of 100) and 國寫 (out of 50) each count 50% toward a single 國文 級分. 國寫 also gets its own score slip with an A/B/C/0 grade.

common_misconceptions.misconception: A good 學測 score can be saved and used next year.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: 學測 scores can be used only in the same 學年度's admission routes. CEEC keeps them 5 years only for issuing certificates.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Taking only the 分科測驗 still allows 繁星推薦 or 申請入學.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Taking only 分科 limits a student to 分發入學 校系 that neither check nor count 學測. 繁星 and 申請 require 學測.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Scoring 0 級分 in any 學測 subject bars a student from 繁星 or 申請.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: That rule was removed from 107學年度. Only a 0 in a subject a 校系 uses as a 檢定 blocks that 校系, and the subjects used must not sum to 0.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Stage-2 interviewers in 申請入學 can see 學測 scores.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Since 99學年度 universities may not give 學測 scores to departments for stage-2 review. Scores are combined by fixed weights, with 學測 at most 50%.

common_misconceptions.misconception: A simple calculator is fine for 數學 or 自然.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Calculators and any computing, communicating or AI-capable device are banned at the seat. Students must work by hand, using the reference values printed in the paper.

common_misconceptions.misconception: A smartwatch or phone switched off in a pocket is harmless.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: From 116, carrying a phone or wearable to the seat costs 3 學測級分 even if it is off; refusing inspection voids the session. Smart glasses at the seat are treated as cheating, and that session scores zero.

pedagogy_notes: Design to the four CEEC 測驗目標. Every unit should include context-based problems, chart and table reading, evidence use and written explanation, not just recall. CEEC frames 學測 as 素養導向 (testing applied competence).

Teach how to write solutions for 非選擇題 and 混合題. Math graders require the reasoning to be shown, give partial credit for a complete concept, and give zero for an answer with no process. The official 評分原則 PDFs can serve as models, linked rather than reproduced.
All practice should be calculator-free and use paper-style reference tables (log values, square-root approximations), because the real exam bans calculators and prints these values.
Build 國中 bridging modules on purpose. CEEC explicitly says 學測 can rely on 國中 content as background, which supports the 'zero prerequisites' goal.
Branch the math track: 10th-grade 必修 is shared, then fork into 11年級 數學A類 (數A) and 數學B類 (數B). Note that a 校系 listing both as 檢定 subjects accepts either one.
Weight coverage within 社會 (歷史 : 地理 : 公民 ≈ 1:1:1) and 自然 (物理 : 化學 : 生物 : 地科 ≈ 1:1:1:1, including 探究與實作), following CEEC's equal-weighting principle.
For the 國文 (beta) track: 國寫 has two task families, 知性的統整判斷 and 情意的感受抒發, with official A/B/C/0 descriptors. It counts 50% of 國文 and must be written in Traditional Chinese.
Version-stamp every exam-rule page as '116學年度 (2027-01) per 簡章 115/8/4'. CEEC issues a new 簡章 each August (the 116 one appeared 8/4), and rules such as the device penalties changed for 116.

Bilingual terms: use 樂詞網 教科書名詞 (高中以下 數學, 物理學, 化學, 生命科學, 地球科學, 地理學) as the canonical English. 歷史 and 公民 have no textbook-term set there, so their English terms need a separate, cited source or must be flagged.

Copyright posture: link to official past papers and 考試說明 rather than copying them, and write original practice items. 課綱 學習內容 text can be quoted with attribution under NAER's open-data declaration. Junyi material can only be reused in a non-commercial, share-alike context.

recent_trends.trend: 116學年度 (2027 sitting): stronger anti-cheating rules. Detectors may be used, smart glasses at the seat make the session score zero, and phones or wearables carried at the seat cost 3 學測級分.
From 115學年度, the 學測英文 篇章結構 item changed from 4選4 to 5選4, with a new 115學年度起適用 英文考試說明 (updated 113.07.29).
From 117學年度, the 申請入學 first-stage screening ratio cap rises from 3x to 4x (招聯會 vote reported 2025-06-20). Falling cohorts and unfilled places are the stated reason.
From 118學年度, 青儲方案 students lose the 大學申請入學 and 四技二專甄選入學 routes that used their original 學測 score; the programme has become 青年生涯領航計畫.
From 114學年度, the 分科測驗 added 數學乙, which covers 數A/數B shared content plus 數學乙類 加深加廣. This matters only for learners going past 學測.

Curriculum policy (2024): MOE said there is no '118課綱'. The 108課綱 stays, with fine-tuning that adds AI and 資訊素養; NAER president 林從一 is in charge of the 微調. I could not confirm whether any 微調 had been published in 2025–2026.

open_questions: Are official 學測 past papers 依法令舉行之考試試題 under 著作權法 §9(1)(5)? TIPO (1090203b) declined to decide and referred the question to the MOE or CEEC. I found no CEEC policy page on reusing past papers. Ask CEEC in writing before reproducing or embedding any 試題; until then, link only.

Is 課綱 text, issued as an attachment to an 教育部令, a 命令/公文 under §9(1)(1)? I found no TIPO ruling. NAER's open-data declaration still permits reuse with attribution, so quoting 學習內容 verbatim with attribution looks permissible. Legal confirmation is still pending.

Does 學測 國文 or 英文 scope include 12th-grade 部定必修 content? 總綱 schedules 國語文 4 credits and 英語文 2 credits in year 3. The 簡章 says only '必修國文' and '必修英文'. Secondary sources claim the scope runs through 高三上, but I did not verify this in a primary document; check the subject 考試說明 PDFs.
Which grades are 社會 (歷史, 地理, 公民) and 自然 (物理, 化學, 生物, 地科, 探究與實作) 部定必修 taught in? 總綱 表6 delegates this to the 領域綱要 and school plans. Subject agents should confirm from the 社會 and 自然 領域課綱.

Has CEEC announced any 117學年度 學測 changes (dates, format, 考試說明 revisions, computer-based testing)? None appeared on the CEEC pages I checked on 2026-11-15. My web-search budget ran out before a full sweep of 2025–2026 news.
Were any 108課綱 微調 published in 2025–2026 that affect 數學, 自然 or 社會 必修 content (for example AI or 資訊 additions), and from which 學年度? Only 2024 statements were verified.

Is there an official MOE 雙語教育 subject-vocabulary list for 國中 or 高中 數學, 自然 and 社會? None was found; 樂詞網 教科書名詞 is the closest official source. There is also no official 歷史 or 公民 textbook-term dataset on 樂詞網.
What are 因材網's terms of use and license, and its exact 高中 subject and grade coverage? Not found on the homepage; the FAQ URL returned 404.
What license does the 普通型高級中等學校學科資源平臺 (ghresource.mt.ntnu.edu.tw) use, and what content does it hold? The site returned connection resets.
How far has Junyi's 高中 數學, 物理 and 化學 build-out progressed since Dec 2025?
What is CEEC's official English name for 學科能力測驗 and for item types such as 混合題, 選填題 and 國寫? Only the Wikipedia title (GSAT) was verified.

verification.subject: Exam-wide facts and policy: 116學年度 大學學科能力測驗 (學測/GSAT), plus copyright, terminology and free-resource landscape. Adversarial fact-check as of 2026-11-15.
verification.corrected_scope_summary:
Primary-source verification as of 2026-11-15. The report is accurate on nearly every load-bearing point; only small corrections and additions follow.

Next sitting: the 116學年度學測 runs 116/1/22 (Fri) to 1/24 (Sun), i.e. 2027-01-22 to 01-24. Registration was 115/10/27 to 11/10, closing at 15:30 at the counter and midnight via ATM. Individual registrants could pay at convenience stores until 11/07. The 報名結果檢核 period is 11/13 to 11/19; seat lists are posted 116/1/05. Sources: CEEC 116簡章 (初版 115/8/4) and CEEC press release 115.10.23.

Subjects: 6, chosen freely, over 7 sessions in 3 days. 國文 is split into 國綜 (90 min) and 國寫 (90 min). 英文, 數學A and 數學B are 100 min each; 社會 and 自然 are 110 min each.

Scope is 108課綱 部定必修 only:
- 國文 and 英文: listed simply as 必修. Both subject specs say "普通型高級中等學校部定必修課程" and give no grade split. The 英聽, by contrast, is explicitly 10th–11th grade.
- 數學A: 10年級必修 plus 11年級 A類. 數學B: 10年級必修 plus 11年級 B類.
- 社會: 歷史, 地理 and 公民與社會 at roughly equal weight.
- 自然: 物理, 化學, 生物 and 地科 at roughly equal weight, including 探究與實作.
- 加深加廣 is excluded. For example, the 國文 spec Q8 excludes 語文表達與傳播應用, 各類文學選讀, 專題閱讀與研究 and 國學常識.
- CEEC states that 國中 content may serve as material or background knowledge, but is not the main object of item design.

Question types: 單選, 多選 (n options, at least one correct, scored (n−2k)/n with a floor of 0), 選填 (數A/數B only; all blanks must be correct; no penalty) and 混合題 or 非選. 國寫 is entirely non-choice. Since 111 each subject uses one A3 double-sided 卷卡合一 sheet with a signature box.

國文 raw score = 國綜×0.5 + 國寫, where 國綜 is out of 100 and 國寫 out of 50.

級分: L = (mean raw score of the top 1%) / 15. Scores run 0–15, with a 60-級分 version for 分發 採計. Five 標準 are set at the 88th, 75th, 50th, 25th and 12th percentiles.

Calculators and any computing, communication or AI device are banned. The math paper prints reference formulas and values.

New for 116: stricter anti-cheating rules.
- Smart glasses at the seat are treated as cheating and the session scores zero. The same applies if they are left switched on in the storage area.
- A phone or other wearable at the seat costs 3 學測級分 even if it is off. A phone not fully powered off in the storage area also costs 3 級分.
- Electronic and metal detection may be used; examinees consent at registration.

Other changes:
- From 115, 英文 篇章結構 uses 4 blanks with 5 options.
- From 114, the 分科測驗 added 數學乙.
- From 117, the 申請入學 first-stage ratio cap rises from 3x to 4x. This is from a secondary source (聯合報 2025-06-20) and was not checked against an official 招聯會 document.
- From 118, the 青儲 routes to 大學申請入學 and 四技甄選 end.

No 117 學測 format or date announcement and no computer-based-testing notice appears on the CEEC homepage or the 學測 unit page as fetched 2026-11-15. The NAER 課綱 page lists no 總綱 amendment after 110/3/15. The 領域綱要 pages were not checked, and the web-search budget ran out before 2025–2026 news could be swept.

Copyright and licensing:
- CEEC 考試說明 PDFs: non-profit use with attribution; commercial use needs written consent.
- CEEC owns all exam materials, including answer content.
- Whether past papers fall under §9(1)(5) is unresolved: TIPO 1090203b declined to rule.
- NAER and 樂詞網 content falls under the open-data declaration: free and irrevocable, with attribution, including value-added use.
- Junyi: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 TW.
- MOE handbook: "版權所有 翻印必究".

Units are intentionally empty for this exam-wide topic.

corrections.original: In Nov 2024, new NAER president 林從一 took charge of 微調108課綱 (including 資訊素養 and 生成式AI).
corrections.correction: Not verified; I could not fetch the cited 聯合報 2024-11-01 article. The 2024-07-16 CNA article names the then NAER head as 鄭淵全. As of 2026-11-15, the NAER staffing page (PageResearchStaffing?fid=36) lists 劉美慧 as 院長. Any plan text naming 林從一 as the current lead of the 微調 is outdated or unverified.

corrections.original: Phones and other wearables carried to the seat cost 3 學測級分, even if switched off; smart glasses carried to the seat make the session score zero.
corrections.correction:
Correct, but incomplete. Under 違規處理辦法第8條 the storage area is also covered:
- Smart glasses left in the 臨時置物區 without being switched off: the session scores zero (§8 ¶3 一).
- A phone not fully powered off in the storage area, or another wearable left on: 3 學測級分 deducted (§8 ¶4 一).
- Refusing to hand over or be inspected: the session scores zero for phones and wearables, and 取消考試資格 for smart glasses.
- Any clear use of a phone or wearable: the session scores zero.

corrections.original: 分發入學 counts 3 ≤ (學測 + 分科 + 術科) ≤ 5 subjects, with 學測 ≤ 4 and 分科 ≥ 1.
corrections.correction: Add the exception stated in 簡章 附錄十: 僅音樂學系不受此限制. 學測 ≤ 4 excludes 術科.

corrections.original: 國寫 must be written in Traditional Chinese (正體中文).
corrections.correction: The 簡章 附錄三 says 限用正體中文書寫, but makes an exception: 惟專有名詞或試題有特殊要求者不在此限.

corrections.original: 多選 with n options: each option judged separately...
corrections.correction: Also note that a 多選 item has n options of which 至少有1個 is correct, so a single correct option is possible. Students should not assume two or more correct answers. The 英聽 is different: its 多選 items have exactly 2 correct out of 4, and one wrong option earns half credit.

corrections.original: Scores are also used by 科技校院四技申請, 中央警察大學 and 軍校.
corrections.correction: The handbook's list also includes 大學進修學士班申請入學, and 中央警察大學 is specified as 單獨招生 and 軍校 as 甄試入學.

corrections.original: 均一: 高中 數學, 物理 and 化學 still being built as of late 2025; 高一 and 高二上 math prioritized from 2024; about 3萬 videos and 12萬 exercises.
corrections.correction:
On the official site the 高中理科主線 '持續規劃建置中' status is given as of Q1 2025, not late 2025.
- Platform totals conflict: one block shows 32,000+ videos and 120,000+ exercises, another 29,590+ and 122,021+, both footnoted Dec 2025.

corrections.original: CEEC published a separate 英文考科考試說明 (115學年度起適用), marked updated 113.07.29.
corrections.correction: Confirmed. The spec is dated 113年07月. Its 公告說明 三 states that from 115 篇章結構 uses one passage with 4 blanks and 5 options. The CEEC listing page also stamps the whole '111學年度起適用之大學入學考試「考試說明」公告' as 113年07月29日更新. Other spec dates on that page: 數學 and 社會 108.11.08更新; 英文 111–114 version 109.07.31更新.

corrections.original: 學科能力測驗（學測）= General Scholastic Ability Test (GSAT) — only Wikipedia verified.
corrections.correction: CEEC's own English page uses the abbreviations GSAT (學測), AST (分科測驗) and TELC (英聽), but does not spell them out. Use 'GSAT' as the CEEC-attested label. The full expansion is still unverified from CEEC.

confirmed_facts.claim: 116學年度學測 dates and registration: the exam runs 116/1/22 (Fri) to 1/24 (Sun). Registration was 115/10/27 to 11/10. Convenience-store payment, for individual registrants only, closed 115/11/07. Counter payment closed at 15:30 on 11/10 and ATM payment at midnight.
116簡章 is 初版 115年8月4日 and covers 英聽, 學測 and 分科.

Timetable:
- 1/22: 數學A 09:20–11:00, 自然 12:50–14:40.
- 1/23: 英文 09:20–11:00, 國綜 12:50–14:20, 國寫 15:20–16:50.
- 1/24: 數學B 09:20–11:00, 社會 12:50–14:40.
The preparatory bell rings 5 min before each session. No entry after 20 min; no leaving within the first 60 min.

Scope table (108課綱):
- 國文: 必修國文. 英文: 必修英文.
- 數學A: 10年級必修 + 11年級 A類. 數學B: 10年級必修 + 11年級 B類.
- 社會: 必修歷史, 地理 and 公民與社會 at 占分比例相當.
- 自然: 必修物理, 化學, 生物 and 地科 at 占分比例相當, 含探究與實作.
- 國綜 and 國寫 each count 50%.

學測考試說明 總說明 (108年9月):
- 測驗範圍：部定必修.
- Four 測驗目標: basic subject ability; knowledge for bridging to university; integrated problem-solving in varied contexts; reading, 圖表判讀, 證據運用, 邏輯推論, 分析評價 and 表達說明.
- 國中 learning content may be used as material or background, but is not the main object of item design.
- From 111, 混合題型 and the 卷卡合一 A3 answer sheet were introduced.
- The cover carries the copyright notice (non-profit use with attribution; commercial use needs written consent).

Scoring rules:
- 單選: all or nothing.
- 多選: n options with at least 1 correct; options judged independently; k wrong options earn (n−2k)/n of the points, floored at 0.
- 數A/數B 選填: all blanks must be correct; no penalty.
- 國文 raw score = 國綜×0.5 + 國寫, with 國綜 out of 100 and 國寫 out of 50.

級分 system:
- L = (mean raw total of the top 1% of 到考 examinees) / 15.
- k 級分 means (k−1)L < X ≤ kL; 0 raw is 0 級分; maximum 15.
- 60-級分 version uses L/60; 15 maps to 57–60.
- 60-級分 lookup opens 116/04/08.
- 五標 (absent examinees excluded): 頂 88th, 前 75th, 均 50th, 後 25th, 底 12th percentile.

Post-exam dates:
- Papers posted after each session.
- 選擇(填) answers at 19:00 the next day (116/1/23–1/25).
- Objections close 116/1/27; final answers 116/2/17.
- Scores 116/2/25; slips mailed 2/26.
- Re-check 2/26–3/4; results 3/11.

116 major changes (重要編輯說明 四):
- 確認報名資料期間 renamed 報名結果檢核期間.
- Electronic and metal detection, with consent given at registration.
- Smart glasses at the seat: treated as cheating, session scores zero.
- Phones and other wearables at the seat: heavier deduction even if off (3 學測級分 per §8).
- New medical-device and hearing-aid rules.

Exam-room items:
- Banned: calculators and devices with 傳輸, 通訊, 記憶, 掃描, 拍攝, 錄影, 翻譯, 計算 or 人工智慧生成 functions.
- Rulers, set squares, protractors and compasses may carry only a brand logo plus measurement scales and numbers; formula or shape rulers are banned.
- Choice items and drawings use a 2B pencil; other written answers use a black ink pen of 0.5–0.7 mm.
IP: all exam materials and answer content belong to CEEC; examinees grant CEEC the IP in their answers on registration (拾壹 十).

英聽 116 cycle:
- Sittings 115/10/17 and 115/12/12; best result counts.
- Scope: 第10、11年級必修英文.
- 40 multiple-choice items; grades A/B/C/F.
- Used as a 檢定 by universities.
分科測驗 116/7/10–7/11: 8 subjects, 80 min each, scope 部定必修 + 部定加深加廣. 數學乙 was added from 114學年度.

116 大學多元入學手冊 (出版 115年8月, '版權所有 翻印必究'):
- 申請入學: at most 6 校系; 學測 ≤ 50% and P = P1 + P2 ≥ 50%.
- 繁星: 在校成績 covers 高一 to 高三上 (5 semesters); 8 學群.
- From 107, the any-subject 0-級分 bar was removed.
- From 99, stage-2 reviewers cannot see 學測 scores.
- 學測 scores are valid only within the same 學年度; CEEC keeps them 5 years for certificates.
- 分科-only examinees are limited to 分發 校系 that neither check nor count 學測.
- If a 校系 sets both 數A and 數B as 檢定, passing either suffices.
- 青儲 routes to 大學申請入學 and 四技甄選 end after 117; from 118 a reserved 學測 score cannot be used for them. 青儲 became 青年生涯領航計畫 from 115年度.
- Each subject has one A3 double-sided 答題卷 with a signature box; 國寫's is not folded.

總綱 (111學年度實施; cover '103年11月發布/110年2月修正'), 表6 普通型高中 部定必修:
- 國語文 20 (16 in years 1–2, 4 in year 3; includes 中華文化基本教材 2).
- 英語文 18 (16 + 2).
- 數學 16 (8 in year 1; 8 in year 2 as 分類課程, students choose one).
- 社會 18 (歷史, 地理 and 公民與社會 6 each).
- 自然科學 12 (each subject 2–4, at least 2 each).
Grade allocation follows the 領域綱要.
confirmed_facts.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/288/(111學年度實施)十二年國教課程綱要總綱.pdf

confirmed_facts.claim: The NAER 課綱 page lists the 教育部令 of 103/11/28, 106/5/10 and 110/3/15, and no later 總綱 amendment.

國文 考試說明 (111起, 108年9月):
- Based on the 國語文課綱 普通型高中 部定必修; 測驗目標 參採 the 第五學習階段.
- 國綜 混合題 non-choice items are worth 20–28 of 100 points.
- 文言文 share follows the 課綱 3-year average of 35–45%.
- Textbook-selection items: B類 ≤ 40% and C類 ≤ 10% of 教材選文 items.
- 加深加廣 courses are excluded.
- 國寫 tests 知性的統整判斷 and 情意的感受抒發, graded on a 三等六級 scale (A+ … C, 0).

英文 考試說明 (115起, 113年07月):
- 篇章結構: 4 blanks, 5 options from 115.
- Scope: 部定必修.
- Vocabulary: mainly 4,500 words (CEEC reference list levels 1–5).
- Non-choice: 中譯英 plus 英文作文 of at least 120 words.

115 數學A paper:
- 選擇(填) 85 points: 6 單選 (30), 6 多選 (30), 5 選填 (25).
- One 混合題組 (Q18–20) worth 15: 3 + 4 + 8.
- Reference sheet: series sums, 和角公式, 正弦/餘弦定理, statistics and regression formulas, √2≈1.414, √3≈1.732, √5≈2.236, √6≈2.449, π≈3.142, and log 2, 3, 5, 7.

115 數學A 非選 grading: full marks need clear reasoning, a detailed process and a correct answer. Partial credit depends on how complete the concept is. No process, a wrong inference, or data that contradicts the question scores zero. Detailed grading notes are in 選才電子報 issue 351 of 4/15.
The CEEC 一般試題 listing has 189 entries (19 pages), with a year filter from 83 to 115. Its only copyright text is the footer '版權所有 © 2026'.
The CEEC 考試說明 page (updated 115-11-12) shows only 111起 學測 specs plus the 英文 115起 version (113.07.29更新). No 116 or 117 versions are listed.
CEEC homepage: '115學年度學科能力測驗試題與解析即日起發售' dated 115-06-30. No 117 or computer-based-testing items as of 2026-11-15.
聯合報 2024-07-29: 115學測英文 篇章結構 changes from 4選4 to 5選4, approved by the MOE.
中央社 2024-07-16: Minister 鄭英耀 said there is no '118課綱' and the 108課綱 will be fine-tuned rather than overhauled. The then NAER head was 鄭淵全.
著作權法 §9(1) excludes 憲法、法律、命令或公文 (1) and 依法令舉行之各類考試試題及其備用試題 (5). §9(2) defines 公文 to include documents drafted by civil servants in their duties.

TIPO 電子郵件1090203b (109-02-03): '依法令' means ROC law. TIPO did not decide whether 基測 or 學測 papers qualify and referred the question to the MOE or the exam body. It cited §46 for reasonable classroom reproduction.

NAER open-data declaration: free, non-exclusive, irrevocable and sublicensable; no time or territory limit; attribution required; moral rights respected; no malicious alteration. Third-party and specially marked works are excluded, and the license covers copyright only.

樂詞網: about 1.93M 學術名詞 in 206 categories, about 20,000 雙語詞彙 in 21 categories, about 60,000 辭書 entries in 9 dictionaries. Built in 2001, renamed 2022, about 30,000 entries added or revised a year. Covered by the same open-data declaration.

樂詞網 教科書名詞 downloads, with update dates:
- 高中以下化學 2026-05-29
- 生命科學 2023-10-12
- 地球科學 2022-10-25
- 地理學 2022-10-25
- 物理學 2025-03-24
- 資訊 2022-10-25
- 數學 2023-04-06
There is no 歷史 or 公民 set.
data.gov.tw dataset 6319, 教育學學術名詞 (NAER), is licensed under 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版.
均一 content is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 TW unless otherwise marked, covering videos, exercises, assessments and handouts. Breach automatically terminates the license.

均一 official site:
- 國中 數學 and 自然 108課綱 content complete.
- 高中 數學, 物理 and 化學 '持續規劃建置中' (status as of Q1 2025).
- End-2024 totals: 29,162 videos and 121,414 questions.
adl.edu.tw is branded '教育部因材網'. It offers '登入/帳號申請', and the footer shows '©2026 Copyright EDU' with no license.
學科中心 courses have moved to ghresource.mt.ntnu.edu.tw and 教育雲 video: 21 two-credit courses (14 加深加廣, 7 多元選修). The platform was unreachable (ECONNRESET) on 2026-11-15.
CEEC's English page uses the abbreviations GSAT (學測), AST (分科測驗) and TELC (英聽).

verification.exam_format_verified:
116學年度學測, 2027-01-22 to 01-24. Verified against the 116簡章, the 116 handbook, the 總說明, the 國文 and 英文 考試說明, and the 115 數學A paper.

Overview: six subjects chosen freely, 7 sessions over 3 days (Taiwan time).

Bells and attendance:
- A preparatory bell rings 5 min before each session.
- No entry 20 min after the start; no leaving within the first 60 min unless ill or permitted.

Timetable:
- Day 1 (Fri 1/22): 數學A 09:20–11:00, 自然 12:50–14:40.
- Day 2 (Sat 1/23): 英文 09:20–11:00, 國文(一) 國綜 12:50–14:20, 國文(二) 國寫 15:20–16:50.
- Day 3 (Sun 1/24): 數學B 09:20–11:00, 社會 12:50–14:40.

Question types:
- 選擇題: 單選, and 多選 with n options of which at least one is correct.
- 選填: 數A and 數B only.
- 混合題 (a 題組 mixing choice/fill-in with written items) or 非選擇題.
- 國寫 is entirely non-choice.

Answer sheet:
- One A3 double-sided 卷卡合一 sheet per subject, with a signature box.
- 國寫's sheet is not folded. Others are folded to A4: Part 壹 is choice marking, Part 貳 is 混合/非選.
- 2B pencil for choice items and drawings; black ink pen (0.5–0.7 mm suggested) for other written answers.
- Correction tape is allowed for ink answers only.

Scoring:
- 單選: all or nothing.
- 多選: (n−2k)/n of the item's points, floored at 0.
- 選填: all blanks must be correct; no penalty for wrong answers.

Example paper, 115 數學A:
- 85 points of 選擇(填): 6 單選 × 5, 6 多選 × 5, 5 選填 × 5.
- One 混合題組 worth 15 (3 + 4 + 8).
- Reference formulas and values printed at the end: √2, √3, √5, √6, π, and log 2, 3, 5, 7.

國文:
- 國綜 is out of 100; its 混合題 non-choice items are worth 20–28 of the 100.
- 國寫 is out of 50: two 大題 graded in 三等六級, covering 知性的統整判斷 and 情意的感受抒發.
- 國文 raw score = 國綜 × 0.5 + 國寫.
- 國寫 gets a separate slip with A/B/C/0 descriptors and must be written in 正體中文 (exceptions: 專有名詞 or explicit item requirements).

英文:
- Choice items, 混合, and 非選 (中譯英 + 英文作文 ≥ 120 words).
- 篇章結構 uses 4 blanks with 5 options.
- Vocabulary is mainly the 4,500-word CEEC list (levels 1–5).

級分:
- L = (mean raw score of the top 1% of 到考 examinees) / 15.
- k 級分 means (k−1)L < X ≤ kL; 0 raw is 0 級分; maximum 15.
- A 60-級分 version (L/60) is used for 分發 採計; lookup opens 116/04/08.

五標 (absent examinees excluded): 88th, 75th, 50th, 25th and 12th percentile.

Devices and rules:
- Calculators and any device with transmission, memory, scanning, camera, translation, computing or AI-generation functions are banned.
- Rulers may show only a brand logo and measurement scales.
- Smart glasses at the seat, or left switched on in the storage area: the session scores zero.
- A phone or wearable at the seat costs 3 學測級分 even if off; so does a phone not fully powered off in the storage area.

Accommodations: approved special-needs candidates get +30 min per approved session.

verification.notes:
Method: every CEEC, MOE and NAER PDF was fetched and its text read in full, including the 79-page 116簡章 and the 116 handbook. Both are internally consistent with the report on dates, timetable, scope, scoring, 級分, 五標, post-exam dates, the new 116 anti-cheating rules, and admissions usage.

Limits: the WebSearch budget for this turn was exhausted after two queries, so the sweep of 2025–2026 news (課綱微調, 117 changes, the NAER president, official 招聯會 117 documents) could not be done. Absence findings are limited to the CEEC homepage, the 學測 unit page and the NAER 課綱 page as fetched 2026-11-15.

Read-only: I created no files. The WebFetch tool automatically cached PDFs in the harness tool-results folder.

Recommendations for the course plan:
- Version-stamp exam-rule pages as '116學年度 per 簡章 115/8/4'. Re-check each August when the 117簡章 appears.
- Do not state that 國文 or 英文 include 高三 content; CEEC says only '部定必修'.
- Practice must be calculator-free and use paper-style reference sheets.
- Model the 數學 非選 written-reasoning standard.
- For the 國文 beta track, follow CEEC's own composition: 國綜 non-choice worth 20–28 of 100; 文言文 roughly 35–45%; two 國寫 tasks (知性 and 情意) in Traditional Chinese.
- Link to, rather than copy, past papers and 考試說明; write original items.
- Bilingual terms: 樂詞網 sets for 數學, 物理, 化學, 生命科學, 地科 and 地理. 歷史 and 公民 need other cited sources.
- Use 'GSAT' as the CEEC-attested English label.
- Drop or re-verify any mention of 林從一 leading the 課綱 微調; the NAER site currently lists 劉美慧 as 院長.

research.subject: 數學 (Mathematics) — 學測 數學A 與 數學B (116學年度學科能力測驗)
research.scope_summary:
The 116學年度學測 (GSAT) is on 116-01-22 to 116-01-24 (Jan 22–24, 2027). 數學A is on Fri 1/22 and 數學B is on Sun 1/24, both 09:20–11:00 (100 minutes). Both papers follow the 108課綱 (十二年國教數學領綱, 107年6月).

Scope:
- 數學A covers 10年級必修數學 plus 11年級必修數學A類.
- 數學B covers 10年級必修數學 plus 11年級必修數學B類.
- 12年級加深加廣選修 (數學甲/數學乙) is not tested. It belongs to the 分科測驗 (116-07-10/11).

The CEEC 考試說明 (108年9月, 111學年度起適用) says the test also covers whatever prerequisite knowledge and basic tools these contents need. That is the official basis for teaching 國小/國中 bridging material.

Paper structure (verified on 111 and 115 數A and on 114 and 115 數B):
- Part 1 (85 pts): single-choice, multiple-choice and fill-in (選填) items.
- Part 2 (15 pts): one 混合題 group, items 18–20.
- The papers end with a formula/value sheet. Calculators are banned; rulers, set squares, protractors and compasses are allowed.

Syllabus size:
- 10年級: 23 學習內容 items (N-10-1…N-10-7, G-10-1…G-10-7, A-10-1/2, F-10-1…3, D-10-1…4), shared by both tracks.
- 11A: 23 items. 11B: 12 items.

Curriculum markings:
- ※ means the item is suggested to be kept out of national exams (cot/sec/csc; Cauchy and the correlation range).
- ★ means it should not be a direct exam target (√2 proof, numerical error, logic, sets, three-plane geometry).
- ＃ means it needs no standalone unit.

Content codes use these strands: N 數與量, S 空間與形狀, G 坐標幾何, R 關係 (國小 only), A 代數, F 函數, D 資料與不確定性. Textbooks may reorder items within a grade.

Web search budget ran out near the end of this research. License and resource checks were done only by fetching known URLs directly.
research.exam_format:
116學年度學測 數學A and 數學B are separate subjects that students choose freely. They are scheduled on different days (數A Fri 116-01-22, 數B Sun 116-01-24, both 09:20–11:00), so a student can take both. Each is 100 minutes and scored out of 100. The paper format below follows the official papers for 111 and 115 數A and 114 and 115 數B. The 116 papers themselves are not yet published.

**數學A**
- 第壹部分 選擇(填)題, 85 pts: 單選 Q1–6 (5 pts each, 30), 多選 Q7–12 (5 each, 30), 選填 Q13–17 (5 each, 25).
- 第貳部分 混合題或非選擇題, 15 pts: one 題組, Q18–20. The single-choice sub-item is worth 3 pts; non-choice points are marked on each item (115: Q19 is 4 pts, Q20 is 8 pts).

**數學B**
- 單選 Q1–7 (5 each, 35), 多選 Q8–12 (5 each, 25), 選填 Q13–17 (5 each, 25).
- 混合題組 Q18–20, 15 pts (115: 3 + 6 + 6).

**Official framework (考試說明 108年9月)**
- Part 1 (單選/多選/選填) is about 80–85% of the paper; Part 2 (混合題) is about 15–20%.
- A 混合題 is a 題組 that combines 選擇(填) and 非選擇 sub-items.

**Scoring (116簡章)**
- 單選: all or nothing.
- 多選 with n options: k wrong options earns (n−2k)/n of the item's points; below zero or blank earns 0.
- 選填: every blank in the item must be correct to score; wrong answers carry no penalty. Answers are bubbled digit by digit, including '−'.
- 非選擇: must show the calculation or reasoning. Incomplete reasoning earns partial credit; no process, or wrong inference, earns 0 (115 數A 評分原則).
- Results are reported on a 15-級分 scale: the average raw score of the top 1% divided by 15 gives the step L.

**Answering**
- 選擇(填) items are answered with a 2B pencil.
- 非選 items are answered with a black pen, written left to right; 作圖 parts use a 2B pencil.

**Formula sheet: yes.** The papers say a reference formula and value sheet follows the questions.
- 115 數A sheet: arithmetic and geometric series sums; trig sum formulas for sin, cos and tan; law of sines with 2R; law of cosines; mean and standard deviation; correlation coefficient; 迴歸直線（最適合直線）; √2, √3, √5, √6, π; log 2, 3, 5, 7.
- 115 數B sheet: the same, but without the trig sum formulas.

**Tools**
- Calculators are explicitly listed among items that may not be brought to the seat. The 考試說明 says any future calculator permission would be announced three years in advance.
- Allowed: 2B pencil, eraser, black pen, correction tape or fluid (non-choice only), and a ruler, set square, protractor and compass that carry only measuring scales.

key_facts.claim:
Scoring rules:
- 多選 with n options and k wrong selections earns (n−2k)/n of the item's points, floored at 0.
- 選填 needs every blank correct and has no negative marking.
- Results are reported on a 15-級分 scale, where L = (average raw score of the top 1%) / 15.

key_facts.claim:
Meaning of the curriculum markings: ※ is advanced or extension material, suggested to be excluded from national exams. ★ is not recommended as a direct exam target but may be folded into other items. ＃ needs no standalone teaching unit.
- ※ items in 10/11: cot, sec and csc definitions and graphs (F-11A-1); using the Cauchy inequality to explain the range of the correlation coefficient (G-11A-7 備註).
- ★ items: the √2 irrationality proof and the significant-digits note (N-10-1); N-10-5 數值計算的誤差; N-10-7 邏輯; D-10-1 集合; the algebraic test for how three planes sit relative to each other (A-11A-2 備註).
key_facts.evidence: 領綱 p.18 legend and the 10/11 tables; repeated in the 考試說明 appendix.
key_facts.source_name: 國家教育研究院 數學領綱

key_facts.claim: CEEC's summary of what 11B lacks compared with 11A: no 和差角公式, no 正餘弦疊合, no cos/tan function graphs, no 二階行列式, no 空間向量 or 三階行列式, no space planes and lines, no 三元一次聯立方程式, no 矩陣應用. 11B instead has 圓錐曲線 (conic sections as plane–cone cuts), 經緯度 to space coordinates, and 平面上的比例 (design and perspective).
key_facts.evidence: 111學測簡介─數學考科 slides 11–12 (民國110年11月).
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 111學測簡介─數學考科

key_facts.claim: CEEC planned to introduce 混合題 at the lower bound of the 考試說明 range and raise it slightly year by year. Observed: Part 2 was still 15 pts in 111 數A, 114 數B, 115 數A and 115 數B. The 116 proportion is not yet known.
key_facts.evidence: 大考命題方向說明 (110.04.01), 混合題(2/2) slide, plus the paper headers listed above.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 大考命題方向說明

key_facts.claim: 115學測 statistics: 數學A had 92,951 takers (76.48%) and 數學B had 101,718 (83.69%) out of 121,535 registrants. 五標 (頂/前/均/後/底): 數A 12/10/8/5/4; 數B 11/9/5/3/2. Compared with 114, 數A's 均標 rose from 6 to 8 and all of 數B's standards fell by 1.

key_facts.claim: The six 測驗目標 are: 概念性知識, 程序性知識, 閱讀與表達, 連結能力, 推理能力, and 解決問題. Each sample item in the 考試說明 is tagged with 學習內容 codes; for example, F-10-2 三次函數的圖形特徵 and S-11B-2 圓錐曲線.
key_facts.evidence: 考試說明 壹、測驗目標 and 參、試題舉例.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 考試說明

key_facts.claim: The 116 學測 will be the sixth exam under the 108課綱. The 115 數A 試題特色 calls 115 the fifth.
key_facts.evidence: 選才電子報 第351期, 115學年度學科能力測驗試題特色【數學A】.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 選才電子報 351期

key_facts.claim:
Some 10th-grade boundaries stated in 備註:
- Absolute-value inequalities stick mainly to the |x−a|<b and |x−a|>b forms; interval notation is used only to express solutions, with no set operations on intervals.
- Synthetic division uses only (x−a) as the divisor.
- 直線與圓 excludes the relationship between two circles.
- G-10-1 does not cover general line or point symmetry.
- 廣義角 starts with angles from −180° to 360°.
- Exact inverse matrices are computed only for 2×2 (A-11A-3).
key_facts.evidence: 領綱 10/11 年級 學習內容 備註 column.
key_facts.source_name: 國家教育研究院 數學領綱
key_facts.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/815/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等學校-數學領域.pdf

units.title_zh: 實數
units.title_en: Real numbers
key_concepts: number line, meaning of decimal notation, trichotomy law (三一律)
rationals have terminating or repeating decimals; estimating irrational decimals
√2 is irrational (proof marked ★)
operations in scientific notation; significant digits kept after computation (★)

units.title_zh: 絕對值
units.title_en: Absolute value (equations and inequalities)
key_concepts: absolute-value equations and inequalities, mainly |x−a|<b and |x−a|>b
b read as an error tolerance (product or engineering specs)
interval notation, including unions and ±∞, used only to state solutions

units.title_zh: 指數
units.title_en: Exponents (rational and real exponents)
key_concepts: fractional and decimal powers of non-negative reals
geometric mean and the AM–GM inequality (算幾不等式)
review of exponent laws; meaning of real exponents
calculator x^y key (calculators are not allowed in the exam)

units.title_zh: 常用對數
units.title_en: Common logarithms
key_concepts: meaning of log (base 10); link to scientific notation
any positive a can be written as 10^(log a)
no other bases at this stage
exam supplies log 2, 3, 5, 7 values

units.title_zh: 數值計算的誤差
units.title_en: Error in numerical computation
key_concepts: limits of calculators; noticing when error occurs
choosing a sensible number of significant digits
marked ★＃: not a direct exam target, taught inside other topics

units.title_zh: 數列、級數與遞迴關係
units.title_en: Sequences, series and recursive relations
key_concepts: finite recursive sequences, mainly first-order
finite geometric series; common summation formulas
mathematical induction: spot the pattern by observation first, then prove
links to 國中 arithmetic and geometric sequences; solve a^x=b approximately with common logs

units.title_zh: 邏輯
units.title_en: Logic
key_concepts: propositions and their negations
'or', 'and' and implication between two propositions
sufficient, necessary, and necessary-and-sufficient conditions
marked ★＃: woven into other topics

units.title_zh: 坐標圖形的對稱性
units.title_en: Symmetry of graphs in the coordinate plane
key_concepts: reflection in the x-axis, the y-axis and the line y=x; symmetry about the origin
general line or point symmetry is not required
＃: no standalone unit

units.title_zh: 直線方程式
units.title_en: Equations of lines
key_concepts: slope and what its absolute value means; point-slope form
translating points and lines; equations of parallel and perpendicular lines
distance from a point to a line; distance between parallel lines
linear inequalities in two variables (half-planes); area of triangle OPQ from coordinates

units.title_zh: 圓方程式
units.title_en: Equation of a circle
key_concepts: standard form (x−h)^2+(y−k)^2=r^2
general form converted to standard form by completing the square

units.title_zh: 直線與圓
units.title_en: Lines and circles
key_concepts: tangent lines to a circle
line–circle position by algebra (discriminant) and by geometry (distance from center vs radius)
the relationship between two circles is excluded
set-builder notation for inequality regions

units.title_zh: 廣義角和極坐標
units.title_en: Generalized angles and polar coordinates
key_concepts: terminal side of a generalized angle; range starts at −180° to 360°
definition of polar coordinates; converting between polar and rectangular on grid paper
slope and inclination angle are equivalent ideas in the plane

units.title_zh: 三角比
units.title_en: Trigonometric ratios
key_concepts: sine, cosine and tangent of acute angles, extended to generalized angles
values at special angles
estimate ratios by measuring drawn figures; calculator sin/cos/tan keys

units.title_zh: 三角比的性質
units.title_en: Properties of trigonometric ratios (laws of sines and cosines)
key_concepts: law of sines (=2R); law of cosines; projection formula (正射影)
slope equals tan of the inclination angle; angle between two intersecting lines
surveying (三角測量＃) on cuboid cross-sections, extendable to regular pyramids
exam formula sheet provides both laws

units.title_zh: 式的運算
units.title_en: Algebraic expressions (cubic identities, radicals, rational expressions)
key_concepts: cubic multiplication identities, e.g. (a±b)^3 and a^3±b^3
operations with radicals; rationalizing denominators
operations with rational expressions

units.title_zh: 多項式之除法原理
units.title_en: Polynomial division (factor and remainder theorems)
key_concepts: division algorithm; remainder theorem; factor theorem
synthetic division by (x−a) only, not ax−b; no detached-coefficient method
rewriting a polynomial in powers of (x−a)

units.title_zh: 一次與二次函數
units.title_en: Linear and quadratic functions
key_concepts: moving from equations to f(x) notation; how f(x−h) and f(−x) graphs relate to f(x)
division-point formula on the number line; interpolation rests on it
completing the square (moved here from 國中 F-9-2); y=ax^2 and translations
applied problems on closed intervals (max/min)

units.title_zh: 三次函數的圖形特徵
units.title_en: Graph features of cubic functions
key_concepts: symmetry of quadratic and cubic graphs; every cubic is a translate of y=ax^3+px
global shape set by the leading term

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 整數位值、數線與四則運算順序
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Place value, the number line and order of operations
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Every 10th-grade unit assumes fluent arithmetic. N-10-1 (real numbers) starts from the number line, and A-10-1 assumes the operation laws.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 分數的意義與四則運算
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Fractions: meaning and four operations
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed for rational expressions (A-10-1), probability (D-10-4), slopes, ratios and fill-in answers in simplest fractions. The curriculum itself flags the misconception that multiplying always gives a bigger result (N-5-5).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 小數與概數
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Decimals and rounding/estimation
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed for decimal characteristics of rationals (N-10-1), significant digits and error (N-10-5), and using the supplied √2≈1.414 and log values. N-6-4 flags the misconception that a quotient is always smaller than the dividend.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 因數、倍數、質因數分解
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Factors, multiples, primes, GCD/LCM, prime factorization
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed to simplify fractions and radicals and for polynomial factorization (A-8-5 → A-10-2).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 比、比值、百分率、速度、比例尺
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Ratio, rate, percentage, speed, map scale
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed for growth-rate models (F-11B-2, F-11A-4), error percentages (115 數B Q1), similar figures and 平面上的比例 (G-11B-3).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 角、角度、旋轉角；平面圖形與面積；圓、扇形
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Angles, rotation, plane figures, area, circles and sectors
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed for generalized angles with direction of rotation (G-10-5), sectors and radians (N-11A-1/N-11B-1), and area reasoning (111 數A 混合題 area errors).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 立體形體：正方體、長方體、柱體、錐體、球
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Solids: cubes, cuboids, prisms, pyramids, cones, spheres
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Foundation for 空間概念 (S-11A-1/S-11B-1), cone cross-sections (S-11B-2) and parallelepiped volume (G-11A-8).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 統計圖表與可能性
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Statistical charts and informal likelihood
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed for reading data and tables in 素養 items. Two-way tables (D-3-1) lead to contingency tables (D-11B-2).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 負數、數線、絕對值（距離意義）
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Negative numbers, number line, absolute value as distance
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: N-10-2 builds absolute-value equations and inequalities on |a−b| as distance. 國中 deliberately excludes absolute-value equations.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 指數、指數律、科學記號

bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Direct prerequisite for N-10-1 (scientific-notation operations), N-10-3 (real exponents) and N-10-4 (common logs).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 比例式與連比

recent_trends.trend: The paper layout has been stable from 111 to 115. 數A has 6 單選 + 6 多選 + 5 選填 (85 pts). 數B has 7 單選 + 5 多選 + 5 選填 (85 pts). Both end with one 混合題組 (Q18–20, 15 pts) combining a 3-point single-choice item with written non-choice items.
CEEC said in 110 that 混合題 would start at the lower bound of the 考說 range (15–20%) and rise gradually. Through 115 it remained at 15 points.

111 數A was the first 108課綱 paper. It introduced a 混合題 with a drawing task: a scanning-rod situation using circle equations, polar coordinates and sector area. Most items stressed concepts over heavy computation (e.g. Q3 used regression-line and variance ideas with little arithmetic).

112 數A continued context-based items with light computation and concise wording. Its 混合題 was plane geometry, mixing trig ratio properties, polar coordinates, vectors, line equations and sum formulas, and the figure was reprinted on the answer sheet. Hardest item: Q12 combining sine and cosine (P=21%).

112 數B had more 素養 items in everyday contexts (ropes between buildings, LED billboards, paper folding). Its 混合題 used single-point perspective. B-only content (perspective, cone sections, globe) was examined. Hardest: Q16 paper folding (P=16%) and Q7 cone section (P=30%).

In 113 數A, about a quarter of the paper was everyday or cross-domain contexts (drug-residue decay, artillery angles, species classification with regression). Computation dropped noticeably. Geometry and functions made up about two-thirds. There were fewer figures, so students had to draw their own. Hardest: Q17 absolute value with two-variable linear inequalities (P=5%) and Q16 vectors with projections (P=8%).

113 數B used varied contexts (games, Christmas lights, climate) with concise wording and light computation; some items linked to 國中 concepts. B-only Q16 on globe and great circles had P=15%. Q7 on reading a temperature chart had P=15%. Q11 on average reduction rate had P=31%.

114 數A stressed cross-unit integration (Q4, 5, 8, 11, 14), explicit links to 國中 content (Q1, 2, 7, 9, 13) and combining figures with algebra. Its 混合題 was built around matrices (rotation, plane vectors, trig). Low P: Q17 14%, Q15 expected value in a market-stall context 16%, Q16 18%, Q12 alloy ratios and 2-D data 22%.

114 數B had plain wording and little computation, with two diagrams and three data tables. Its 混合題 used UV-index data, linking proportional growth and periodic models. Low P: Q17 LED modelling 11%, Q7 perspective 23%, Q15 permutations 25%, Q5 cone section 30%.

115 數A drew content roughly evenly from 10th grade and 11A, emphasized links between geometry and algebra, and avoided special tricks. Easy items opened each section. Its 混合題 used a parallelepiped (cross product, plane equation). Q20 longest distance had P=2%; Q17 law of sines with double angles had P=6%; Q14 normal vector of a line had P=19%. The teacher-author stresses algebraic computation accuracy.

115 數B focused on conceptual and procedural knowledge, with plain wording, many text-plus-diagram or table items, and contexts such as territorial baselines, lucky bags and drink dilution. Its 混合題 used star-trail photos (lines, circles, vectors). B-only items: Q4 latitude 44%, Q11 cone cross-section 26%, Q17 single-point perspective 3%.
Score standards: 115 數A 均標 was 8 (114: 6, 113: 7). 115 數B 均標 was 5 (114: 6, 113: 6). 數B has more takers than 數A (101,718 vs 92,951 in 115), and 46.09% of candidates took all 6 subjects.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Misreading the physical setup of a context problem. In 111 數A Q19–20, students assumed the scanning rod lay flat on the x-axis, or that it was longer than stated. They then shaded the wrong region and wrote the wrong equations.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Translate the situation into a diagram that exactly matches every stated condition (start and end positions, orientation) before computing. Check that the region is closed and bounded by the correct edges.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Polar-coordinate errors in 111 數A: swapping the distance and the angle, giving rectangular instead of polar coordinates, or computing the length or angle wrongly.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: A polar coordinate is written [r, θ]: first the distance from the pole, then the directed angle from the polar axis. Convert with x = r·cosθ and y = r·sinθ.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Area errors in 111 數A Q20: judging regions to be triangles by eye, writing the sector-area formula wrongly, splitting the region incorrectly, or assuming one area is twice another 'by symmetry'.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: A sector's area is (central angle / full turn) × πr², or ½r²θ in radians. Decompose a region only into pieces whose areas you can justify, and verify every symmetry claim.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Writing conclusions without justification: stating that two vectors are parallel without a reason, or giving only a final number. A correct answer reached through a wrong concept or an unreasonable process still scores 0.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Non-choice items grade the reasoning chain. Justify each claim, for example parallel because one vector is a scalar multiple of the other. Partial credit requires correct reasoning.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Sign and position errors with coordinates in 112 數A Q19: ignoring that a coordinate should be negative when found from a distance to an axis, or misplacing a point found with trig ratios.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: A distance is non-negative, but a coordinate carries a sign set by the quadrant. Fix the quadrant from the figure before converting a distance into a coordinate.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Misremembered area formulas in 112 數A Q20: the trapezoid area taken as (top + bottom) × height without halving. Errors in a line's equation also spoiled the point-to-line distance.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Trapezoid area = ½(a + b)h. Derive the line equation carefully before substituting into d = |ax₀ + by₀ + c| / √(a² + b²).

common_misconceptions.misconception: Comparing sine values without a reason in 111 數B Q19: ordering sin values without noting that sine is strictly increasing on the interval, or sketching a graph with no supporting argument. Students also linked tower height, tilt offset and sine wrongly (Q20).
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: To compare function values, cite monotonicity on the relevant interval. Set up the right-triangle relationship explicitly (offset = length × sin of tilt angle) before computing.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Misunderstanding the vanishing point in perspective drawing (112 數B Q19): treating it as the intersection of other segments, or assuming a triangle is isosceles without any basis.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: In single-point perspective, images of parallel lines receding from the viewer meet at one vanishing point. Find it as the intersection of those specific lines, and use only properties the problem guarantees.

common_misconceptions.misconception: 'Multiplying always makes a number bigger.' The curriculum explicitly tells teachers to address this error when teaching fraction and decimal multiplication.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Multiplying by a number between 0 and 1 gives a smaller result; for example, 12 × 0.5 = 6.
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/815/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等學校-數學領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: 'Dividing always makes a number smaller.' The curriculum explicitly flags this error type for decimal division.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Dividing by a number between 0 and 1 gives a larger result; for example, 6 ÷ 0.5 = 12. The quotient equals the dividend times the divisor's reciprocal.
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/815/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等學校-數學領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: Wrongly predicting the shape of a cone's or cylinder's cross-section (B-only 圓錐曲線). These items were repeatedly hard: 112 Q7 P=30%, 114 Q5 P=30%, 115 Q11 P=26%. The 115 author notes the two-lamp-shade design was meant to expose misconceptions about cone sections.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: A plane cutting a right circular cone gives a circle (perpendicular to the axis), an ellipse (tilted but cutting all generators), a parabola (parallel to one generator) or a hyperbola (steeper). Visualize with 3D models.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Unfamiliar notation and conceptual traps in 115 數A, reported as low success rates rather than coded errors: matrix operations written as linear combinations of vectors (Q5, P=26%), the normal vector of a line (Q14, P=19%), and the symmetry center of a general cubic (Q12, P=28%).
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Read a matrix times a vector as a linear combination of the matrix's columns. A line ax + by = c has normal vector (a, b). Every cubic is a translate of y = ax³ + px, and its symmetry center is at x = −b/(3a).

open_questions: Is there a newer 學測數學考科考試說明 than the 108年9月 edition (111學年度起適用) that applies to 116? None was found, but the web-search budget ran out before an exhaustive check of CEEC announcements. The 116簡章's scope wording matches the 108年9月 document.
Will the 116 papers keep the 111–115 layout (數A 6/6/5 + 15-pt 混合題; 數B 7/5/5 + 15-pt 混合題)? CEEC's plan was to raise the 混合題 share gradually within the 15–20% range. The 116 試卷 does not exist yet.
Has any announcement been made allowing calculators in 117 or later? The 116簡章 bans them, and the 考試說明 requires three years' notice. No announcement was found (search limit reached).

The publisher-specific chapter order of 108課綱 textbooks (龍騰, 翰林, 南一, 康熹) and the 普通型高中數學 課程手冊's recommended order were not retrieved. The 領綱 allows reordering within a grade, so the website's teaching sequence needs its own justification.
Full 選才電子報 non-choice common-error write-ups for 113 (issue 342), 114 (347) and 115 (351), for both 數A and 數B, were not retrieved. Only 111 and 112 數A, 111 數B and part of 112 數B were read.

Licensing for reproducing CEEC past papers, items and figures on a public bilingual website, especially if it is ever monetized, is unconfirmed. Prior written permission from CEEC is likely needed. The 樂詞網 reuse terms were also not verified.
The 111 數A 評分原則說明 page was read only up to about 200k characters; the tail (Q20 remainder) was not read. The 112 數B page was read only up to 100k characters (Q19 only).
Khan Academy (English) license terms were not verified, and neither was 均一's coverage of the specific 11A/11B 108課綱 units.
Whether teacher-authored 選才電子報 P values refer to all test takers (assumed to be the share answering correctly) is not defined in the articles.
pedagogy_notes: Syllabus spine: use the official code lists exactly (10年級 has 23 items for both tracks, 11A has 23, 11B has 12). The 領綱 says one item does not equal one teaching unit, and textbooks may reorder within a grade. So module order can follow pedagogical logic as long as every depends_on prerequisite comes first.

CEEC's own grouping of 10th-grade content (111學測簡介) can serve as chapter titles: 數與式, 直線與圓, 多項式, 數列與級數, 排列組合, 機率, 數據分析, 三角比. 11A groups: 三角函數, 指數對數函數, 平面向量, 空間向量, 空間中的平面與直線, 機率, 矩陣. 11B groups: 週期性數學模型, 按比例成長模型, 平面向量（含平面上的比例）, 空間（空間概念、坐標系）, 圓錐曲線, 機率（不確定性）, 矩陣與資料表格.

To avoid topics appearing 'out of nowhere', respect the 備註 boundaries. Examples: no two-circle relations in G-10-4; synthetic division only by (x−a); 國中 absolute value only as distance (equations start at N-10-2); 國中 avoids f(x) notation, which F-10-1 introduces; completing the square for quadratic functions moves from 國中 F-9-2 to F-10-1.

The curriculum marks several cross-links explicitly; make them visible. N-10-6 links to 國中 sequences (N-8-4/5/6). D-10-2 extends 國中 quartiles and box plots (D-9-1) to percentiles. G-10-2 links to 國中 parallel and perpendicular geometry. G-11A-1 and G-11A-5 build on 10th grade. S-11B-1 is designed to serve 地理 (great and small circles), a natural cross-link to the Social Studies course. G-11B-4 turns latitude and longitude into 3D coordinates.

Items marked ★＃ (N-10-5 error, N-10-7 logic, D-10-1 sets) are not direct exam targets and should not be standalone units. Present them as short 'toolbox' interludes inside other lessons. ※ items (cot/sec/csc; Cauchy and the correlation range) can be optional extensions labeled 'beyond 學測'.

Exam reality vs curriculum: the 領綱 repeatedly mentions calculator keys (x^y, log, sin, rad), but the 學測 bans calculators and instead supplies √2, √3, √5, √6, π and log 2/3/5/7. Teach the concept with calculator or GeoGebra demos, then drill estimating with the supplied values.

Teach students to read the formula sheet as a tool, not a crutch. 數A gets the trig sum formulas, laws of sines and cosines, series sums, σ, r and the regression line; 數B gets the same minus the sum formulas. Lessons can point out which formulas will be provided.

Non-choice write-ups are graded on the reasoning chain: a correct answer with flawed reasoning scores 0. Build a 'show your reasoning' habit from 國中 proof (S-9-11) onward. The dialogue format can model justifying each step, e.g. 'why are these vectors parallel?'.

Topics with persistently low success deserve extra visualization or interaction. B-only: cone cross-sections (P 26–30%), single-point perspective (P 3–23%), great circles and latitude (P 15–44%). 數A: space vectors and plane/line distances, combining sine and cosine (P 21%), symmetry center of a cubic (P 28%), multi-step expected value in contexts (P 16%). Interactive 3D models (e.g. GeoGebra 3D, mind its non-commercial license) fit well here.

Reading-heavy 素養 items have been part of the 學測 since 105. CEEC keeps text length near recent averages and still includes many basic items. Each unit should pair a core-concept item with a context item that requires translating text, tables or figures into math, as CEEC articles repeatedly cite translation as the main hurdle in 數B.

Bilingual terms differ between the 課綱/exam and 樂詞網 in places: 正弦定理/餘弦定理 vs 樂詞網 正弦定律/餘弦定律; 反方陣 vs 逆方陣/反矩陣; 圓錐曲線 vs 圓錐截痕 (for 'conic section'); 最適直線 vs 迴歸線/迴歸直線; 轉移方陣 vs 轉移矩陣. Show the 課綱/exam term as primary, with the 樂詞網 variant as an alias.

In the 108課綱 both tracks share all 10th-grade content, and 數B is taken by more students than 數A (115: 101,718 vs 92,951). A track switch after the shared 10th-grade core (11A vs 11B paths) matches how the curriculum branches.

verification.subject: 數學 (Mathematics) — 學測 數學A 與 數學B (116學年度學科能力測驗)
verification.corrected_scope_summary:
The 116學年度學測 runs 116-01-22 (Fri) to 116-01-24 (Sun), which is Jan 22–24, 2027. 數學A sits on Fri 1/22 and 數學B on Sun 1/24, both 09:20–11:00 (100 minutes). Students choose subjects freely, so they can take both papers. Registration was 115-10-27 to 115-11-10 (116簡章, 初版 115-08-04).

**Scope (116簡章 and 考試說明), under the 108課綱**
- 數學A = 10年級必修數學 (8學分) + 11年級必修數學A類 (8學分).
- 數學B = 10年級必修數學 + 11年級必修數學B類 (8學分).
- 12年級加深加廣選修 (數學甲/數學乙) is not in 學測. It belongs to the 分科測驗, 116-07-10 (Sat) to 07-11 (Sun).
  - 數甲 = 10必修 + 11A + 數學甲類.
  - 數乙 = 10必修 + the 11年級 content that relates to both A類 and B類 (per CEEC's 112-05-02 分科數學考試說明) + 數學乙類.
- The 考試說明 says the test 自然包含修習這些內容所需之先備知識和基本工具 (naturally includes the prerequisite knowledge and basic tools needed to learn this content). That is the official basis for 國小/國中 bridging.

**Curriculum (數學領綱)**
- Dates: the cover says 中華民國107年6月; MOE promulgated it on 107-07-26 (footnote in the 考試說明).
- Counts verified against the 領綱 table:
  - 10年級: 23 items (N-10-1…7, G-10-1…7, A-10-1/2, F-10-1…3, D-10-1…4).
  - 11A: 23 items (N-11A-1, S-11A-1, G-11A-1…10, A-11A-1…4, F-11A-1…4, D-11A-1…3).
  - 11B: 12 items (N-11B-1, S-11B-1/2, G-11B-1…4, A-11B-1, F-11B-1/2, D-11B-1/2).
- Markings:
  - ※ = 建議不納入全國性考試 (suggested to be kept out of national exams). In 10–11 this covers cot/sec/csc in F-11A-1 and the Cauchy-to-correlation-range note in G-11A-7.
  - ★ = not a direct exam target. Covers the √2 proof and the significant-digits note in N-10-1, N-10-5, N-10-7, D-10-1, and the three-plane algebraic test in A-11A-2.
  - ＃ = no standalone unit. Covers N-10-5, N-10-7, G-10-1, 三角測量 in G-10-7, and D-10-1.
- Textbooks may reorder items within a grade, and one item is not one teaching unit.
- Σ notation is formally introduced only in 12甲/12乙 (N-12甲-2, N-12乙-2). The 學測 formula sheet writes sums out in full.

**Paper structure (考試說明)**
- 第壹部分 單選/多選/選填 is about 80–85%; 第貳部分 混合題 is about 15–20%.
- CEEC planned to start at the lower bound. Part 2 was exactly 15 pts on every 數A and 數B paper from 111 to 115.
- 數A: 6 單選 + 6 多選 + 5 選填 (30/30/25). 數B: 7/5/5 (35/25/25).
- The 混合題組 is always Q18–20, but its sub-item mix varies by year (see exam format).
- Every paper has a 參考公式及可能用到的數值 page. 數A's includes the 三角函數和角公式; 數B's does not.
- Calculators are banned. Rulers, set squares, protractors and compasses are allowed if they carry only measuring scales, numbers and a brand logo.
- The 116 papers are not yet published, so the 116 layout is unconfirmed.

corrections.original: 115學測統計: 數學A had 92,951 takers (76.48%) and 數學B had 101,718 (83.69%).
corrections.correction: 92,951 and 101,718 are 選考人數 (candidates who registered for the subject; 表2). The number who actually sat and received a 級分 (表8 cumulative totals) was 90,579 for 數學A and 97,536 for 數學B. The 五標 values (數A 12/10/8/5/4; 數B 11/9/5/3/2) and the year-on-year changes are correct.

corrections.original: Both papers end with one 混合題組 (Q18–20, 15 pts) combining a 3-point single-choice item with written non-choice items (stated as a stable 111–115 trend).
corrections.correction:
Part 2 was 15 pts in all ten 數A and 數B papers from 111 to 115, but the sub-items vary:
- 數A: 111, 112 and 114 were 3(單選)+6+6; 113 and 115 were 3(單選)+4+8.
- 數B: 111 was 5(單選)+4+6; 112 was 3(選填)+6+6, so its first sub-item was a fill-in, not single-choice; 113 was 3(單選)+4+8; 114 and 115 were 3(單選)+6+6.
So the first sub-item is not always a 3-pt single-choice question.

corrections.original: Units 1–15 order: N-10-1, N-10-2, N-10-3 … with A-10-1 式的運算 at position 15.
corrections.correction: Move A-10-1 to position 3, right after 實數 and 絕對值. N-10-3 needs radical operations for fractional exponents and the 算幾不等式. CEEC's 111學測簡介 slide groups 實數、絕對值、式的運算 together as 數與式. Add A-10-1 to N-10-3's depends_on.

corrections.correction: The 學習內容 for G-10-3 reads only 圓方程式：圓的標準式, with no 備註. The general form (一般式) is not in the item text. If the site teaches it, label it as an extension that relies on 國中 配方 (A-8-7).

Put N-10-7 (★＃ toolbox) before N-10-6, because 數學歸納法 is an implication chain. Add these missing prerequisites:
- N-10-7 → N-10-6
- G-10-2 → G-10-5 (the 備註 says 斜率和斜角觀念彼此等價)

- D-10-1 → D-10-3 (取捨原理 uses union and intersection)
- G-11A-7 → G-11A-10 (skew-line distance)
- N-11B-1 and G-10-6 → S-11B-1 (great-circle arcs; 緯線 problems such as 115數B Q4 need cos)
- S-11B-1 → G-11B-3 (115數B Q17 tested 單點透視法與空間概念)
- G-10-5 → G-11B-4
- F-10-1 → F-11B-1
- D-3-1 → D-11B-2 (二維表格 leads to 列聯表)
