corrections.original: Open question: is there a newer 學測數學考科考試說明 than 108年9月?
corrections.correction: The 116簡章 appendix (考試相關參考資訊) points to 「111學年度起適用之大學入學考試『考試說明』（113年07月29日更新）」. As new documents it lists only the 115學年度起適用 學測英文 考試說明 and the 114學年度起適用 分科數學 考試說明; it lists no new 學測數學 考試說明. The 108年9月 math document is therefore still the applicable framework. Whether the 113-07-29 update changed any math wording was not checked.

corrections.original: 非選擇: Incomplete reasoning earns partial credit; no process, or wrong inference, earns 0.
corrections.correction:
The 115 數A 評分原則 is more precise:
- Partial credit (酌給部分分數, by completeness of the solution concept) goes to answers that reason clearly from correct premises and explain the process in detail but miss the final answer.
- Answers that do not reason from correct premises, or 未能詳細說明解題過程, get 0.
Item rubrics may still award partial credit for specific steps; for example, 115數A Q19 gives partial credit for correctly identifying the normal vector.

corrections.original: Pedagogy note: CEEC's 10th-grade grouping = 數與式, 直線與圓, 多項式, 數列與級數, 排列組合, 機率, 數據分析, 三角比.

confirmed_facts.claim:
116學測 runs 116-01-22 (Fri) to 116-01-24 (Sun).
- 數學A: Fri 1/22, 09:20–11:00.
- 英文: Sat 1/23, 09:20–11:00.
- 數學B: Sun 1/24, 09:20–11:00.
- Durations: 國綜 and 國寫 90 min each; 英文, 數A and 數B 100 min; 社會 and 自然 110 min.
- 學測 registration: 115-10-27 to 115-11-10.
- 簡章 初版: 115-08-04.

116簡章 測驗範圍 (108課綱): 數學A = 10年級必修數學 + 11年級必修數學A類; 數學B = 10年級必修數學 + 11年級必修數學B類.
題型: 選擇 (單選、多選), 選填 (only 數A and 數B), and 混合 or 非選擇. A 混合題 is a 題組 that combines 選擇(填) and 非選擇 items.

分科測驗 runs 116-07-10 (Sat) to 07-11 (Sun), 80 min per subject.
- 數學甲 = 10必修 + 11A + 數學甲類.
- 數學乙 = 10必修 + 11年級必修數學A類與數學B類均關聯的學習內容 + 數學乙類, per the 112-05-02 分科測驗數學考科考試說明 (114學年度起適用).

The 考試說明 (中華民國108年9月, 111學年度起適用) gives the range as 10年級 and 11年級 必修.
- It states 「自然包含修習這些內容所需之先備知識和基本工具」.
- 第壹部分 單選/多選/選填 is about 80–85%; 第貳部分 混合題 is about 15–20%.
- The appendix gives 10年級 8學分, 11A 8學分, 11B 8學分.

考試說明 前言:
- Any calculator permission will be announced three years before the exam.
- If calculators are allowed, the paper will stop supplying trig and log values.
- Terms that are not common to all textbook versions will be explained in the paper.
It lists six 測驗目標: 概念性知識, 程序性知識, 閱讀與表達, 連結, 推理, 解決問題. Sample items are tagged with codes, e.g. F-10-2 and S-11B-2.

Every item code, title and 備註 for 10年級 (23), 11A (23), 11B (12), 12甲 (14) and 12乙 (12) in the report matches the NAER 數學領綱 PDF. The cover is dated 中華民國一○七年六月.

The coding (p.18) is: first character = strand (N, S, G, R, A, F, D; R is 國小 only and becomes A and F later); second = grade 1–12, with 11A/11B and 12甲/12乙; third = serial number. Textbooks may reorder items within a grade.

confirmed_facts.claim:
115 數學A: 單選 Q1–6 (30), 多選 Q7–12 (30), 選填 Q13–17 (25), then 混合題組 Q18–20 (15) = Q18 單選 3 + Q19 非選 4 + Q20 非選 8. 100 minutes.
111 數A is also 30/30/25/15, but its 題組 was 3+6+6.

The 115 formula sheet (參考公式及可能用到的數值) contains:
- arithmetic and geometric series sums
- 三角函數的和角公式 for sin, cos and tan (數A only)
- 正弦定理 (=2R) and 餘弦定理
- 1-D mean and standard deviation
- correlation coefficient and 迴歸直線（最適合直線）
- √2, √3, √5, √6 and π
- log 2, 3, 5 and 7
The 數B sheet omits the 和角公式; the 112 and 113 數B sheets also omit them.

Paper instructions:
- 選擇(填): 2B pencil.
- 非選: thick black ink pen, 由左而右橫式書寫 (written horizontally, left to right), and 必須寫出計算過程或理由 (must show the working or reasons).
- 作圖: 2B pencil, no correction tape.

116簡章 scoring:
- 多選 with n options and k wrong selections earns (n−2k)/n of the item's points; below zero or blank earns 0.
- 選填 needs every blank correct and has no negative marking; answers are bubbled digit by digit, including '−'.
- 級距 L = (average raw score of the top 1% of 到考 candidates) / 15; maximum 15 級分.

116簡章 tools:
- Allowed: 黑色2B鉛筆, 橡皮擦, 黑色墨水筆, 修正帶/液, 直尺, 三角板, 量角器, 圓規. Rulers may carry only measuring scales and numbers, plus a brand logo.
- Banned from the seat: 計算機, listed among devices with 計算 functions.

115 數A 非選 評分原則 intro: full marks need clear reasoning, a detailed process and the correct answer. Correct reasoning without the final answer gets partial credit. No process, wrong inference, or data that contradicts the problem gets 0. Usually more than one solution method is accepted.

111學測簡介 (民國110年11月):
- B類沒有 和差角公式, 正餘弦疊合, cos與tan函數, 二階行列式.
- B類 has no 三元一次聯立方程式 or 矩陣應用, and no 空間向量 or 三階行列式, but stresses computing space coordinates from 經緯度.
- B類 has no 空間中的平面與直線.
- B類 has 圓錐曲線 and 平面上的比例.
- 學測 = 部定必修; 分科 = 部定必修與加深加廣選修.

大考命題方向說明 (110.04.01): 學測 would introduce 混合題 at the 考說 lower bound and raise it slightly year by year. 數A and 數B 混合題 are about 15–20%. Every 數A and 數B paper from 111 to 115 had exactly 15 pts in Part 2.

115學測 statistics:
- 報名 121,535.
- 選考: 數A 92,951 (76.48%), 數B 101,718 (83.69%).
- 五標: 數A 12/10/8/5/4 (114 均標 6; 113 均標 7); 數B 11/9/5/3/2, every standard down 1 from 114.
- 46.09% of candidates took all 6 subjects.

選才電子報 351期 (115-04-15), 115數A 試題特色 by 鍾世勳: 115 is 108課綱正式實施後的第五屆, so 116 is the sixth by inference. Content is spread roughly evenly over 高一 and 高二 A類.
P values: Q1 = 84%; Q5 = 26%; Q9 (T分數) = 44%; Q12 (三次函數對稱中心) = 28%; Q13 (貝氏) = 73%; Q14 (直線法向量) = 19%; Q17 (正弦定理＋倍角) = 6%; Q20 = 2%.

選才電子報 351期, 115數B 試題特色 by 鄭凱鐘:
- Q4 (緯線航行): P=44%.
- Q7 (福袋條件機率): P=37%.
- Q11 (燈罩 cone section; two different-sized lamp shades used to expose misconceptions): P=26%.
- Q17 (單點透視法與空間概念): P=3%.
- 混合題: 星軌 (lines, circles, vectors).

Earlier 試題特色 P values:
- 113數A: Q16 = 8%, Q17 = 5%; about a quarter of the paper is 素養 contexts (藥物殘留, 砲彈, 物種迴歸); lighter computation; fewer figures.
- 113數B: Q7 = 15%, Q11 = 31%, Q16 = 15%.
- 114數A: Q12 = 22%, Q15 = 16%, Q16 = 18%, Q17 = 14%; 混合題 built on 矩陣的應用; items linked to 國中 (Q1, 2, 7, 9, 13).
- 114數B: Q5 = 30%, Q7 = 23%, Q15 = 25%, Q17 = 11%; UVI 混合題; two diagrams and three data tables.
- 112數A: Q12 疊合 = 21%; 混合題 figure reprinted on the answer sheet.
- 112數B: Q7 = 30%, Q16 = 16%; 混合題 used 單點透視.

111 數A 評分原則說明 lists these common errors:
- Q19: misplaced scan-rod endpoints or length; open region boundaries; rod assumed horizontal; polar coordinates written in rectangular form, or radius and angle swapped.
- Q20: regions judged by eye to be triangles (D1); sector-area formula wrong (D2); wrong decomposition (D4); assuming one area is twice another by symmetry (D6).
111 數B Q19–20 errors include comparing sine values without citing that sine is strictly increasing, and wrongly linking tower height, offset and sine.

verification.exam_format_verified:
**116學年度學測 數學A / 數學B**
- 數A and 數B are separate subjects that students choose freely.
- 數A: Fri 116-01-22, 09:20–11:00. 數B: Sun 116-01-24, 09:20–11:00.
- Each paper is 100 minutes and scored out of 100.
- The 116 papers are not yet published. The structure below is taken from the official 111–115 papers, all ten of which were checked.

**第壹部分 選擇（填）題, 85 pts**
- 數A: 單選 Q1–6 (5 each, 30), 多選 Q7–12 (5 each, 30), 選填 Q13–17 (5 each, 25).
- 數B: 單選 Q1–7 (35), 多選 Q8–12 (25), 選填 Q13–17 (25).

**第貳部分 混合題或非選擇題, 15 pts**
- One 題組, Q18–20, on every paper from 111 to 115.
- Sub-item points vary by year:
  - 數A: 3+6+6 in 111, 112 and 114; 3+4+8 in 113 and 115.
  - 數B: 5(單選)+4+6 in 111; 3(選填)+6+6 in 112; 3+4+8 in 113; 3+6+6 in 114 and 115.
- Official framework (考試說明 108年9月): Part 1 is about 80–85% and Part 2 about 15–20%. CEEC planned to start at the lower bound and rise gradually; through 115 it stayed at 15.

**Scoring (116簡章)**
- 單選: all or nothing.
- 多選 with n options and k wrong selections: (n−2k)/n of the item's points, floored at 0; blank earns 0.
- 選填: every blank in the item must be correct; no negative marking; answers are bubbled digit by digit, including '−'.
- 非選擇: graded on the reasoning chain (115 數A 評分原則).
  - Full marks need correct reasoning, a detailed process and the correct answer.
  - Correct reasoning that misses the final answer gets partial credit.
  - No process, wrong inference, or data that contradicts the problem gets 0.
  - Item rubrics can give partial credit for specific steps.
- 級分: L = (average raw score of the top 1% of 到考 candidates) / 15, with a maximum of 15 級分.

**Answering**
- 選擇(填) items and 作圖 parts: 2B pencil, no correction tape.
- Other 非選 items: thick black ink pen, 由左而右橫式書寫 (written horizontally, left to right), and calculation or reasons must be shown.

**Formula sheet**
- Every paper ends with 參考公式及可能用到的數值.
- 115 數A sheet:
  - arithmetic and geometric series sums
  - 三角函數和角公式 for sin, cos and tan
  - 正弦定理 (=2R) and 餘弦定理
  - 1-D mean and standard deviation
  - correlation coefficient r and 迴歸直線（最適合直線）
  - √2≈1.414, √3≈1.732, √5≈2.236, √6≈2.449, π≈3.142
  - log2=0.3010, log3=0.4771, log5=0.6990, log7=0.8451
- 數B sheet: the same without the 和角公式.

**Tools**
- Calculators may not be brought to the seat.
- Allowed: 2B pencil, eraser, black pen, correction tape or fluid, ruler, set square, protractor and compass. Rulers may carry only measuring scales and numbers, plus a brand logo.

verification.notes:
**Method**
- I read every primary document directly by fetching the official PDFs and extracting their text locally (read-only):
  - the NAER 數學領綱 PDF
  - the CEEC 學測數學 考試說明 (108年9月)
  - the 116簡章
  - all ten official 數A and 數B papers for 111–115
  - the 115 數A 評分原則
  - the 115 statistics deck
  - the 111學測簡介 slides
  - the 大考命題方向說明 (110.04.01)
  - six 選才電子報 試題特色 articles
  - two 評分原則說明 pages
- The web-search budget for this run was already used up, so I could not run any new Traditional Chinese searches. Everything was checked by fetching known or official URLs, including CEEC's 歷屆試題 listing pages to find the 111–114 paper links.

**Bottom line**
- The report is accurate on curriculum codes, titles, 備註, markings, scope, dates, scoring, tools and formula sheets. I found no invented codes.
- Every 國小 and 國中 code it cites exists, and the ones I spot-read match their stated content.
- Main corrections:
  - 選考 vs 到考 counts.
  - The 混合題 sub-item mix is not uniform.
  - A-10-1 should come before N-10-3.
  - G-10-3 covers only the standard form.
  - Σ notation is a 12年級 topic.
  - F-11A-3 should come after conditional probability.
  - A few missing depends_on links.

**Recommendations for the course site**
- Treat ★＃ items (N-10-5, N-10-7, D-10-1) as short toolbox interludes.
- Label the ※ items (cot/sec/csc; Cauchy → correlation range) 'beyond 學測'.
- Branch into 11A and 11B paths after the shared 23-item 10年級 core.
- Teach students to use the formula sheet. The 數A and 數B sheets differ only by the 和角公式.
- Model a 'show your reasoning' habit for 非選 items.
- Many 學習內容 mention calculator keys, but the exam bans calculators and supplies √ and log values. 115數B Q2 even mentions a calculator 'ln' key while computing nothing with it. Teach estimation with the given values.
- Before reusing CEEC items, get permission:
  - The 考試說明 notice allows non-profit use with attribution; commercial use needs written consent.
  - The slide notices also require written consent for large-scale copying.

research.subject: 物理 Physics (學測自然考科 — 116學年度學科能力測驗)
research.scope_summary: The 116學年度學測 (exam dates 116/1/22–1/24, i.e. 22–24 Jan 2027; 自然 is on Fri 1/22, 12:50–14:40, 110 min) tests 自然 on 必修物理、必修化學、必修生物、必修地球科學 (含探究與實作). The four subjects are weighted roughly equally ("以占分比例相當為原則"). Physics is therefore about 1/4 of the paper: about 32 of 128 points, if 111–115 practice holds. In 115 that was 14 physics questions. Physics scope = 108課綱 (自然科學領域課綱, 107年11月) 第五學習階段 部定必修物理. It is 32 學習內容 items coded P□□-Ⅴc-n across 11 次主題: Ba, Bb, Ea, Eb, Ka, Kb, Kc, Kd, Ke, Mc, Nc. The 課綱 designs it as a story-driven, mostly qualitative "十年級基礎物理" for all students, with about 31 reference periods, plus cross-subject 探究與實作. All 10 學分 of 加深加廣選修物理 are NOT in 學測; the 116 簡章 lists them only under 分科測驗物理. These are 力學一, 力學二與熱學, 波動、光及聲音, 電磁現象一, 電磁現象二與量子現象. The 自然考試說明 also says items may draw on 國中 knowledge (not as the main focus), so 國中理化 bridging is required. The unit order below is a dependency-based teaching order built from the 課綱's own cross-references. The printed code order is B→E→K→M→N, and the 課綱 states its sequence is only a suggestion.
research.exam_format: 學測自然考科, 110 minutes (116: 1/22 Fri, 12:50–14:40). Per 考試說明 (111學年度起適用, 108年9月): 第壹部分 is multiple choice (單選+多選), about 32–36 items. 第貳部分 is 混合題型 or 非選擇題, about 6 題組. Choice items carry about 70–80% of points and non-choice about 20–30%. Recent papers (111–115) total 128 points. The 115 paper had 36 Part-1 items × 2 pts = 72, plus 6 Part-2 groups = 56 (12 choice items for 24 pts and 8 written items for 32 pts). Each subject gets 9 Part-1 items. Part 2 mixes single-subject groups with 1–2 cross-subject groups; physics has been paired with biology (111, 113), earth science (112, 115) and chemistry (114). Multi-select scoring per 116 簡章: with n options and k wrong, the item scores (n−2k)/n of its points, floored at 0. Results are reported in 級分, max 15 (60 when used for 分發入學採計). Non-choice answers are graded on reasoning as well as the answer. Bare answers without reasoning have scored 0 (115 Q53). Drawing items (waveforms, ray diagrams, I–t graphs, data plots) increased in 115. The 116 paper's total points and item count are not yet published.

key_facts.claim: Much of 必修物理 is qualitative by design. Newton's laws are taught without formula derivation or calculation. Inverse-square gravity and Coulomb force are introduced without derivation, using only single-charge fields. Wave and light topics derive no formulas. The photoelectric effect involves no mathematical derivation. Energy conversions avoid quantitative derivation. Snell's law is still treated quantitatively by a diagram method.

recent_trends.trend: Physics share is steady at about 1/4 of 自然. Each year has 9 single-subject Part-1 items, one physics 題組 in Part 2, and usually one cross-subject 題組 that includes physics. Physics has been paired with biology (111, 113), earth science (112, 115) and chemistry (114). 115 counted 14 physics questions.

Contexts come from real science news and technology: the new SI mass definition and Kibble balance (111), coal reduction and hydropower (112), radiation therapy and the Venus flytrap (113), bitcoin energy use, wireless charging, the 2024 Nobel Prize and TiO2 photocatalysts (114), and the 2019 Nobel Prize with Doppler, small modular reactors, and semiconductor chip processes (115).

探究與實作 is examined directly: identifying suitable variables (112 Q38–39), filling a research-question and variable table with predicted results (113 Q43, framed as 研究與規劃), and reproducing an experiment from data (111 Q58–60).
Electromagnetic induction is a recurring free-response topic. 113 Q44–46 asked for an I–t sketch plus a Lenz explanation; 115 Q53 asked for current direction, magnitude reasoning and data plotting.

Drawing and expression tasks are growing. 115 had more drawing than usual: a reflected-wave waveform, refracted-ray direction, and an electric-field and position diagram. 114 added curve drawing and a new matching format. 112 Q40 asked for symbolic expressions.

Calculation is light but present. 113 had only Q25 and Q27 needing simple calculation. 112 used dimensional analysis. 115 Q18 (fission energy estimate) was hard (P = 21%). Most physics items stress reading, graph interpretation and reasoning over heavy computation.

Graph and data reading is central to physics items: dose–depth curves (113 Q22–23), 114 Q49, and quasi-periodic blood-flow curves (111). CEEC advice is to find the physical meaning in graphs and to link theory with experimental evidence.

Modern-physics content (Kd and Ke) is examined regularly: electron double-slit (114 Q25, P = 74%; 112 Q31), strong vs weak interaction in uranium decay (112 Q52), and passages using band terms beyond the syllabus, which CEEC suggests bridging through energy levels (114 Q50–54).
Doppler effect recurs: 111 (blood flow, physics/biology), 112 Q32 (blood-flow rate), and 115 Q13 (2019 Nobel Prize context).

common_misconceptions.misconception: A moving object must have a force acting on it in its direction of motion (impetus). About 80% of Taiwanese 國中–高中 students in a survey held this.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Without a net force, an object keeps constant velocity (Newton's 1st law, PEb-Ⅴc-4 / Eb-Ⅳ-10). A net force changes velocity; it does not sustain it.

common_misconceptions.misconception: An object resting on a horizontal surface always experiences friction (about 40%), and friction always equals the maximum static friction (about 70%).
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Static friction only arises against a tendency to slide, and it adjusts in size up to a maximum. With no horizontal push it is zero.

common_misconceptions.misconception: To push a resting object you must overcome its weight (gravity) as well as friction.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Weight is vertical and balanced by the normal force. A horizontal push only needs to exceed the maximum static friction (PEb-Ⅴc-5 normal force and friction).

common_misconceptions.misconception: Friction exists whenever surfaces touch, equals the object's weight, grows with contact area (or with smaller area), or grows with speed. 國中 students showed these.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: These were identified as misconceptions in the study. Teach which factors affect friction through experiment (國中 Eb-Ⅳ-4: static vs kinetic friction differ), and do not assume area or speed dependence.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Action-reaction confusion, plus mixing up velocity and acceleration.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: An action-reaction pair acts on two different bodies; name the exerting body and the receiving body for each force (PEb-Ⅴc-4 說明). Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, not velocity itself.

common_misconceptions.misconception: The net force sets the direction of motion, and the 'resultant' is an extra force of its own. Normal force, friction and air resistance get misdirected or omitted in free-body diagrams.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Net force sets the direction of acceleration (change in velocity). The resultant is the vector sum, not an additional force. Draw each contact force from its physical origin.

common_misconceptions.misconception: In induction answers, naming 'Faraday's law and Lenz's law' or writing just 'I < 0' is treated as an explanation (115 Q53). Others assume the larger current is where the magnet is slower.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Explain that the induced current's field opposes the change in flux. A faster-moving magnet gives a larger rate of flux change, so a larger induced current.

common_misconceptions.misconception: When a magnet leaves a coil, the induced-current curve is drawn as a copy or a mirror of the entering curve, or its peak time is misplaced (113 Q46).
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The flux change reverses as the magnet leaves, so the current sign reverses (Lenz). Constant speed gives a symmetric shape, with the peak timed to the actual pole position.

common_misconceptions.misconception: A refracted ray is drawn bending to the wrong side of the normal, and an attenuated reflected wave is drawn with equal or larger amplitude (115 Q49).
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Entering a medium where light is slower, the ray bends toward the normal (wave-speed explanation of Snell's law, PKa-Ⅴc-4). A partially reflected wave has smaller amplitude.

common_misconceptions.misconception: In experiment design, the manipulated variable is written as 'time' instead of 'time interval', and predictions are written as events ('leaves cannot close') rather than relationships between quantities (113 Q43).
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Specify variables precisely and state predicted results as a relationship between the manipulated and responding variables.

common_misconceptions.misconception: When asked for an expression, students substitute numbers instead of using the given symbols, or produce expressions with wrong dimensions (adding unlike quantities, missing a factor) (112 Q40).
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Use the symbols defined in the question, and check that the result has the dimensions of the requested quantity (energy, mass).

common_misconceptions.misconception: Writing only 'α decay' or 'β decay', or only one equation, when the full decay equations are required (112 Q52).
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: α emission involves the strong interaction and β decay the weak interaction (PKe-Ⅴc-1~2). Write every required decay equation in the requested table format.

pedagogy_notes: The unit order is a dependency-based teaching sequence, not the printed code order (B→E→K→M→N). It follows the 課綱's own cross-references: Newton's third law 'echoes the previous chapter's basic interactions', so Ke comes before Eb. The electron double-slit is 'the same as Young's experiment', so Ka comes before Kd. EM fields carry energy (PBa-Ⅴc-1), so Kc comes before Ba. The 課綱 states its sequence is only a suggestion.

The 課綱 frames 必修物理 as the story of how physicists developed ideas, built on two axes, energy and scale. This fits the user's OSTEP-style professor–student dialogue well: e.g. Aristotle → Galileo → Kepler → Newton, and corpuscle vs wave → Maxwell → photon → wave-particle duality.

Note the narrative arc for light: wave basics → light as a wave → EM unification → 'light is an EM wave' → photoelectric effect shows it is also a particle → electrons are waves too. Each step resolves a question raised by the previous one, so no topic appears from nowhere.

The 課綱 says many items need no formulas, but 學測 still asks for estimation, unit conversion, dimensional checks and symbolic expressions (112 Q40, 113 Q25 and Q27, 115 Q18). Add a light 'quantitative toolkit' strand (scientific notation, ratios, dimensions) even though the 學習內容 are qualitative.

Free-response grading rewards stated reasoning. Bare conclusions scored 0 (115 Q53), and naming a law without applying it lost credit. Each lesson should include 'explain why' practice with model answers that state the causal chain.
Drawing is increasingly examined: waveforms with phase and amplitude, ray diagrams, I–t sketches, plotting data in quadrants. Interactive drawing and plotting widgets would map directly to the exam.
Teach Lenz's law qualitatively inside the induction unit. CEEC scoring guides (113, 115) expect it even though 必修 text only says qualitative Faraday.

Teach energy levels well enough that learners can read unfamiliar contexts. CEEC notes the 114 band-theory passage can be bridged from energy levels. Practise reading passages that contain off-syllabus terms.
Integrate 探究與實作 skills into every unit: identify manipulated, controlled and responding variables, state predictions as relationships, read graphs for physical meaning. These appear yearly.

The 考試說明 says 國中 knowledge may be needed. Geometric optics (113 Q21) and static equilibrium (112 Q36) appeared, so bridging modules from 國中理化 (Ea, Eb, Ka, Kc, Ba, Bb) are essential for zero-prerequisite learners.

Mark elective-only content clearly in the UI (e.g. a 'not in 學測' badge), so learners do not over-study. Examples: kinematic equations and projectile motion (PEb-Ⅴa), momentum and work–energy theorem (PEb/PBa-Ⅴa), PV = nRT (PBb-Ⅴa), lens formula and standing waves (PKa-Ⅴa), electric potential and circuits (PKc-Ⅴa), Bohr model and de Broglie (PKd-Ⅴa).

The 課綱 itself stresses some correct ideas that are good targets for misconception checks: photoelectron emission depends on frequency, not intensity (Kd 說明); mass and weight are different quantities (國中 Kb-Ⅳ-1).

The 課綱 demonstration experiments (mechanical-energy conservation, double-slit, magnetic effect of current, EM induction) can be paired with PhET-style simulations. Specific PhET sim titles and their licence dates still need verification before embedding.
When displaying codes, use the 課綱 form with Roman Ⅴ (e.g. PKc-Ⅴc-3) and accept the ASCII variant (PKc-Vc-3) used in CEEC documents for search and linking.
open_questions: The 116學測 自然 paper's total score and item count are not yet published. 128 points and the 36 + 6-group structure come from 111–115 practice; per the 簡章, scoring follows each paper's own rules.
The CEEC 考試說明 page (updated 113.07.29) shows no newer 自然考科 version than 108年9月 '111學年度起適用'. This research did not check whether CEEC plans a revision affecting 116.
Textbook chapter order and titles for 108課綱 必修物理 (翰林/南一/龍騰 '物理 全一冊') were not verified. The unit order here is derived from 課綱 cross-references only.
Whether 必修物理 is taught in grade 10 or 11 depends on the school. The 課綱 calls it '十年級基礎物理', and the 2–4 學分 range includes a share of 探究與實作. The exact physics-only credit at a given school is unknown.
Math bridging codes (數學領域 課綱 codes for scientific notation, proportion, functions and graphs, trigonometric ratios) were not retrieved. A math-curriculum source is needed before adding codes.
Whether Snell's law in 必修 needs sine (trigonometric ratios from 10th-grade math) or only a diagram/ratio method is not settled. The 課綱 says '以圖示法定量說明'.
English equivalents for many terms are not yet verified against the 樂詞網 物理 categories; only 12 were checked.
The 114 學測 自然 非選擇題評分原則 article is published as images. Its physics common-error notes were not extracted.
Full per-item P/D statistics (選擇題答題分析) for all physics items 111–115 were not retrieved; only selected values quoted in CEEC 試題特色 articles.

Taiwanese research on misconceptions in circuits, waves, optics and quantum/photoelectric topics was not retrieved because the web-search budget ran out. The current misconception list covers mechanics plus CEEC-reported answer errors.
The 111學測 physics item count (one secondary source cites 15 of 60) was not verified from an opened source.
Reuse and licence terms for CEEC past papers, the NAER curriculum documents, and 樂詞網 data were not confirmed. This matters if the website reproduces items verbatim.

verification.subject: 物理 Physics (學測自然考科 — 116學年度學科能力測驗)
verification.corrected_scope_summary:
The 116學年度學測 runs 116/1/22 (Fri) to 1/24 (Sun), i.e. 22–24 Jan 2027. 自然 is on 1/22, 12:50–14:40, 110 minutes. Registration ran 115/10/27–11/10. Per the 116 簡章 (p.4, 註3), 自然 covers 必修物理、必修化學、必修生物、必修地球科學 (含探究與實作). The four subjects follow 以占分比例相當為原則, so physics is roughly a quarter of the paper. The 115 paper had 14 physics questions. The 32-of-128-points figure is an estimate and is not stated by CEEC.

Physics scope is the 108課綱 自然科學領域 (中華民國107年11月) 第五學習階段 部定必修物理. It has 49 學習內容 items, not 32, coded P□□-Ⅴc-n across 11 次主題: Ba4, Bb4, Ea3, Eb5, Ka7, Kb2, Kc6, Kd7, Ke3, Mc4, Nc4. Reference periods total 31 節. The 課綱 calls it 十年級基礎物理, designed for 不分組、全領域學生 and built on two axes, 能量 and 尺度. It is story-driven and largely qualitative, and the 課綱 says its order 只是一個建議. 探究與實作 is cross-subject, takes one third of the 12 部定必修 credits, and has four strands (發現問題、規劃與研究、論證與建模、表達與分享) with no alphanumeric codes.

All five 加深加廣選修物理 courses are excluded from 學測 and appear only in 分科測驗物理 (簡章 p.9): 力學一、力學二與熱學、波動、光及聲音、電磁現象一、電磁現象二與量子現象. The 考試說明 (108年9月, 111學年度起適用) says items may draw on 國中 knowledge, though it is not the design focus, so 國中理化 bridging is needed. The exam also tests some skills that are not 必修 學習內容 text:
- Lenz's-law reasoning. 冷次 does not appear anywhere in the 課綱, but the 113 Q46 and 115 Q53 scoring guides require it.
- Dimensional reasoning. Formally this is elective 力學一 (PEa-Va-1 說明), but the 112 Q37–40 group was framed by 因次分析 and Q40 required symbolic expressions.

confirmed_facts.claim: The 116學測 runs 116/1/22 (Fri) to 1/24 (Sun). 自然 is on 1/22, 12:50–14:40; 社會 and 自然 are 110 minutes each. Registration ran 115/10/27–11/10. Scores use a 15-級分 scale, max 60 級分 when used for 分發入學採計 (press release 115.10.23).
116 簡章 p.4: 自然 = 必修物理、必修化學、必修生物、必修地球科學（含探究與實作）, based on the 108課綱. 註3 says the four subjects follow 以占分比例相當為原則 and include 探究與實作 學習內容.
116 簡章 p.9: 分科測驗物理 = 必修物理 + 力學一、力學二與熱學、波動、光及聲音、電磁現象一、電磁現象二與量子現象, including 探究與實作. Multi-select scoring: k wrong options out of n gives (n−2k)/n of the points, with a floor of 0.

自然考試說明 (中華民國108年9月, 111學年度起適用):
- Scope is 部定必修12學分, each subject 2–4 學分, 含探究與實作.
- 國中 content may be involved but is not the main design focus (國中與普通高中階段之課程難以切割).
- Part 1 is about 32–36 choice items; Part 2 is about 6 題組.
- Choice items carry about 70–80% of points, non-choice about 20–30%.
- There are five 測驗目標 categories: 1a–1d, 2a–2c, 3a–3d, 4a–4d, 5a–5c.

考試說明 physics examples and their tags:
- Induction cooker: PKc-Vc-3 + PMc-Vc-2.
- 夢溪筆談 lightning and point discharge: PKc-Vc-4 + PMc-Vc-1.
- Iridescent cut meat (interference): PKa-Vc-5, with PMc-Vc-3 on Q4.
- Part 2 measurement items: PEa-Vc-1/PEa-Vc-2.

108 自然領綱 is dated 中華民國一○七年十一月.
- 普高 部定必修 totals 12 學分, with 物理/化學/生物/地科 at 2–4 each and 三分之一 跨科目主題式探究與實作.
- 加深加廣 totals 32 學分; 選修物理 is 10 學分 across five 2-學分 courses.

verification.exam_format_verified:
The 學測自然考科 is 110 minutes; in 116 it is on Fri 1/22, 12:50–14:40. The 考試說明 (108年9月, 111學年度起適用) sets two parts:
- 第壹部分: choice items (單選 and 多選), about 32–36.
- 第貳部分: 混合題型 or 非選擇題, about 6 題組.
- Choice items carry about 70–80% of points and non-choice items about 20–30%.

Every paper from 111 to 115 totalled 128 points: Part 1 had 36 items × 2 = 72, in four 9-item subject blocks, and Part 2 had 6 groups worth 56. Part 2 composition was 16 choice + 8 non-choice in 111 and 12 choice + 8 non-choice in 115. The per-type point split was not stated. Cross-subject groups that included physics were:
- with biology in 111 (Q49–54) and 113 (Q40–43);
- with earth science in 112 (Q51–54) and 115 (Q50–53);
- with chemistry in 114 (Q50–54).

Scoring rules per the 116 簡章:
- Multi-select: (n−2k)/n of the item's points, floored at 0.
- Single-select: wrong answers or multiple marks score 0.
- Scores are reported in 級分, max 15 per subject, or max 60 when used for 分發入學採計.
- 簡章 rule: each paper's own instructions set its scoring and full marks, so the 116 total is not yet known.

CEEC scoring guides confirm that reasoning is graded: bare answers such as '115 Q53 I<0' scored 0. Drawing items increased in 115, and 114 introduced curve drawing and a matching format.

verification.notes:
Method and limits. The WebSearch budget was already exhausted when this run started, so no new Traditional-Chinese searches were possible. All checks used direct WebFetch of the primary documents the report cites. Files fetched as binaries were parsed in memory and read-only: the NAER 課綱 ODT content.xml, the CEEC 簡章 and 考試說明 PDFs, and the 116 press release PDF. Every 必修物理 code (49) and elective code was enumerated from the 課綱 text itself.

Overall, the report is accurate on codes, item text, reference periods, exam dates and scope. The main errors:
- It says 32 items instead of 49.
- It overstates how consistently codes are printed.
- It misdescribes 111 Part 2 as having no choice items, and uses 'Kibble balance' where CEEC says 電磁天平.
- It ignores the 課綱 instruction not to make PMc-Ⅴc-4 a separate unit.
- Some ordering is weak: PKc-Ⅴc-2 came before Coulomb's law, light Doppler comes before light-as-wave, and elective depends_on were incomplete.
- A few examples rest on inference, such as the 115 Q18 attribution and the 112 Q29 'pressure' example.

Pedagogical flags for the course:
- Lenz's law and dimensional analysis are exam-expected but not 必修 學習內容 text; tag them in the UI as exam skills.
- The 課綱 itself supports teaching Ke before Eb, since the Eb 說明 refers back to 前章節基本作用交互.
- The 考試說明 cover allows non-profit reuse with attribution; commercial use needs CEEC's written consent. This matters if the site reproduces items.

research.subject: 化學 Chemistry, as tested in the 學測 自然考科 (116學年度 GSAT, sitting 116/1/22, i.e. 2027-01-22)
research.scope_summary:
The 116學年度學測 is confirmed by the CEEC 116學年度考試簡章 (初版 115/8/4). It runs 116/1/22 (Fri) to 1/24 (Sun). 自然 is on 1/22 in the afternoon, 12:50–14:40, 110 minutes. The 自然 scope follows the 108課綱: 必修物理、必修化學、必修生物、必修地球科學（含探究與實作）. The 簡章 says the four subjects should carry roughly equal points ("以占分比例相當為原則"). The 學測 table lists no 部定加深加廣選修. Those courses appear only in the 分科測驗 化學 scope: 物質與能量、物質構造與反應速率、化學反應與平衡一、化學反應與平衡二、有機化學與應用科技 (2 學分 each, 10 學分 in total). So all 加深加廣選修化學 is outside the 學測.

Credits: the 自然領綱 (教育部 107年11月) sets 普通型高中 自然 部定必修 at 12 學分. One-third of that must be cross-subject 探究與實作. 化學 is listed at 2–4 學分. The 附錄四 參考節數 for 必修化學 add up to 32 class periods (my sum), which fits a roughly 2-學分 course.

Exam weight: chemistry is about 1/4 of 自然. 翰林's analyses count 32 of 128 points every year from 112 to 115 (14–15 questions). The CEEC 考試說明 (111學年度起適用, 108年9月) also says 學測 items may use 國中 content as background knowledge. That justifies a 國中 理化 bridge for beginners.

The 必修化學 syllabus has 18 次主題 groups, coded CAa…CNc-Vc-n: composition and periodicity, states and classification, energy, separation, bonding, gases, reaction laws and stoichiometry, aqueous solutions, redox, acids and bases, rate and equilibrium, organic and biomolecules and surfactants, STS/history/applications, environment, and sustainability/energy. The 課綱 explicitly lets textbooks reorder chapters.
research.exam_format:
Format of the 學測 自然考科. The 116 sitting is 2027-01-22 (116/1/22), 12:50–14:40, 110 minutes.

Format rules (CEEC 考試說明, 111學年度起適用):
- 第壹部分 is multiple choice (單選 and 多選), about 32–36 questions.
- 第貳部分 is 混合題 or 非選擇題, about 6 題組.
- Multiple choice carries about 70–80% of the points; written answers about 20–30%.

Multi-select scoring: an item with n options and k wrong answers earns (n−2k)/n of its points, floored at 0 (簡章).

The actual 115 paper:
- 第壹部分: questions 1–36, 2 points each, 72 points.
- 第貳部分: 6 題組 (Q37–56), 56 points.
- Total 128 points, 19 pages.

Chemistry share (翰林 analysis of the 115 paper):
- 14 questions, 32 points in total.
- 第壹部分: 5 單選 (10 points) and 4 多選 (8 points).
- 第貳部分: 1 單選 (2), 2 多選 (4), and written sub-items worth 8.
- One 題組 was chemistry–biology cross-subject; one was a pure-chemistry 探究與實作 set.

Written items usually ask for a short answer, a chemical formula or equation, or a calculation. Partial credit is given for a correct setup (CEEC 評分原則 practice).

key_facts.claim: Taiwan chemical naming rules come from 化學命名原則（第四版）, published by 國立編譯館 in 2009/11 and hosted on the NAER 樂詞網. They follow IUPAC with Chinese adaptation. Each element name is one character: 气 radical for gases, 氵 for liquids, 金 for solid metals, 石 for solid nonmetals. Binary compounds put the more electronegative element first with 化 (e.g. 氯化鈉). Variable-valence ions use Roman numerals, e.g. 鐵(III)離子. 過/亞/次 prefixes mark oxidation states (過氯酸, 亞氯酸, 次氯酸).
key_facts.source_name: 國立編譯館/國家教育研究院 化學命名原則 第四版

key_facts.claim: NAER's chemical-element open dataset includes the newest element names: 113 鉨 (Nh), 114 鈇 (Fl), 115 鏌 (Mc), 116 鉝 (Lv), 117 Ts (石+田), 118 Og (气+奧). Si is 矽 in Taiwan.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 物質的粒子模型與三態、溫度對狀態的影響
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Particle model of matter, the three states, effect of temperature
bridging_prereqs.level: 國中（第四學習階段 7–9年級）
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed before phase diagrams (CAb-Vc-1) and gas pressure from molecular collisions (CEc-Vc-1).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 物理性質與化學性質；純物質與混合物；元素與化合物
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Physical vs chemical properties; pure substances vs mixtures; elements vs compounds
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Classification vocabulary used from the first 高中 unit onward.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 混合物分離（結晶、過濾、簡易濾紙色層分析）與以化學性質鑑定
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Separating mixtures (crystallization, filtration, simple paper chromatography); identifying compounds
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: 高中 CCa-Vc-1 adds distillation, extraction and TLC. 國中 teaches technique without the theory of chromatography.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 原子模型的發展；分子與原子；同素異形體、同分異構物初探
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Atomic models; atoms vs molecules; first look at allotropes and isomers
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Background for Dalton's theory (CAa-Vc-2), valence electrons (CAa-Vc-3) and network solids/carbon allotropes (CCb-Vc-2).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 原子量與分子量（相對質量）；莫耳僅名詞
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Atomic and molecular weight as relative masses; mole as a term only
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: 國中 does no Avogadro or mole calculations, so 高中 CJa-Vc-3 is a learner's first mole calculation. The course must teach mole conversions from scratch.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 元素的規律性與週期性；元素符號與化合物命名簡則
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Periodicity of elements; element symbols and simple naming rules
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: 國中 does not require memorizing the periodic table. 高中 CAa-Vc-3 uses valence electrons for Z=1–18, and naming follows 化學命名原則.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 化學反應：質量守恆、原子重新排列、反應現象、反應式表示法
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Reactions: mass conservation, rearranging atoms, observable signs, writing equations
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Directly underlies CJa-Vc-1/2 (balancing) and stoichiometry.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 能量形式與轉換；化學反應吸放熱；熱量單位
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Forms of energy; heat absorbed or released in reactions; heat units
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed for energy diagrams and thermochemical equations (CBa-Vc-1/2).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 電解質與離子；溶液與重量百分濃度、ppm
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Electrolytes and ions; solutions, mass percent and ppm
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Base for molarity (CJb-Vc-3), strong/weak electrolytes (CJd-Vc-4) and ionic compounds. 國中 does no dilution calculations.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 酸鹼鹽：氧化物酸鹼性、pH 定性、指示劑、中和
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Acids, bases, salts: oxide acidity, qualitative pH, indicators, neutralization
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: 高中 adds the Arrhenius definition and pH = −log[H+]. 國中 pH involves no calculation.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 氧化還原（狹義：得氧／失氧）、燃燒、電池與電解
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Narrow redox (gain or loss of oxygen), combustion, cells and electrolysis
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: 高中 CJc-Vc-1 replaces the oxygen definition with the electron-transfer definition. The course must bridge the two explicitly.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 反應速率與影響因素、可逆反應、化學平衡（定性）
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Reaction rate factors, reversible reactions, equilibrium (qualitative)
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Background for CJe-Vc-1 (dissolution equilibrium) and CJe-Vc-2 (surface area and rate).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 有機化合物：烷、醇、有機酸、酯；酯化與皂化；塑膠
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Organic basics: alkanes, alcohols, organic acids, esters; esterification and saponification; plastics
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed for biomolecules and surfactants (CJf-Vc-1~3). Soap structure builds on saponification.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 測量：基本與衍伸物理量、尺度（奈米到光年、毫升到立方公尺）
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Measurement: base and derived quantities, scales and unit conversion
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Unit conversion (mL↔L, g↔kg) for molarity and stoichiometry; the nanoscale for CMc-Vc-3.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 氣體壓力（大氣壓力；定溫下壓力與體積定性關係）
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Gas pressure (atmospheric pressure; qualitative pressure–volume link)
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed for CEc-Vc-1 and for reading phase-diagram pressure axes.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 環境與能源（空氣汙染、溫室氣體、化石燃料、新興能源）
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Environment and energy (air pollution, greenhouse gases, fossil fuels, emerging energy)
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Context for CMe and CNc units.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 比與比值、單位換算（大單位到小單位）、基準量與比較量
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Ratio and rate, unit conversion, base vs compared quantity
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Proportional reasoning for mole ratios and concentration.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 指數、指數律、科學記號（含負次方）
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Exponents, exponent laws, scientific notation (including negative powers)
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed for Avogadro's number, Kw = 1.00×10^-14 and [H+] values.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 比與比例式、正比、反比
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Proportions, direct and inverse proportion
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Core of stoichiometry and dilution reasoning.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 一元一次方程式；二元一次聯立方程式
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Linear equations; systems of two linear equations
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: The algebraic (代數法) way of balancing equations named in CJa-Vc-2.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 科學記號運算；常用對數 log
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Calculating with scientific notation; common logarithms
bridging_prereqs.level: 高一（10年級數學，與化學同步）
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: pH = −log[H+] (CJd-Vc-3) needs log. If math class has not reached it yet, the course should teach a minimal version.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Risk carried over from 國中: oxidation means gaining oxygen and reduction means losing oxygen, so a reaction without oxygen cannot be redox.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: 國中 Jc-Ⅳ-1 gives the narrow oxygen definition. 高中 CJc-Vc-1 uses the broad definition: losing electrons is oxidation, gaining electrons is reduction. The course must explicitly upgrade the definition.
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: Seen in CEEC marking of 111 學測 Q57: some students named only 氧化反應 or only 還原反應 for a redox process. They got partial credit.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Oxidation and reduction happen together, so the full answer is 氧化還原（反應）. The oxidizing agent is reduced and the reducing agent is oxidized (CJc-Vc-2).

common_misconceptions.misconception: Seen in CEEC 111 Q57-2: balancing errors, such as a wrong coefficient on the iron ion or on products.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: A reaction only rearranges atoms and their number does not change. Every species' coefficient must make the atoms balance (CJa-Vc-2). Full credit required all six coefficients to be correct.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Design hypothesis: a 'strong' acid or base is the same as a concentrated one.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Strength means nearly 100% dissociation in water (CJd-Vc-4). Concentration is expressed separately as molarity (CJb-Vc-3).
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: Design hypothesis: atomic weight is the mass in grams of one atom.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Atomic and molecular weights are relative masses between atoms and molecules (Aa-Ⅳ-2). Grams enter only through the mole and molar mass (CJa-Vc-3).
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: Design hypothesis: [H+][OH−] = 1.00×10^-14 at any temperature.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The 課綱 states this constant for 25℃ specifically (CJd-Vc-1 說明).
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: Design hypothesis: isotopes are different elements, so they should have different element names.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Isotopes are the same element. Taiwan naming writes the element name plus the mass number (e.g. 鈾-235). Only hydrogen's isotopes have their own names: 氕, 氘, 氚.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Design hypothesis: NaCl is made of NaCl molecules, just as water is made of H2O molecules.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The 課綱 contrasts ionic compounds (NaCl, MgO) with molecular compounds (H2O, CO2). Their properties differ because their bonding differs (CAb-Vc-3, CCb-Vc-1/2).
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: Design hypothesis: colloids are just dilute solutions.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Solutions are classed by particle size into true solutions, colloids and suspensions. Colloids show the Tyndall effect (CJb-Vc-1 說明).
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

recent_trends.trend: 111 (first 108課綱 學測): total 自然 items fell from 68 to 60 and chemistry from 17 to 15. Chemistry had 10 chart items (7 素養, 2 探究與實作), 2 cross-subject items plus 1 cross-subject 題組, 3 current-events items and 2 advanced-technology items. Written chemistry items were Q38 and Q57.

112: 60 items overall; chemistry 15 items, 32 points. Chart items dominated (12, 80%). Only 1 探究與實作 item. Cross-chapter and cross-subject items rose to 6 each, mainly with biology. Topics leaned toward 生活化學, and one item reused the 國中 oxygen-preparation experiment.

113: total items dropped to 56; chemistry 14 items, still 32 points. More points moved to written answers, with more calculation. About 64% of chemistry was chart/data work. The 探究與實作 題組 grew to 4 items. There was a chemistry–earth-science cross-subject set. 翰林 rated it medium-to-hard.

114: 57 items overall; chemistry 15 items, 32 points. Less calculation, more basic items, and chart items fell from 9 to 7. Written items asked students to write formulas and equations (a fuel thermochemistry set), plus a chemistry–physics nano-photocatalyst set. 翰林 noted options touching content outside 必修, e.g. 再結晶, which the 課綱 says 必修 does not cover.

115: 56 items, 128 points, 19 pages. Chemistry had 14 items, 32 points, weighted toward bonding/structure and stoichiometry. Q25–27 were an inquiry set on extracting potassium salts from bananas (solubility). Q40–43 were a chemistry–biology cross-subject set. Q44–46 were built on the 2023 Nobel quantum-dot research (ZnS quantum dots, stoichiometry, Tyndall effect, green chemistry). Teacher groups judged chemistry relatively easy with no tedious calculation.

Across 111–115, chemistry stayed at about 1/4 of 自然 (32 of 128 points in 112–115), in line with the official equal-share rule. The steady features are chart reading, inquiry/experimental design, cross-subject 題組, and short written answers such as formulas, equations or simple calculations.

pedagogy_notes: Bridge from 國中 explicitly: the CEEC 考試說明 says 學測 items may assume 國中 content. Three gaps matter most: 國中 never calculates with the mole, pH or dilution (附錄四 notes on Aa-Ⅳ-2, Jd-Ⅳ-2, Jb-Ⅳ-4), and it defines redox by oxygen, not electrons.

Unit order: the 課綱 lets textbooks reorder chapters. The proposed sequence follows the 翰林 化學（全） chapter flow seen in its 115 analysis table. Ch1 物質的分類與組成 (1-1 分類分離狀態, 1-2 基本定律與莫耳, 1-3 原子結構與週期表, 1-4 化學鍵構造特性). Ch2 化學式與化學計量 (2-1 化學式與百分組成, 2-2 化學反應式, 2-3 化學計量, 2-4 能量變化). Ch3 溶液與常見的化學反應 (3-1 溶液, 3-2 溶解度, 3-3 酸鹼, 3-4 氧化還原). Ch4 生活化學 (4-1 有機物質, 4-2 科學與人文, 4-3 資源與永續). Matching 課綱 codes to sections is my own alignment by topic; 翰林 did not publish such a mapping.
Keep thermochemical equations (CBa) after balancing and the mole (CJa). The official 課綱 lists Ba before Ja, but writing thermochemical equations needs balanced equations.

Mark scope limits in the UI ('in 學測 scope' vs 'enrichment'). The 必修 limits are: valence electrons Z=1–18 only; isotopes C and H only; phase diagrams H2O and CO2 only; no lattice energy; no yield or gas-volume stoichiometry; no oxidation numbers or redox balancing; pH without complex calculation; no recrystallization. Teaching 'more' is fine if flagged: 翰林 notes 112 and 114 options touched 再結晶.

Time budget: 必修化學 參考節數 total about 32 periods. The heaviest blocks are classification/states, separation, bonding, reaction laws and stoichiometry, solutions, redox, and organics (3 periods each). Gases (0.5) and surface-area rate (0.3) are minor and should be folded into other units, as the 課綱 says.

Exam skills to drill every unit: read charts and data (more than half of 115 chemistry items used charts), design or critique experiments with variables, write formulas and equations by hand, and do simple-number stoichiometry with a written setup (partial credit for a correct setup).

Weave in the four 探究與實作 strands (發現問題, 規劃與研究, 論證與建模, 表達與分享) through virtual labs that match the 課綱 labs: ink distillation, pigment extraction and TLC, solubility curves, indicators, surfactant effects.

Terminology differences to handle in the language switch: the 課綱 writes 路易士結構 while the NAER school list writes 路易斯結構; 色層分析 (課綱) vs 層析術 (NAER); 鈍氣 (NAER school list) vs 惰性氣體/惰氣 (命名原則 2-4); Taiwan 矽, 莫耳, 鋞離子 vs mainland 硅, 摩尔, 水合氢离子. Use Taiwan terms in zh-TW and show the English term.

Naming hook for beginners: element-character radicals (气 gas, 氵 liquid, 金 metal, 石 solid nonmetal). In Chinese the more electronegative element comes first (氯化鈉), the reverse of English 'sodium chloride'. 過/亞/次 prefixes mark oxidation levels.
Cross-subject 題組 recur every year (with biology in 112 and 115, earth science in 113, physics in 114). Add short 'connection' boxes linking chemistry to the other 自然 subjects.
open_questions: Grade placement of 必修化學: the 課綱 fixes neither the year nor the exact 學分 split (化學 is listed 2–4 學分 inside a 12-學分 block that includes one-third 探究與實作). '10 (typical)' comes from publisher wording (高一課程) and the 2-學分-sized 參考節數, not from an official grade rule.
Will CEEC publish an updated 學測自然考科考試說明 before 116? The listing page (footer updated 115-11-12) still shows only the 111學年度起適用 edition from 108年9月, with no update date.

Official per-subject points: CEEC states only the equal-share rule. The 32-point chemistry figures for 112–115 come from 翰林 (secondary). Points for 111 chemistry were not confirmed (15 items, per 建中 teachers).

My web-search budget for this run ran out. Not checked: NAER 自然科學領域課程手冊 (e.g. https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/2025/自然科學領域課程手冊(定稿版).pdf), the 普通型高中 化學學科中心 resources, PubChem reuse terms, and textbook chapter layouts from other publishers (龍騰, 南一, 康熹).

verification.subject: 化學 Chemistry, as tested in the 116學年度學測 自然考科 (sitting 116/1/22 = 2027-01-22)
verification.exam_format_verified:
Verified against primary sources (CEEC 簡章 116, 考試說明 111起, 115 試卷, 111 評分原則).

Schedule:
- 116 學測 自然 is 116/1/22 (Fri), 12:50–14:40, 110 minutes.

Structure (考試說明 貳-二):
- 第壹部分 is 選擇題 (單選 and 多選), about 32–36 items.
- 第貳部分 is 混合題 or 非選擇題, about 六大題組.
- 選擇題 is about 70–80% of the points; 非選擇題 about 20–30%.

Scoring (簡章 and the 115 cover page):
- 單選: n options, only one correct.
- 多選: n options, at least one correct, each option judged separately. With k wrong options the item earns (n−2k)/n of its points. A negative score, or leaving every option blank, scores 0.

Actual 115 paper (19 pages, 110 minutes):
- 第壹部分: Q1–36, 2 points each, 72 points.
- 第貳部分: 56 points in 6 題組 (37–39, 40–43, 44–46, 47–49, 50–53, 54–56). Choice items are 2 points each; written-item points are printed at the end of each item.
- Total: 128 points.

Chemistry share of 115 (翰林 宋彧):
- 14 items, 32 points.
- 第壹部分: 5 單選 (Q19, 20, 21, 22, 24; 10 points) and 4 多選 (Q23, 25, 26, 27; 8 points).
- 第貳部分: 單選 Q43 (2), 多選 Q44–45 (4), and written 42(a)(b) and 46(a)(b) (8).
- Q40–43 is a chemistry–biology cross-subject 題組 (nectar compounds). Q44–46 is a pure-chemistry inquiry 題組 on 2023 Nobel ZnS quantum dots. Q25–27 is a 第壹部分 inquiry 題組 on extracting potassium salts from bananas.

Correction: the claim that partial credit is given for a correct setup is not a verified general rule. Scoring is set per item:
- 111 Q38 (2 points) was all-or-nothing.
- 111 Q57-1 gave 1 of 2 points for writing only 氧化反應 or only 還原反應.
- 111 Q57-2 gave 1 of 2 points for fractional or doubled coefficients.
- The 評分原則 intro asks students to explain their solution process clearly.

confirmed_facts.claim: 116學年度學測 runs 116/1/22 (Fri) to 1/24 (Sun). 自然 is on 1/22 afternoon, 12:50–14:40, 110 minutes. 數學A is 1/22 morning. The 簡章 is 初版 中華民國115年8月4日.
The 學測 自然 scope is 必修物理、必修化學、必修生物、必修地球科學（含探究與實作）, under the 108課綱. 註3 says 以占分比例相當為原則 and that the scope includes 探究與實作 學習內容.
The 分科測驗 化學 scope is 必修化學 plus 物質與能量、物質構造與反應速率、化學反應與平衡一、化學反應與平衡二、有機化學與應用科技. The 學測 table lists only 必修.
多選 scoring: n options, at least one correct, each option judged separately. With k wrong options the item earns (n−2k)/n of its points; a score below 0, or no options marked, scores 0.

The 考試說明 in force is the 111學年度起適用 edition (中華民國108年9月). It covers 部定必修 12 學分 including 探究與實作, with 必修化學 at 2-4 學分. 國中 content may appear in 命題素材 or as needed basic knowledge, but is not the main object of the items. The paper is 第壹部分 about 32-36 選擇題 and 第貳部分 about 六大題組; 選擇題 is about 70-80% of points and 非選擇題 about 20-30%.
The CEEC 考試說明 listing has no 自然 edition newer than 111學年度起適用 (定稿). The page footer is 更新日期 115-11-12. The 113/07/29 update tag applies to the 英文考科 entry, not 自然.
Copyright notice on the 考試說明 cover: 僅供非營利目的使用，轉載請註明出處; commercial use needs prior written authorization from CEEC.

The 115 自然 paper: 110 minutes, 19 pages. 第壹部分 Q1–36 at 2 points each (72). 第貳部分 混合題或非選擇題 is 56 points in 6 題組 (37–39, 40–43, 44–46, 47–49, 50–53, 54–56). Q25–27 is the banana potassium-salt inquiry set, Q40–43 the nectar (苄丙酮/尼古丁) set, and Q44–46 the 2023 Nobel quantum-dot ZnS synthesis set.
自然領綱 (中華民國一○七年十一月): 普通型高中 自然 部定必修 is 12 學分, which must include one-third cross-subject 主題式探究與實作. 物理/化學/生物/地科 are each 2-4. 加深加廣選修 is 32 學分: 物理10, 化學10, 生物8, 地科4.

confirmed_facts.claim: 必修化學 scope limits in the 學習內容說明: 倍比定律不涉及複雜計算; valence electrons only for Z 1~18; isotopes only C and H; phase diagrams only H2O and CO2; ionic bonding with NaCl/MgO and metallic bonding by 電子海, both with no 晶格堆積/形狀/晶格能; Lewis structures for H2O, NH3, CH4, C2H4, CO2. Balancing by 觀察法與代數法 with no complex equations; stoichiometry with no 產率 or gas volume. Tyndall is the only colloid property; no 再結晶 and no hydrated solutes; molarity includes preparing solutions. Redox: no 氧化數 calculation and no balancing. Oxidizers 氧氣、臭氧、雙氧水、次氯酸、氯氣; reducers 焦煤、二氧化硫; antioxidant 維生素C. 25℃ Kw = 1.00x10^-14; pH without complex calculation; indicator lab. Surface area and rate are taught together with CMc-Vc-3. Biomolecules without complex structure. 奈米碳管/TiO2 光觸媒 without structure. CMb-Vc-1 should be woven into chapters, not made a separate unit. CEc-Vc-1 is taught together with other chapters. Nuclear energy is left to physics.

confirmed_facts.claim: 115 chemistry (翰林, 宋彧): 14 items, one fewer than 114, worth 32 points. 第壹部分 has 5 單選 (10) and 4 多選 (8). 第貳部分 has 1 單選 (2), 2 多選 (4) and 2 written items with 4 sub-items (8). It has one chemistry–biology 題組 and one pure-chemistry 探究與實作 題組, with emphasis on bonding/structure and stoichiometry.

翰林 化學（全） chapter structure: Ch1 (1-1 物質的分類、分離及狀態, 1-2 化學的基本定律與莫耳, 1-3 原子結構與元素週期表, 1-4 物質的化學鍵、構造及特性); Ch2 (2-1 化學式與百分組成, 2-2 化學反應式, 2-3 化學計量, 2-4 化學反應中的能量變化); Ch3 (3-1 溶液的種類與特性, 3-2 溶解度, 3-3 酸鹼反應, 3-4 氧化還原反應); Ch4 (4-1 生活中常見的有機物質, 4-2 科學與人文, 4-3 資源與永續發展).

114: 57 items overall, chemistry 15 items and 32 points. It had less calculation and more basic items, chart items fell from 9, and the 50–54 set was a nano TiO2 photocatalyst cross-subject set. There was a fuel thermochemistry set with written formulas and equations. Q30 included 再結晶, and some items went beyond 必修.

113: 56 items overall, chemistry 14 items and 32 points, rated 中等偏難. More points went to written items, with heavier calculation. About 64% of chemistry was chart/data work; 探究與實作 grew from 1–2 items to 4; there was a chemistry–earth-science set.

112: 60 items overall, chemistry 15 items and 32 points. There were 12 chart items (80%) and 1 探究與實作 item; cross-chapter and cross-subject items were 6 each (40%). It leaned toward 生活化學 and reused the 國中 oxygen-preparation experiment. One option involved 再結晶.

111 (建中 趙君傑): total items fell from 68 to 60 and chemistry items from 17 to 15. There were 10 chart items (7 素養, 2 探究與實作), 2 cross-subject items (chemistry–physics and chemistry–biology), and 1 cross-subject 題組 (chemistry–earth science).

111 written items: 8 in total. Chemistry's were Q38 (2 points) and Q57 (4 points). Q57-2's full answer is Cr2O7^2− + 6Fe2+ + 14H+ → 2Cr3+ + 6Fe3+ + 7H2O, and all coefficients had to be correct for 2 points.
選才電子報 第330期 (111-04-15) on Q57: writing only 氧化反應 or only 還原反應 earned 1 point; one or two wrong coefficients (e.g. on 鐵離子) earned 1 point.
udn 2026-01-17: the Taipei teacher group invited by CEEC said 今年化學偏易，為近五年來最簡單. About 81,000 of about 121,000 registrants (66%) took 自然. 全教會 called chemistry relatively easy with 無繁瑣計算.

化學命名原則（第四版） is published by 國立編譯館, 2009.11. Each element name is one character: 气 for gases, 水 (氵) for liquids, 金 for solid metals, 石 for solid nonmetals. Binary compounds put the more electronegative element first. Variable valence uses Roman numerals, e.g. 鐵(III)離子. 過/亞/次 prefixes are used (過氯酸, 亞氯酸, 次氯酸). Isotopes are written element name plus mass number (鈾-235); only H has special names (氕, 氘, 氚). Group 18 is called 惰性氣體/惰氣. The element table ends at 111 (錀).
The NAER element CSV includes 14 矽 Si, 113 鉨 Nh, 114 鈇 Fl, 115 鏌 Mc, 116 鉝 Lv, 117 Ts (石田) and 118 Og (气奧). Its dataset on data.gov.tw (14843) is licensed 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版.

The NAER 兩岸中小學教科書學術名詞 CSV gives: Lewis structure 路易斯結構; chromatography 層析術; noble gas 鈍氣 (mainland 惰性气体); hydronium ion {舊名} 鋞離子 (mainland 水合氢离子); molarity 體積莫耳濃度; Tyndall effect 廷得耳效應; mole 莫耳; Avogadro's number 亞佛加厥數; limiting reagent 限量試劑; surfactant 界面活性劑; Arrhenius 阿瑞尼斯; recrystallization 再結晶.

confirmed_facts.claim: 3Dmol.js is under a permissive BSD license and asks for citation of DOI 10.1093/bioinformatics/btu829. The MolView README says that since 2023 patches are no longer released under an open-source license.

corrections.original: Pedagogy note: the proposed unit sequence 'follows the 翰林 化學（全） chapter flow'.
corrections.correction: It does not fully follow it. 翰林 teaches the mole in 1-2 化學的基本定律與莫耳, before 1-3 atomic structure and 1-4 bonding. The report puts the mole (unit 8) after bonding. Both orders are allowed (the 課綱 permits reordering) and the report's order has no prerequisite violation. But the claim should say 'adapted from' 翰林, not 'follows'.

corrections.original: Unit 7 '氣體基本性質' (CEc-Vc-1) is a standalone unit placed after bonding.
corrections.correction: The 課綱 說明 for CEc-Vc-1 says 與其他章節合併說明, with 0.5 periods. Gas pressure from molecular collisions is also useful before reading the pressure axis of phase diagrams. It is merged into the states/phase-diagram unit.
corrections.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

corrections.original: Scope limit treated as firm: 'no 氧化數 calculation or redox balancing' in 必修. The UI is to mark it as outside 學測 scope.
corrections.correction: The 課綱 說明 does say 不涉及…氧化還原反應的平衡. But 111 學測 Q57-2 (2 points) required full coefficients for Cr2O7^2− + Fe2+ + H+ → Cr3+ + Fe3+ + H2O. Balancing by atom and charge conservation (代數法 or 觀察法 under CJa-Vc-2) should therefore be taught as tested enrichment, not dropped. I did not check whether the stem gave hints.

corrections.original: exam_format: 'Partial credit is given for a correct setup (CEEC 評分原則 practice).'
corrections.correction: Not verified as a general rule. Scoring is set per item: 111 Q38 was all-or-nothing (2 or 0), and Q57 gave 1 of 2 for partial answers (only 氧化反應, or fractional/doubled coefficients). The 評分原則 intro only asks students to show their solution process clearly.

corrections.original: Bridging (Jd): '高中 adds the Arrhenius definition…'.
corrections.correction: 國中 already introduces Arrhenius: the Jb-Ⅳ-2 說明 says 簡單的說明阿瑞尼斯的電離說. What 高中 CJd-Vc-2 adds is Arrhenius acid–base theory (acids give H+, bases give OH−) and pH = −log[H+].
corrections.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

corrections.original: Scientific notation (N-7-8) is a sufficient 國中 prerequisite for Avogadro's number and Kw calculations.
corrections.correction: N-7-8 says 不宜涉及科學記號的四則運算, and N-7-6 covers only non-negative integer exponents. Multiplying and dividing in scientific notation first appears in 高一 N-10-1 (科學記號數字的運算). The course must teach it explicitly before mole and pH calculations.
corrections.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/815/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等學校-數學領域.pdf

corrections.original: Key fact sourced to udn: 'Q44–46 used the 2023 Nobel Chemistry topic (quantum dots).'
corrections.correction: True, but the udn article body does not say so. There 趙君傑 describes 44–46 as 探究與實作結合化學計量. The Nobel quantum-dot theme is confirmed by the 115 試卷 stem itself and by 翰林.

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 物質的粒子模型與三態、溫度對狀態的影響

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Physical vs chemical properties; pure substances vs mixtures; elements vs compounds

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 混合物分離（結晶、過濾、簡易濾紙色層分析）與以化學性質鑑定
final_bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Separating mixtures (crystallization, filtration, simple paper chromatography); identifying compounds by chemical properties

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Atomic models; atoms vs molecules; first look at allotropes and isomers

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 原子量與分子量（相對質量）；莫耳僅名詞、不涉及莫耳運算
final_bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Atomic and molecular weight as relative masses; mole as a term only, no mole calculations

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 元素的規律性與週期性（不需記憶週期表）；元素符號與化合物命名簡則（限日常簡單物質）

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Reactions: mass conservation, rearranging atoms, observable signs, writing equations

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 能量形式與轉換（含孤立系統能量守恆）；化學反應吸放熱；熱量單位
final_bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Forms of energy and conservation; heat absorbed or released in reactions; heat units

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 電解質與離子（含簡單說明阿瑞尼斯電離說）；沉澱（僅鈣鎂與碳酸根）；溶液、重量百分濃度、ppm（不涉及混合與稀釋計算）

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Narrow redox (gain or loss of oxygen), combustion, metal reactivity, cells and electrolysis

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 反應速率與影響因素、可逆反應、化學平衡（定性）

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 有機化合物：烷、醇、有機酸、酯；酯化與皂化；塑膠

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 測量：基本與衍伸物理量、尺度（奈米到光年、毫升到立方公尺）、估計
final_bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Measurement: base and derived quantities, scales (nanometres to light-years, mL to m³), estimation

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 氣體壓力（大氣壓力；定溫下壓力與體積定性關係）
final_bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Gas pressure (atmospheric pressure; qualitative pressure–volume link)

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 環境與能源（家庭廢水、空氣汙染、溫室氣體、化石燃料、新興能源）
final_bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Environment and energy (household wastewater, air pollution, greenhouse gases, fossil fuels, emerging energy)

final_bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Linear equations; systems of two linear equations

verification.notes:
The report is accurate on the points that matter. I found no invented curriculum codes. All 46 必修化學 codes are present and correctly grouped, and all 5 選修 course code groups match the 課綱 附錄四. The 參考節數 values and the 32-period total check out. Exam dates, timetable, scope and scoring match the 116 簡章 and the 111 考試說明. The 翰林 per-year chemistry counts (112: 15/32; 113: 14/32; 114: 15/32; 115: 14/32) check out, as do the 龍騰 111 figures, the 111 評分原則 and the 選才電子報 330.

Main fixes:
1. CEc-Vc-1 is folded into the states/phase-diagram unit, as the 課綱 says (與其他章節合併說明).
2. 111 Q57-2 did test redox ionic-equation balancing, despite the 必修 說明. It is flagged as tested enrichment in the balancing and redox units.
3. 國中 math excludes arithmetic in scientific notation (N-7-8). N-10-1 is added as a prerequisite for mole and pH calculations.
4. 國中 already introduces Arrhenius' ionization theory (Jb-Ⅳ-2 說明).
5. The 'follows 翰林' claim is softened: 翰林 places the mole in 1-2.
6. 'Partial credit for setup' is not a general CEEC rule.

Unit order was rechecked so that no unit uses a concept before its prerequisite. Electives stay listed for 分科 continuity, with in_gsat 'no'. Note, though, that 翰林 saw 選修-level ideas in 學測 options in 112 and 114.

Method: PDFs were fetched with WebFetch, which cached them automatically. I extracted text read-only to stdout with pdftotext and PyMuPDF; 參考節數 row alignment was checked by word positions.

The shared WebSearch budget ran out on my first query, which returned no results, so I ran no independent Traditional-Chinese searches. All verification used direct fetches of the official URLs (ceec.edu.tw, naer.edu.tw, terms.naer.edu.tw, opendata.naer.edu.tw, data.gov.tw) plus the cited secondary sources. You can send a follow-up to run extra searches, for example for a newer 考試說明 or CEEC announcements about 117.

research.subject: 生物 (Biology) as tested in the 116學年度學測 自然考科 (108課綱 部定必修生物, including 探究與實作)
research.scope_summary:
The 大考中心 116學年度簡章 (初版 115年8月4日) confirms the next 學測 runs 116年1月22日–24日. 自然 is on Fri 1/22, 12:50–14:40 (110 minutes). The 自然 scope is 必修物理、必修化學、必修生物、必修地球科學（含探究與實作）under the 108課綱. Note 3 of the 簡章 says the four subjects carry roughly equal points (占分比例相當), so biology is about 1/4 of the paper. Papers 111–115 match this: each year biology had 9 of the 36 Part-1 choice items, plus one biology 題組 and one biology-crossover 題組 in Part 2 (total 128 points).

部定必修生物 is 2 學分 (領綱 附錄 says 必修生物2學分; the time-allocation table allows 2–4 per subject inside 12 自然 學分, one third of which is cross-subject 探究與實作). The 課程手冊 places Mendelian genetics and evolution in 十年級. The four 加深加廣選修生物 courses (細胞與遺傳／生命的起源與植物體的構造與功能／動物體的構造與功能／生態、演化及生物多樣性, 8 學分) belong to the 分科測驗 生物 scope, not 學測.

必修生物 has three sub-themes in curriculum order: 細胞的構造與功能 (BDa-Ⅴc-1~9), 遺傳 (BGa-Ⅴc-1~7), 演化 (BGb-Ⅴc-1~5), closing with biodiversity. History-of-science (BMb-Ⅴc-1~4) and application (BMc-Ⅴc-1) items are woven into those chapters.

Two official statements make bridging content mandatory. The 課程手冊 says 國中生物 and 高中必修生物 were designed as one combined body, so students must fully learn both. The 考試說明 says 學測 materials and the base knowledge needed to answer may involve 國中 content. Its sample items cite 國中 codes such as Db-Ⅳ-7 and Lb-Ⅳ-2. Human body systems, plant structure and ecology are taught in 國中 or 選修, not in 必修生物, so a zero-prerequisite course must teach the 國中 biology first.
research.exam_format:
學測 自然考科, 110 minutes. The 考試說明 (111學年度起適用, 108年9月) gives the design: Part 1 is about 32–36 choice items (single and multiple); Part 2 is about six mixed (混合題) or non-choice 題組; choice items carry about 70–80% of points and non-choice about 20–30%. Actual papers 111–115 all had 36 Part-1 items × 2 points (72 points) plus 6 Part-2 題組 (56 points), 128 points in total.

Biology Part-1 item numbers by year: 111 Q19–27; 112 Q10–18; 113 Q1–9; 114 Q1–9; 115 Q28–36. The subject order rotates each year.

Part-2 biology groups by year:
- 111: Q46–48 (bio) and Q49–54 (phys/bio)
- 112: Q48–50 (bio) and Q55–60 (chem/bio)
- 113: Q37–39 (bio) and Q40–43 (bio/phys)
- 114: Q37–39 (bio) and Q40–43 (bio/earth)
- 115: Q37–39 (bio) and Q40–43 (bio/chem)

Multiple-choice scoring: with n options and k wrong, the score is (n−2k)/n of the item points, floored at zero. Non-choice answers must show reasons or working. 114 added curve-drawing and the first matching-style (連連看) non-choice items.

key_facts.claim:
Official depth limits in the 必修生物 學習內容說明:
- Interphase and the division phase are not further subdivided.
- Mitosis is not split into prophase/metaphase/anaphase/telophase.
- ATP's structural formula is not covered.
- Photosynthesis and respiration mechanisms are deferred to 選修.
- DNA replication names no enzyme except polymerase.
- Transcription and translation are covered without mechanism or gene regulation.
- Polygenic inheritance (skin colour) involves no calculation.
- Transgenic technology is covered without mechanism or molecular formulas.

- Q29: seedlings moved to darkness; options mention 光反應/固碳反應 and lactate/ethanol.
- Q30: cell-theory history (Hooke, Leeuwenhoek, Brown, Schleiden, Virchow).
- Q31: ABO pedigree.
- Q32: ATP.
- Q33: kiwi DNA crude extraction follow-up.
- Q34: Sepkoski mass extinctions (bio/earth).
- Q35: common ancestry, classification and the binomial system.
- Q36: placing dinosaur DNA on a tetrapod tree.
- Q37–39: temperature-dependent sex in Trachemys turtles (Dmrt1/Kdm6b expression, transcription vs translation location, gene-family phylogeny).

recent_trends.trend: 111 (first 108課綱 year): COVID-19 contexts. Q24–25 was a vaccine experiment. Q46–48 combined virus RNA, the three-domain system and phylogenetic-tree inference. Q49–54 (phys/bio) used the Doppler effect to measure blood-flow changes after drinking alcohol. CEEC stressed reading, analysis and explanation over memorisation.

112: Q13 described slide-preparation methods as physical actions, testing real lab experience (折撕法 on Sedum leaf epidermis). The chem/bio group Q55–60 linked the 2022 Nobel click chemistry to antibiotic resistance and its evolution. CEEC suggested asking why meiosis halves chromosomes yet still needs DNA replication.

113: Q1 used a cell-observation schematic (P=82%). Q3 covered cell theory and virus classification. Q7 applied changing trait ratios to Micrococcus in a nylon-factory pond. Q37–39 was on broiler chickens. Q40–43 (bio/phys) on Venus-flytrap closure asked students to identify variables and predict results.

114: Q1 asked students to distinguish two division types and was hard (P=32%). Q2 read a diagram to separate respiration from photosynthesis. Q4 applied Mendel to ABO, jasmine flower colour and polygenic traits. Q37–39 used milkfish cold-tolerance data and charts. Q40–43 (bio/earth) used ocean-colour, chlorophyll and El Niño data. The paper added curve-drawing and the first matching-style non-choice items.

115: strong history-of-science and lab-activity focus. Items covered:
- onion root-tip mitosis
- cell-theory history
- kiwi DNA extraction follow-up
- Linnaean naming and classification
- dinosaur DNA placed on a tree
- Sepkoski mass-extinction chart (bio/earth)
- turtle temperature-dependent sex gene expression (Q38, P=65%)
- GM tobacco nectar and hummingbird experiments with four-panel graphs (bio/chem)
CEEC advice: master 必修 content, learn the science history, and practise inquiry.

Patterns across 111–115:
- Every year has one biology 題組 and one biology-crossover 題組 in Part 2, built on unfamiliar real research (graphs, tables, passages).
- Phylogenetic-tree reading recurs (111 Q46–48, 115 Q36, Q39).
- Pedigree and ABO reasoning recurs (112 Q50, 114 Q4, 115 Q31).
- 必修 探討活動 labs are tested directly (slide methods, mitosis slides, DNA extraction).

Non-choice scoring rewards precise terms and complete causal chains. Partial credit goes to answers giving one perspective or one factor only. Wrong wording, such as 女性 for a female turtle or incomplete symbols, scores zero.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Bacteria become resistant because they slowly adapt (慢慢適應) or get stronger after antibiotic exposure.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Resistance spreads by natural selection (天擇) on existing variation. In 112 Q57, 慢慢適應 scored 0 and naming only mutation got partial credit.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Organisms evolve because they aim or need to survive (teleological), or the environment directly strengthens traits within one generation (Lamarckian).
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Evolution comes from selection acting on heritable variation across generations of a population. A study of 295 高一 students found these teleological and Lamarckian models alongside the Darwinian one.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Plants photosynthesise during the day and respire only at night.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Plant cells respire all the time. Photosynthesis needs light. The 科學教育月刊 article cites this as a typical prior conception that teaching must confront.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Two structures are analogous simply because the organisms are different species, or similar function alone proves close kinship.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Analogous (同功) structures share function but not common ancestral origin, so they cannot show kinship. Homologous (同源) structures can. In 113 Q41, full credit needed both the functional and the evolutionary argument.

common_misconceptions.misconception: A colour-normal woman always has colour-normal children; affected sons mean the father carries the allele.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: In X-linked inheritance, a colour-normal mother of affected sons is a heterozygous carrier (X^A X^a). A colour-normal father is X^A Y and carries no colour-blind allele.

common_misconceptions.misconception: One pedigree observation (affected parents with a healthy son) is enough to show a trait is not sex-linked.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The reason must actually rule out X-linkage, e.g., affected parents with both healthy sons and healthy daughters. In 112 Q50, incomplete reasons got partial or zero credit.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Phylogenetic-tree branches can be filled with sampling locations, or node order can be read arbitrarily.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Trees show relationships among taxa or variants, so branch order follows shared ancestry. In 111 Q48, about 20% put locations in the tree and 20–30% got the order wrong.

common_misconceptions.misconception: All parts of a flower are haploid, or meiosis happens in the stigma.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Meiosis happens in the anther and the ovule. The style and ovary wall are diploid tissue (考試說明 biology sample 3, tied to 國中 Db-Ⅳ-7).

common_misconceptions.misconception: Everyday wording is fine in answers, e.g., calling a female turtle 女性, or describing the untreated control instead of the treated group.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Use precise biological terms (雌性 for animals) and answer about the condition actually asked. 115 Q38 gave 0 for 女性, and imprecise phrases such as 變化較少 lost credit.

common_misconceptions.misconception: When explaining data, listing two trends is enough (e.g., growth rose and feed changed).
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Full credit needs the relationship between the variables, a complete causal chain. In 113 Q38 many students omitted the link, and some misread a conversion ratio as a percentage.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Meiosis halves chromosome number, so DNA is not replicated before it.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: DNA is replicated once before meiosis, and two successive divisions then halve the chromosome number. CEEC's 112 biology teaching suggestions frame this as a discussion question, not a measured error rate.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Genetics concepts such as homologous chromosomes, alleles, dominance, codominance and gametes are well understood once memorised.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: A review of 48 studies (1970–2000) found misconceptions across seven genetics concept areas, including mitosis/meiosis, homologous and sex chromosomes, alleles, DNA, dominance and codominance, and Mendel's laws and probability. These need explicit, multi-representation teaching.

pedagogy_notes: Build a mandatory 國中生物 bridge before 必修. The 課程手冊 says 國中 and 高中必修生物 were designed as one combined body. Body systems, ecology and plant structure appear only in 國中 (or 選修), yet 學測 contexts use them.

Follow the curriculum's spine: 細胞 (Da) → 遺傳 (Ga) → 演化 (Gb) → biodiversity. Weave history (BMb-Ⅴc-1~4) and application (BMc-Ⅴc-1) into those chapters as the curriculum directs, not as separate units. This keeps concepts from appearing out of nowhere.

Respect the official depth limits so lessons do not overreach (no mitosis phase names, no ATP or DNA structural formulas, no photosynthesis or respiration mechanisms, only polymerase named, no gene regulation). 115 Q29 and Q32 options did mention 光反應/固碳反應 and purine/pyrimidine, so consider short labelled 'preview' sidebars rather than full coverage. This needs a planner decision.

Make every 必修 探討活動 a visual or interactive lab: slide methods (折撕法/壓片法/抹片法/徒手切片), micrometer cell measurement, a eukaryotic cell model, onion root-tip mitosis, DNA crude extraction (not chicken blood), peppered-moth simulation, and a virus-classification debate. 112 Q13, 113 Q1, 115 Q28 and 115 Q33 tested these labs directly.
Give phylogenetic-tree reading and pedigree reading their own scaffolded practice, because they recur nearly every year (111 Q46–48; 112 Q50; 114 Q4; 115 Q31, Q36, Q39).

Train non-choice writing explicitly: use exact terms (雌性 not 女性; 天擇), state the relationship between variables, give both perspectives when asked (function plus evolution), and write symbols completely. CEEC rubrics deduct for each of these.

For the professor-student dialogue (OSTEP style), give the student the documented misconceptions (慢慢適應; 'different species so analogous'; 'plants respire only at night'; teleological evolution) so the professor can resolve them with evidence.
Terminology: introduce both 酵素 (國中) and 酶 (高中 選修 wording). Note Taiwan forms such as 粒線體, 高基氏體, 同型合子/異型合子, 轉譯 and 基因轉殖, which appear in official documents and exam items.
Code formatting: the 領綱 prints biology codes with the Roman numeral Ⅴ (e.g., BDa-Ⅴc-1), while the 考試說明 uses a Latin V (BGa-Vc-4). Normalise them in the site's data model.

Biology is about 9/36 Part-1 items plus about 2 Part-2 題組 each year. Many Part-2 sets are cross-subject (bio with phys, chem or earth), so the course should link to physics, chemistry and earth-science units (e.g., Doppler effect, molecular formulas, geologic time).

Most English equivalents in terminology are standard renderings not yet checked against 樂詞網; only meiosis and mitosis were confirmed through 樂詞網 indexed titles. 樂詞網 detail pages render via JavaScript and could not be read by WebFetch. A follow-up pass should verify each pair, ideally against the 高中以下生命科學名詞 set.

No CEEC 學測 自然 選擇題答題分析 with distractor-choice statistics was found. P/D values come only from the 試題特色 articles.

115 Q29 and Q32 options used 光反應/固碳反應, lactate/ethanol accumulation and purine/pyrimidine. This seems to brush against the 必修 limits (mechanisms deferred to 選修; no ATP structural formula). Expert judgement is needed on how much to preview.
