verification.subject: 生物 (Biology): 116學年度學測 自然考科 scope (108課綱 部定必修生物 + 探究與實作), with 國中 bridge and 選修 (分科) extension
verification.corrected_scope_summary:
The 116 學測 runs 116年1月22日(五) to 1月24日(日). 自然 is on 1/22 from 12:50 to 14:40 (110 minutes). The source is the 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章, 初版 dated 中華民國115年8月4日.

**Scope.** 自然 tests 必修物理、必修化學、必修生物、必修地球科學（含探究與實作）under the 108課綱. 簡章 註3 says the four subjects are weighted 以占分比例相當為原則, and that the paper includes 探究與實作 學習內容. The 分科測驗 生物 scope is 必修生物 plus four 加深加廣 courses: 細胞與遺傳／生命的起源與植物體的構造與功能／動物體的構造與功能／生態、演化及生物多樣性. 分科 also includes 探究與實作 (註2). None of the 選修 courses are in 學測.

**必修生物 per the 領綱.**
- It is 2 學分 (附錄 diagram: 必修生物2學分). The time-allocation table gives each subject 2–4 學分 within 12 必修 學分, one third of which is cross-subject 探究與實作.
- It has 26 學習內容 codes in three sub-themes: 細胞的構造與功能 BDa-Ⅴc-1~9, 生殖與遺傳 BGa-Ⅴc-1~7, 演化 BGb-Ⅴc-1~5. Biodiversity comes last.
- It also has history items BMb-Ⅴc-1~4 and an application item BMc-Ⅴc-1. The curriculum says to fold these into the related chapters rather than teach them as separate units.
- Textbook writers may choose their own chapter names and order (可依課程發展的理念自訂章節名稱與順序). The 學習內容說明 sets the depth limits.

**Grade.** The 課綱 fixes only 第五學習階段. The 課程手冊 says Mendel and evolution theory 移至十年級, and that organelles, cell theory and prokaryote/eukaryote 移至高中. Which semester a given school uses was not verified.

**Why a 國中 bridge is required.**
- 課程手冊 p.474: because 必修 shrank to 2 學分, 國中生物 and 高中必修生物 were 合併設計, and students 均須完整學習完 both.
- 考試說明 p.4: 學測 素材 or the base knowledge needed to answer 部分可能涉及國中學習內容.
- Its biology samples cite 國中 Db-IV-7 (flower) and Lb-IV-2 (human impact).
- Body systems, plant structure and ecology appear only in 國中 or 選修, so a zero-prerequisite course must teach the 國中 biology first.

**Recent papers (111–115).** Each paper had 36 Part-1 items worth 72 points and 6 Part-2 題組 worth 56 points, 128 in total. Biology always had 9 consecutive Part-1 items, one biology 題組, and one biology-crossover 題組. In 112, items 45–46 inside the chemistry group were also chem-bio crossover items.

confirmed_facts.claim: 116 學測 runs 116年1月22日(五) to 1月24日(日). 自然 is on 1/22, 12:50–14:40. 社會 and 自然 are 110 minutes each. The 簡章 初版 is dated 中華民國115年8月4日.
The 116 學測 自然 scope is 必修物理、必修化學、必修生物、必修地球科學（含探究與實作）, 課綱依據 108課綱. 註3 says the four subjects follow 以占分比例相當為原則 and include 探究與實作的學習內容.
分科測驗 生物 = 必修生物 + 細胞與遺傳／生命的起源與植物體的構造與功能／動物體的構造與功能／生態、演化及生物多樣性. 註2 says the 物理/化學/生物 分科 scopes include 探究與實作.
Multiple-choice scoring: n options, k wrong gives (n−2k)/n of the item points. A score below zero, or a blank, counts as zero.
領綱 (中華民國107年11月): 自然 部定必修 is 12 學分. 物理/化學/生物/地球科學 each get 2–4, and one third is 跨科目之主題式探究與實作. 加深加廣 is 32 學分, with 選修生物 = 8 (four 2-學分 courses).

confirmed_facts.claim:
考試說明 (111學年度起適用, 中華民國108年9月):
- Part 1 has about 32–36 single and multiple choice items.
- Part 2 has about six mixed or non-choice 題組.
- 選擇題 carry about 70–80% of points and 非選擇題 about 20–30%.
- 每題均計分.
- Five goal families: 1a–1d, 2a–2c, 3a–3d, 4a–4d, 5a–5c.
考試說明 p.4: 學測命題之相關素材，或考生作答所需之基礎知識，部分可能涉及國中學習內容, but 國中 content is not the design target. Biology sample 3 is coded BDa-Vc-6 + 國中 Db-IV-7. Samples 4–5 are coded 探究與實作 + 國中 Lb-IV-2.
The 考試說明 cover allows non-profit use with attribution. Commercial use needs prior written consent from 財團法人大學入學考試中心基金會.
The CEEC 考試說明 listing shows the 自然 file '111學年度起適用' with no update note. The 113.07.29 update is the English 115-onward file. The page footer is dated 115-11-12.

Biology Part-1 blocks were 111 Q19–27, 112 Q10–18, 113 Q1–9, 114 Q1–9 and 115 Q28–36. Every year had 36×2 = 72 points in Part 1 and 56 in Part 2, 128 in total. Part-2 biology groups:
- 111: 46–48 and 49–54 (物/生)
- 112: 48–50 and 55–60 (化/生)
- 113: 37–39 and 40–43 (物/生)
- 114: 37–39 and 40–43 (生/地)
- 115: 37–39 and 40–43 (生/化)
CEEC's 115 試題特色 says Q29 (P=50%) required understanding 呼吸作用、發酵作用、光反應、固碳反應. It also gives Q33 P=59% and Q38 P=65%. Its advice: master 必修, learn the science-history context, and practise 探討活動 and 探究.

The 115 paper matches the report's item descriptions for Q28–43: onion root tip, seedlings in the dark, cell-theory scientists, ABO pedigree, ATP options, kiwi DNA, Sepkoski, binomial naming and classification, dinosaur DNA on a tetrapod tree, Trachemys Dmrt1/Kdm6b, and GM tobacco with hummingbirds. Non-choice answers 必須寫出計算過程或理由.

Rubric details:
- 115 Q38: 女性 scored 0, and vague wording such as 變化較少 got no credit.
- 112 Q57: 慢慢適應 scored 0; only 突變 or only 適者生存 got 1 point.
- 112 Q50: the reason must rule out sex-linkage.
- 113 Q38: the relationship between variables was needed, and misreading the conversion ratio as % scored 0.
- 113 Q41: both function and evolution views were needed; 兩者為不同生物 scored 0.
- 111 Q48: about 20% wrote locations into the tree, and 20–30% got the order wrong.
111 試題特色 結語 lists 第23題的基因轉殖 among experiment-based items.

Secondary misconception sources confirmed:
- 陳藍萍 (2004 NTNU thesis), 295 高一 students, Darwinian, Lamarckian and teleological models.
- 楊坤原、張賴妙理 (2004, 科學教育學刊 12(3)), reviewing 48 studies from 1970–2000 across seven genetics concept areas.

verification.exam_format_verified:
**Length and structure.** 學測 自然 is 110 minutes. The 考試說明 (111學年度起適用) specifies:
- Part 1 (第壹部分): about 32–36 choice items, single and multiple.
- Part 2 (第貳部分): about six mixed (混合題) or non-choice 題組.
- Across the whole paper, choice items are about 70–80% of points and non-choice about 20–30%. Every item is scored.

**Actual papers, 111–115.** Part 1 always had 36 items × 2 points (72). Part 2 always had 6 題組 worth 56, for 128 in total. The Part-2 split varied:

| Year | Part-2 choice | Part-2 non-choice |
|---|---|---|
| 111 | 16 items (32 pts) | 8 (24 pts) |
| 112 | 16 items (32 pts) | 8 (24 pts) |
| 113 | 12 items (24 pts) | 8 (32 pts) |
| 114 | 12 items | 9 |
| 115 | 12 items (24 pts) | 8 (32 pts) |

**Biology items by year.** The Part-1 block of 9 items moves each year as subject order rotates.

| Year | Part-1 block | Part-2 biology 題組 | Part-2 crossover 題組 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 111 | Q19–27 | 46–48 | 49–54 (物/生) |
| 112 | Q10–18 | 48–50 | 55–60 (化/生); also Q45–46 in the chemistry group are 化/生 crossover items |
| 113 | Q1–9 | 37–39 | 40–43 (物/生) |
| 114 | Q1–9 | 37–39 | 40–43 (生/地) |
| 115 | Q28–36 | 37–39 | 40–43 (生/化) |

**Scoring.** A multiple-choice item with n options and k wrong options earns (n−2k)/n of its points, with zero as the floor. Non-choice answers 必須寫出計算過程或理由.

**114 formats.** 114 included curve-drawing in its non-choice items, and the first 連連看-style item (首次出現).

verification.notes:
**Method**
- Primary PDFs were fetched with WebFetch, which saved them to the tool-results cache: the 116 簡章, the 自然領綱 (107年11月), the 課程手冊(定稿版), the 學測自然考科考試說明 and the 115 試卷.
- Their text was read with pdftotext to stdout only. No project files were created or modified.
- PDF page numbers differ from printed page numbers. For example, the 必修生物 附錄 is PDF pp.169–173 but printed pp.165–169, and the 簡章 scope table is printed p.4.
- The web-search budget was already exhausted, so no independent Traditional Chinese searches could be run. Verification relied on opening the cited primary URLs directly.

**Code alignment**
- In -layout extraction the 課綱 tables shift codes by one row against their text. Mappings were checked against the 附錄 說明 numbering (for example, Ba-Ⅳ-2 is 說明 2-1).
- The 考試說明 prints codes with Latin V/IV (BGa-Vc-4, Db-IV-7). The 領綱 uses Ⅴ/Ⅳ.

**Design implications**
- The 課綱 lets textbook writers set their own chapter order. The order Da → Ga → Gb → biodiversity, with history and application items folded into those chapters, matches the curriculum's own structure.
- The real sequencing risks are forward references to DNA (Units 6 and 8) and terms CEEC now expects beyond the stated depth: in 115 Q29, 發酵作用、光反應、固碳反應; in 115 Q32, the ATP components. Handle them as clearly labelled previews.
- Units 24–27 are kept only as an optional 'beyond 學測' track (in_gsat = no).

**Unchecked report sections**
- Recent_trends and common_misconceptions were spot-checked against CEEC rubric pages and held up.
- The resources section was only partly checked. Servier, NIAID, TaiCOL and the 樂詞網 terms were not re-verified.

research.subject: 地球科學 (Earth Science) + 自然科學探究與實作 (cross-subject Inquiry & Practice) in 116學年度學測 自然考科
research.scope_summary: Earth Science is formally part of 學測 自然考科. The 116學年度簡章 (初版 115-08-04) gives the 自然 scope as 必修物理、必修化學、必修生物、必修地球科學 (含探究與實作). It states that the four subjects are set to carry roughly equal shares of the score, and that the paper includes 探究與實作 learning content. The 116 學測 runs 116-01-22 to 116-01-24 (Jan 22–24, 2027). 自然 is a 110-minute paper on 1/22 starting 12:50. 學測 is the only 大考 that tests 地科: the 116 分科測驗 science papers are 物理、化學、生物 only. In past papers, 地科 takes about one quarter of the paper. 112–114 each had 9 地科 choice items (18 of 128 points) in Part 1, and in Part 2 each year had one 地科 題組 plus at least one cross-subject 題組 that includes 地科. In 115, 2 of the 8 non-choice items were 地科 (Q50, Q54). The 部定必修地球科學 is only 2 學分. Its official content list has 42 學習內容 items in 12 次主題, with 參考節數 totalling 32 class periods. This makes it compact and high-yield for a course site, so including it is strongly recommended. 自然科學探究與實作 is a cross-subject required component worth 4 of the 12 必修 自然 credits. It has no alphanumeric codes: it is organized as 4 探究學習內容 strands (發現問題、規劃與研究、論證與建模、表達與分享) plus 實作學習內容, linked to the coded 第五學習階段 學習表現 (ti/tr/tc/tm/po/pe/pa/pc/ai/ah/an-Ⅴc). 大考中心 does not test it as a separate section. Instead it is built into subject items, especially Part 2 混合題 題組: data and graph reading, identifying variables, plotting data, and short written justifications. The units below list the 地科 必修 items in the official listing order. The 領綱 itself says this order is not a required teaching order. After them come 探究與實作 units, an exam-skills unit, and a 選修 地科 unit marked not-in-學測.
research.exam_format: 116學年度學測 自然考科 (officially confirmed parts): date 116-01-22 (Fri, Jan 22, 2027), 12:50 start, 110 minutes. Scope is 必修 物理/化學/生物/地球科學 (含探究與實作), with the four subjects set to carry roughly equal score shares. Allowed question types: 單選, 多選, 混合題 (a 題組 mixing choice and non-choice items; the CEEC FAQ says usually 2–4 小題), and 非選擇題. Multi-select items are scored per option: with k wrong options the item earns (n−2k)/n of its points, floored at 0. Results are reported on a 15-級分 scale: the 級距 is the mean raw score of the top 1% of examinees divided by 15. A 60-級分 version is also issued for 分發入學. Design spec in the 考試說明 (111學年度起適用, 108年9月, still the newest listed on CEEC as of 115-11-12): Part 1 (第壹部分) has about 32–36 choice items; Part 2 (第貳部分) has about 6 混合題/非選 題組; choice items carry about 70–80% of the score and non-choice about 20–30%. Actual recent papers: 112, 113, 114 and 115 all had Part 1 = Q1–36 at 2 points each (72 points) and Part 2 = 6 題組 worth 56 points, total 128 raw points. 112 Part 2 had 16 choice items (32 points) and 8 non-choice (24 points). 113 had 12 choice (24) and 8 non-choice (32). 114 had 12 choice (24) and 9 non-choice (32). 115 had 8 non-choice items, 2 per subject (物理 Q49, Q53; 化學 Q42, Q46; 生物 Q38, Q41; 地科 Q50, Q54), each worth 4 points, for 32 points total. Non-choice answers must show calculations or reasoning, and may ask for plotting on a grid or explanations of no more than 20 characters. Subject distribution in Part 1 was 9 items per subject in 112–114, in blocks that change each year: 112 地科 Q1–9; 113 地科 Q28–36; 114 地科 Q10–18. Part 2 always includes cross-subject 題組 (合科): 112 物/地 Q51–54 and 化/生 Q55–60; 113 物/生 Q40–43 and 化/地 Q50–53, with 地科 alone Q54–56; 114 生/地 Q40–43, 物/化 Q50–54, with 地科 alone Q44–46; 115 has a tides-and-tidal-power 題組 Q50–53 (Q50 classed as 地科, Q53 as 物理) and a meteorite-dating 題組 Q54–56. CEEC's official per-subject numbering for 115 Part 1 was not found. Caveat: the 116 brochure confirms scope, time and question types, but not the 128-point layout, which is inferred from 112–115 papers. CEEC says any change to exam time would be announced at least one year ahead.

key_facts.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

key_facts.claim: The NAER 課程手冊 states that 必修地科 is 2 學分 and that high school includes a 4-credit cross-subject 自然科學探究與實作 requirement. The 地科 選修 is two 2-credit courses: 地質與環境 and 大氣、海洋及天文.

key_facts.claim: 115 學測 自然 paper: 110 minutes. Part 1 is Q1–36 (單選 and 多選, 2 points each, 72 points). Part 2 has 6 題組 (Q37–56, 56 points); answers must show calculations or reasoning.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 115學年度學測 自然考科試卷
key_facts.evidence: Cover instructions; 第壹部分 / 第貳部分 headers

key_facts.claim: 115 had 8 non-choice items worth 4 points each (32 points), 2 per subject. The 地科 items were Q50 (plot tide-gauge data and compute the tidal range) and Q54 (pick the radioactive isotope unsuitable for dating meteorites and justify it in no more than 20 characters).
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 115學測自然 非選擇題滿分參考答案與評分原則
key_facts.evidence: Intro paragraph; 第50題, 第54題

key_facts.claim: 115 Q50–53 is a cross-subject 題組 about tides, tidal-barrage power (gravitational potential energy) and a float-and-magnet generator (electromagnetic induction). Q54–56 is about radiometric dating of meteorites and impact craters.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 115學年度學測 自然考科試卷
key_facts.evidence: 50-53 題為題組; 54-56 題為題組

key_facts.claim: 114 學測 自然: Part 1 has 36 items (72 points), 9 per subject (生物 1–9, 地科 10–18, 物理 19–27, 化學 28–36). Part 2 has 6 題組 with 12 choice and 9 non-choice items (56 points), for 128 points in total. 地科 題組 Q44–46 used 中央氣象署 typhoon forecast data; Q40–43 was a combined 生/地 題組 on ocean color and climate change.
key_facts.source_name: 選才電子報 第347期 114學年度學測試題特色 (114-04-28)
key_facts.evidence: 表1 and 第貳部分 description. Q44 P=42%, D=0.27; Q45 P=76%, D=0.46.

key_facts.claim: 113 學測 自然: 地科 was Q28–36 in Part 1. Part 2 had a 化/地 合科 題組 (Q50–53: early-Earth oxygenation and banded iron formations) and a 地科 題組 (Q54–56). Q31 (earthquake early warning) had P=55% and D=0.59. Q43 was highlighted as a direct 探究與實作 item on identifying variables and predicting results. Total 128 points.
key_facts.source_name: 選才電子報 第342期 113學年度學測試題特色 (113-04-15)
key_facts.evidence: Structure table and 地球科學 section

key_facts.claim: 112 學測 自然: 地科 was Q1–9 in Part 1, with a 地科 題組 Q41–44 (Mars-colonization context, absolute magnitude) and a 物/地 合科 題組 Q51–54 (environmental lead). The article states that the 地科 items built in 探究與實作 skills such as data analysis, explanation and drawing conclusions.
key_facts.source_name: 選才電子報 第336期 112年學測試題特色 (112-04-17)
key_facts.evidence: Structure and 地球科學 sections

key_facts.claim: Commentary from the 115 解題 teachers rated 115 地科 as medium-to-hard with high discrimination, with chart-based items about half of the 地科 section. Q34 (bio–earth) and Q50–53 (physics–earth) were cross-subject.
key_facts.evidence: Other commentators disagreed on difficulty, so treat this as opinion.

units.title_zh: 宇宙的組成與尺度、宇宙膨脹
units.title_en: Composition and scales of the universe; the expanding universe
key_concepts: Hierarchy of celestial bodies from below stellar scale to above it (stars, star clusters, galaxies, groups); the solar system's makeup can serve as an example
Distant galaxies receding, so the universe is expanding; the Big Bang (霹靂說) is the mainstream origin theory
Scope limit: simple introduction of scales and hierarchy only
depends_on: 國中 Ea-Ⅳ-2 (scales, e.g. up to light-years)
units.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

units.title_zh: 視星等、絕對星等、亮度與光度
units.title_en: Apparent vs absolute magnitude; brightness vs luminosity
key_concepts: Brightness as seen from Earth (亮度, 視星等) vs intrinsic power (光度, 絕對星等)
Explain the magnitude–brightness–luminosity relation from principles
Tested in 112 Q44 (definition of absolute magnitude)
units.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

units.title_zh: 多波段天文觀測與恆星顏色–表面溫度
units.title_en: Multi-wavelength astronomy; star colour and surface temperature
key_concepts: Different electromagnetic bands reveal different aspects of celestial objects; astronomy needs bands beyond visible light (kept brief)
A star's colour indicates its surface temperature (explained from principles)
depends_on: 國中 Ka-Ⅳ-10, Ka-Ⅳ-11 (dispersion, colour of light)

units.title_zh: 由地震波認識固體地球分層
units.title_en: Earth's internal layers from seismic waves
key_concepts: Graph of seismic wave speed against depth showing 地殼, 地函, 地核, 岩石圈 and 軟流圈
S waves cannot pass through liquid, which reveals the liquid outer core (no formula derivation)
Wave-speed changes distinguish 岩石圈 from 軟流圈
The medium's physical state and chemical makeup affect wave speed
Emphasis on physical layering; chemical layering may be mentioned
depends_on: 國中 Ka-Ⅳ-1, Ka-Ⅳ-2 (wave properties; transverse vs longitudinal)

units.title_en: Vertical variation of atmospheric temperature and pressure
key_concepts: Only the basic causes of the vertical temperature and pressure profiles
depends_on: 國中 Fa-Ⅳ-3, Fa-Ⅳ-4 (atmospheric composition and layers)

How diurnal motion looks from different latitudes
Annual motion treated qualitatively
depends_on: 國中 Fb-Ⅳ-1, Id-Ⅳ-3 (Earth's rotation, revolution and axial tilt)

units.title_en: Earth's unique habitability and the evolution of its atmosphere
key_concepts: Suitable distance from the Sun, temperature, liquid water, atmosphere and magnetosphere protection, compared with other terrestrial planets
Atmospheric evolution from early Earth to today; oceans and life changed the atmosphere's composition
Cross-subject link: 113 Q50–53 (化/地) on early oxygenation and banded iron formations

Radioactive decay at a regular rate (half-life) is one way to estimate absolute age
Exam link: 115 Q54–56 meteorite dating (choosing an isotope by half-life)

units.title_en: From continental drift and seafloor spreading to plate tectonics (history of science)
key_concepts: Told as a history of science: models are built up as evidence accumulates

units.title_en: Plate boundary types and their geologic processes
key_concepts: Three boundary types by relative motion: 聚合 (convergent), 張裂 (divergent), 錯動 (transform), with diagrams and examples
Differences in magmatism, metamorphism, geologic structures and focal distribution
Volcanic eruption styles are not covered

units.title_en: Evidence that Taiwan lies on a convergent plate boundary
key_concepts: Infer the boundary from Taiwan's geologic structures and earthquake focal distribution
May use the two subduction zones near Taiwan as examples
Avoid complex or unsettled details of Taiwan tectonic models
units.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

units.title_en: Water vapour, saturation and humidity
key_concepts: Saturation vapour pressure curve: warmer air can hold more water vapour (supersaturation not covered)
At saturation, excess vapour condenses or deposits; dew point
Relative vs absolute humidity; a wet/dry-bulb thermometer activity is suggested

Exam link: 113 Q34 estimated cloud-base height from temperature and dew point
units.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

units.title_zh: 氣壓梯度力、科氏力、摩擦力與風
units.title_en: Pressure-gradient force, Coriolis force, friction and wind
key_concepts: Qualitative meaning, size and direction of each force; no formulas or calculations

Convergence and divergence at surface highs and lows, and the weather they bring

depends_on: 國中 Ib-Ⅳ-1, Ib-Ⅳ-4 (air masses, fronts)

units.title_zh: 表面海流與盛行風
units.title_en: Surface ocean currents and prevailing winds

units.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

units.title_zh: 波浪成因與海岸地形
units.title_en: Origin of waves and their effect on coastlines
key_concepts: Causes: mainly wind on the sea surface, also submarine landslides and earthquakes
Wind waves vs swell: longer wavelengths lose energy more slowly and travel farther
Dangers of rogue waves (瘋狗浪) and pre-typhoon swell; wave effects on coastal landforms

Tracks steered by the Pacific High, mostly moving clockwise around it; impacts depend on track, terrain and circulation

Magnitude (規模) and intensity (震度) have different meanings and uses
Secondary hazards beyond direct shaking
Disaster response and early warning need seismic monitoring and location

Understanding the Earth supports economic, ecological, cultural and policy sustainability

key_concepts: Climate varies on multiple timescales (plate motion, mountain building, solar activity), shown with charts at different timescales
Sea level and temperature in glacial vs interglacial periods affect life and environments
Natural long-term drivers cannot fully explain recent rapid change; current evidence points to human activity as the main factor

units.title_zh: 探究與實作總覽：課程定位與七大跨科概念
units.title_en: Inquiry & Practice overview: course role and the seven cross-cutting concepts
curriculum_codes: 自然科學探究與實作 (no alphanumeric codes; 4 of the 12 部定必修 學分)
key_concepts: Cross-subject, theme- or issue-driven; hands-on work is the means and inquiry ability is the goal (not recipe labs)
Seven cross-cutting concepts: 物質與能量, 構造與功能, 系統與尺度, 改變與穩定, 交互作用, 科學與生活, 資源與永續性
Strands can be done in a cycle, not a fixed sequence
學測 tests it inside subject items, not as a separate section
depends_on: 國中 探究與實作 experience (1/3 of 國中 自然 time)

units.title_zh: 發現問題：觀察現象、蒐集資訊、形成或訂定問題、提出可驗證的觀點
units.title_en: Finding problems: observing, gathering information, framing questions, testable claims

related 學習表現 (planner mapping, not official): po-Ⅴc-1, po-Ⅴc-2, ti-Ⅴc-1
key_concepts: Observe with senses or instruments across time and space; guess possible causes
Gather information and judge source reliability
Turn observations into researchable questions and pick the priority one
Make hypotheses, predictions or models

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中：星系與銀河系
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Galaxies and the Milky Way
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Base for EEd-Vc-1 (scale hierarchy of the universe)

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中：太陽系、類地行星、月球公轉、日月食、月相
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Solar system, terrestrial planets, lunar orbit, eclipses, lunar phases
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed for EHa (solar nebula, habitability), EFb (apparent motion) and EIc-Vc-3 (tides)

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中：地球三圈、三大類岩石、大氣成分與分層、海水特性
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Earth's spheres, three rock types, atmospheric composition and layers, seawater properties
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: EFa-Vc-3~5 assume these basics

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中：地層與化石、疊置與截切關係
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Strata and fossils; superposition and cross-cutting relations
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: The 考試說明 explicitly tags these with EHb-Vc-1/2 items

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中：內外營力、板塊、地震火山分布、地殼地函地核
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Internal and external processes, plates, earthquake and volcano belts, crust/mantle/core
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Base for EFa-Vc-1/2 and EIa-Vc-1~4

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中：氣團、氣壓與風、高低壓旋轉、鋒面、臺灣災變天氣、季風
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Air masses, pressure and wind, rotation of highs and lows, fronts, Taiwan's hazardous weather, monsoons
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Base for EIb-Vc-5/6 and EMd typhoons

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中：波浪、海流、潮汐
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Waves, currents, tides
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Base for EIc-Vc-1~4

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中：晝夜長短、太陽照射角度、四季成因（地軸傾斜）
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Day length, solar angle, seasons from axial tilt
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Base for EId-Vc-1 and EFb-Vc-1

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中：颱風、地震、山崩災害
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Typhoons, earthquakes, landslide hazards
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Base for EMd-Vc-1~4

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中：全球暖化、氣候變遷衝擊、減緩與調適、溫室氣體
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Global warming, climate impacts, mitigation and adaptation, greenhouse gases
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Base for ENb-Vc-1~4

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中物理：波的特徵、橫波與縱波
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Wave properties; transverse vs longitudinal waves
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: P and S waves (EFa-Vc-1); wind waves and swell (EIc-Vc-2)

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中物理：色散與物體顏色
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Dispersion of sunlight; colour of objects
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Star colour and temperature, observing in different EM bands (EEd-Vc-3/4)

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中理化：大氣壓力、氣體壓力與體積
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Atmospheric pressure; gas pressure and volume
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Vertical pressure profile (EFa-Vc-3); rising air expanding and cooling (EIb-Vc-4)

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中理化：熱的傳播（傳導、對流、輻射）、物質三態
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Heat transfer (conduction, convection, radiation); states of matter
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Condensation and saturation (EIb-Vc-1~3); heat in the atmosphere and ocean

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中理化：原子模型
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Atomic model
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Isotopes and radioactive decay for absolute dating (EHb-Vc-2)

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中：物理量、尺度與估計
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Physical quantities, scales and estimation
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Astronomical scales (EEd-Vc-1); reading data in inquiry items

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國中物理：感應電流
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Induced current from a changing magnetic field
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Cross-subject 地科–物理 題組 such as 115 Q50–53 (tidal generator)

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 數學基礎：科學記號、比例、讀圖表、指數衰減（半衰期）
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Math basics: scientific notation, ratios, reading graphs, exponential decay (half-life)

bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Magnitudes, scales and radiometric-dating calculations; plotting and computing in non-choice items (e.g. 115 Q50, Q52)

common_misconceptions.misconception: 學測自然 only covers 物理、化學、生物, so 地科 can be skipped.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The 116 簡章 scope includes 必修地球科學, and the four subjects are set to carry roughly equal score shares.

common_misconceptions.misconception: 探究與實作 is a separate exam section, or needs its own lab memorization.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: It is built into subject items: 考試說明 items carry both subject content codes and 探究與實作 sub-items, and Part 2 混合題 assess reasoning and expression.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Since 學測 is high-school content, 國中 地科 can be ignored.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The 考試說明 notes that question materials and the knowledge needed to answer may involve 國中 content, and its sample items cite 國中 codes such as Hb-IV-1/2.

common_misconceptions.misconception: The Andromeda Galaxy belongs to the Milky Way; stars in a constellation are all the same distance from Earth.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Andromeda is a separate galaxy. A constellation is a region of sky as seen from Earth, and its stars lie at different distances. Naked-eye stars belong to the Milky Way.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Wind direction is the direction the wind blows toward; the strongest typhoon winds are at the exact centre.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: 風向 is the direction the wind comes from. The typhoon centre is nearly calm, and the strongest winds are in the region just outside it. Near the surface the circulation is counter-clockwise.

common_misconceptions.misconception: More weathered rock is older; rock with less uranium is older.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Weathering depends mainly on rock type and environment, not age. Many rocks contain no uranium. Valid ordering tools are superposition, cross-cutting relations and fossils.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Carbon-14 can date meteorites or very old rocks.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: C-14's half-life (about 6,000 years) is too short: over billions of years the parent isotope is no longer measurable. Long-half-life systems such as U-238→Pb-206 are needed.

common_misconceptions.misconception: S waves travel through the whole Earth.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: S waves cannot pass through liquid. This property is used to infer that the outer core exists and is liquid.
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: Rising air cools because it meets colder air higher up.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Rising air cools because it expands, treated as adiabatic. This can bring it to saturation and form cloud.
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: Tides are caused mainly by the Sun.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The Sun–Earth–Moon system controls tides, and the Moon is the main cause of tidal variation.
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: Seasons happen because Earth is closer to the Sun in summer.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Seasons are mainly caused by the tilt of Earth's axis relative to its orbital plane (國中 Id-Ⅳ-3), which changes solar angle and day length.
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: Recent warming is just the same natural cycle as past climate changes.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The natural drivers of long-term climate change cannot fully explain the rapid change of recent decades. Current evidence shows human activity is the main factor (ENb-Vc-3).
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: Earthquake magnitude (規模) and intensity (震度) are the same thing.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The curriculum requires teaching them as distinct quantities with different meanings and uses. Exact definitions are not in the opened sources and should be checked against 中央氣象署 material before writing content.
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: 地科 is also on the 分科測驗, so it can be studied later.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The 116 分科測驗 science papers are 物理、化學、生物 only. 地科 appears only in 學測.

pedagogy_notes: Recommend adding 地科 as a fourth 自然 track. It carries about 25% of 學測 自然 by the equal-share principle, it is tested only in 學測, and its 必修 is just 2 學分 (42 items, about 32 reference periods), so it gives a high return for the time.

The 領綱 says the order of 主題/次主題 is not a required teaching order. The 課程手冊 recommends an Earth-system framework (geosphere, atmosphere, hydrosphere, space and how they interact) rather than isolated facts. A beginner-friendly sequence could be: space and scale (Ed, Fb, Id) → solid Earth (Fa-1/2, Hb, Ia) → atmosphere and ocean (Fa-3~5, Ib, Ic) → hazards (Md) → origins and climate (Ha, Na, Nb). The depends_on links in the units are planner inferences, not official.

Use the 學習內容說明 scope limits to stop content running too deep or too fast. Explicitly excluded are: seismic-wave formula derivations, celestial coordinates, atmospheric stability, dry and moist lapse rates, Southern Oscillation indices, volcanic eruption styles, supersaturation, and unsettled Taiwan tectonic models. Solar nebula evidence is deferred to the elective.
Use the official 參考節數 to size lessons: Ib weather 6, Ed astronomy 5, Ia plates 4, Fa/Ic/Md 3 each, Fb/Nb 2, and Ha/Hb/Id/Na 1.

Teach 探究與實作 through real Taiwanese data (CWA tide tables, typhoon forecasts, earthquake reports), because the 112–115 exams did exactly that. Build exercises that ask learners to name variables, plot points, compute from tables and write 20-character justifications.

There are no 探究與實作 learning-content codes. On the site, label lessons with the strand names (e.g. 論證與建模－分析資料和呈現證據) as the 考試說明 does. The 學習表現 codes (po/pe/pa/pc/t*-Ⅴc) can be shown as related outcomes, but the mapping is not official.

Cross-subject 題組 involving 地科 have appeared every year (with 物理, 化學 and 生物). Add explicit bridge lessons such as tides and tidal power with EM induction, radiometric dating with isotopes, early-atmosphere oxygen with chemistry, and ocean productivity and climate with biology.
The curriculum asks for history-of-science narratives with diverse scientists (e.g. continental drift → seafloor spreading → plate tectonics). This fits a professor–student dialogue format well.
Bilingual site: take English from 樂詞網 entries tagged 高中以下地球科學名詞 or 兩岸中小學教科書名詞 so the terms match school level. Note variant characters (濕/溼, 周/週).
Many beginners lack 國中 地科, which is only 2/18 of 國中 自然 time. Add a short 國中 bridge module (Ed, Fa, Fb, Hb, Ia, Ib, Ic, Id, Md, Nb codes) before each 高中 unit.

recent_trends.trend: Every year 112–115 had a Part 2 題組 combining 地科 with another subject: 112 物/地 Q51–54; 113 化/地 Q50–53; 114 生/地 Q40–43; 115 tides and tidal power with physics Q50–53.
Items increasingly use authentic Taiwanese observation data: 中央氣象署 typhoon forecasts (114 Q44–46), tide-gauge records (115 Q50–53) and earthquake early warning (113 Q31).
Non-choice weight settled at 32 of 128 points from 113 to 115. In 115 each subject had 2 four-point items, including plotting graphs and word-limited explanations.
Commentators described 115 地科 as chart-heavy (about half of the items) with high discrimination. Views on its difficulty differ across sources.
Themes repeatedly cover natural hazards (typhoons, earthquakes, tsunami), energy and sustainability (tidal power), and early-Earth and solar-system history (oxygenation, meteorite dating).
116 exam logistics: penalties for smart glasses and other electronic wearables are stricter. Bringing smart glasses to the seat means the session is not scored. This is not a content change.

open_questions: No 115學年度 學測 自然「試題特色」article was located on CEEC (the web-search budget ran out), so the official per-subject numbering for 115 Part 1 is unconfirmed. Commentary says Q5 was 地科 and Q34 was 生/地.
No 116-specific 自然 考試說明 or format change was found. The 128-point layout (36 + 6 題組) is inferred from 112–115 papers and is not guaranteed by the 116 brochure.
The 115 學測 工作報告 (item P/D statistics for 自然) exceeded the fetch size limit and was not read.
Textbook publishers' chapter order for 必修地科 (e.g. 龍騰, 翰林, 南一) was not checked. The 領綱 says its listing order is not the teaching order.

In which grade schools actually teach 必修地科 and 探究與實作 varies. The 總綱 table appears to place 自然 必修 in grades 10–11. A secondary claim that most schools run 探究與實作 in grade 11 was seen only in a search snippet and not verified.
The reuse license for the 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心 (GSMMA) data and its official English name could not be verified. The /en/ page returned 404.
Reuse terms for CEEC past papers, NAER curriculum PDFs and 樂詞網 were not verified, apart from the 考試說明 cover statement (non-profit use with attribution).
樂詞網 returned 0 hits for the exact strings 張裂板塊邊界 and 錯動板塊邊界. Standard English terms (divergent and transform boundary) still need a verified NAER source, as do 外地核 and 太平洋高壓.
Precise official definitions for 地震規模 vs 震度 (CWA) were not opened. Verify them before writing that lesson.

More searches could not be run because the session's web-search limit was reached. Follow-up searches are needed for 115 試題特色, the 選才電子報 351期 non-choice rubric details, and CWA and GSMMA dataset pages.

verification.subject: 地球科學 (Earth Science, 必修) + 自然科學探究與實作 in 116學年度學測 自然考科
verification.corrected_scope_summary:
Earth Science is formally part of 學測 自然. The 116學年度簡章 (初版 115-08-04) gives the 自然 scope as 必修物理、必修化學、必修生物、必修地球科學 (含探究與實作). Its 註3 says the four subjects are set to carry roughly equal score shares and that the paper includes 探究與實作 learning content. The 116 學測 runs 116-01-22 (Fri) to 116-01-24. 自然 is on 1/22, 12:50–14:40 (110 minutes). The 116 分科測驗 science papers are 物理、化學、生物 only, so 學測 is the only 大考 that tests 地科.

Every year from 112 to 115 (CEEC 選才電子報 336/342/347/351期), 地科 had 9 of the 36 Part 1 choice items (18 of 128 points), in blocks that move each year: 112 Q1–9, 113 Q28–36, 114 Q10–18, 115 Q1–9. Each year Part 2 also had one 地科-only 題組 and one 地科 cross-subject 題組:
- 112: 地 Q41–44; 物/地 Q51–54
- 113: 地 Q54–56; 化/地 Q50–53
- 114: 地 Q44–46; 生/地 Q40–43
- 115: 地 Q54–56; 地/物 Q50–53

部定必修地球科學 is 2 學分 in practice. The 總綱 and 領綱 allow 2–4 for each subject (at least 2), and the 課程手冊 A15 calls it 2 學分. Its official list has 42 學習內容 in 12 次主題 (Ed 4, Fa 5, Fb 1, Ha 3, Hb 2, Ia 4, Ib 7, Ic 4, Id 1, Md 4, Na 3, Nb 4). The 參考節數 total 32 class periods (Ed 5, Fa 3, Fb 2, Ha 1, Hb 1, Ia 4, Ib 6, Ic 3, Id 1, Md 3, Na 1, Nb 2). The 領綱 states that the listed order is not a teaching order.

自然科學探究與實作 is one third of the 12 必修 credits (4 學分). It has no alphanumeric codes. It has 4 探究 strands (發現問題、規劃與研究、論證與建模、表達與分享), each with named sub-items, plus 實作學習內容. 大考中心 does not give it a separate section. Its items are tagged with these strand sub-items, sometimes alongside subject codes and sometimes alone (e.g. 考試說明 Part 2 外傘頂洲 Q1). It shows up mainly in data and graph reading, identifying variables, plotting, and short written reasoning.

The 加深加廣選修地球科學 (4 學分: 地質與環境 2, 大氣、海洋及天文 2) is outside 學測 scope.
verification.exam_format_verified:
116學年度學測 自然 (簡章 115-08-04 初版, verified):
- Date and time: 116-01-22 (Fri), 12:50–14:40, 110 minutes.
- Scope: 必修物/化/生/地 (含探究與實作), with the four subjects at roughly equal score shares.
- Question types: 單選, 多選, 混合題 (a 題組 containing both choice and non-choice items) and 非選擇題.
- Multi-select scoring: with k wrong options the item earns (n−2k)/n of its points, floored at 0.
- 15-級分 scale: 級距 = mean raw score of the top 1% of examinees ÷ 15. A 60-級分 version (÷60) is used for 分發入學, and 60-級分 score lookup opens 116-04-08.

考試說明 (111學年度起適用, 108年9月; still the only 自然 version listed on CEEC, page footer 115-11-12):
- Part 1: about 32–36 choice items. Part 2: about 6 混合/非選 題組.
- Choice items about 70–80% of the score, non-choice about 20–30%.
- Materials may draw on 國中 content, but 國中 content is not the main object of question design.

CEEC FAQ: a 混合題 usually has 2–4 小題, starting with choice items and moving to non-choice. Any change to exam time is to be announced at least 1 year in advance.

Actual papers (CEEC 選才電子報 336, 342, 347 and 351期, plus the 115 paper and rubric): 112–115 all had Part 1 = Q1–36 at 2 points each (72) and Part 2 = 6 題組 (56), for 128 points total.

Part 2 make-up by year:

| Year | Choice items (points) | Non-choice items (points) |
|---|---|---|
| 112 | 16 (32) | 8 (24) |
| 113 | 12 (24) | 8 (32) |
| 114 | 12 (24) | 9 (32) |
| 115 | 12 (24) | 8 (32) |

115 details:
- Non-choice items were 4 points each: 生 Q38, Q41; 化 Q42, Q46; 物 Q49, Q53; 地 Q50 (plot tide data and compute the tidal range) and Q54 (tick C-14 and justify in no more than 20 characters).
- Official Part 1 blocks: 地 1–9, 物 10–18, 化 19–27, 生 28–36.
- Official Part 2 題組: 37–39 生, 40–43 生/化, 44–46 化, 47–49 物, 50–53 地/物, 54–56 地.

Non-choice answers must show calculations or reasoning, or marks are deducted. The 128-point layout for 116 is inferred from 112–115 and is not guaranteed by the 116 brochure.

confirmed_facts.claim: 116學測 runs 116-01-22 (Fri) to 116-01-24. 自然 is 110 minutes, 12:50–14:40 on 1/22. The brochure is 初版 dated 115年8月4日.
The 116 自然 scope is 必修物理、必修化學、必修生物、必修地球科學（含探究與實作）. 註3 says the four subjects 以占分比例相當為原則 and the paper includes 探究與實作 learning content.
Question types are 選擇題型 (單選, 多選), 選填 (數學 only), 混合題型 and 非選擇題型. A 混合題型 is a 題組 that contains both choice (or 選填) items and non-choice items.
Multi-select scoring is (n−2k)/n of the item's points, floored at 0. The 15-級分 級距 is the mean raw score of the top 1% of examinees ÷ 15. A 60-級分 version (÷60) is used for 分發入學.
The 116 分科測驗 science papers are 物理、化學、生物 only, with no 地科. 註2 says all three include 探究與實作 learning content.
考試說明 (111學年度起適用, 中華民國108年9月) 表一: the 學測 自然 scope is the 12 部定必修 credits, with each of 物/化/生/地 at 2–4 學分 and 含探究與實作.
考試說明 二、題型與配分: Part 1 has about 32–36 choice items; Part 2 has about 6 混合/非選 題組; choice items carry about 70–80% of the score and non-choice about 20–30%.
考試說明: question materials and the background knowledge needed may involve 國中 content, but 國中 content is not the main object of question design.

The test objectives have 5 大項 with sub-items 1a–1d, 2a–2c, 3a–3d, 4a–4d and 5a–5c; the wording of 3c, 3d and 4d matches the report. The 地科 sample items 1–4 carry subject codes. The typhoon-buoy item is tagged 論證與建模－解釋和推理, the 金門 tide item 發現問題－形成或訂定問題 and 論證與建模－提出結論或解決方案, and the dating item also cites 國中 Hb-IV-1/2. The Part 2 外傘頂洲 items are tagged 規劃與研究－尋找變因或條件 and 表達與分享－評價與省思.
The 考試說明 cover says copyright belongs to 大考中心基金會: non-profit use is allowed with attribution, and commercial use needs prior written consent.
CEEC FAQ Q5: a 混合題型 is a 題組, generally of 2–4 小題, that moves from choice to non-choice items. Q9: any change to exam time will be announced at least 1 year ahead.
The CEEC 考試說明 page lists only the 111學年度 version for 學測 自然. Only 英文 has a newer (115學年度起適用) 學測 revision. The site footer reads 更新日期 115-11-12.

自然領綱 (中華民國107年11月) 參、時間分配:
- 國中 time split is 生物 6/18, 理化 10/18, 地球科學 2/18.
- 高中 部定必修 is 12 學分, of which one third is cross-subject 探究與實作; each subject is listed at 2–4.
- 加深加廣 electives total 32 學分, including 選修地球科學 4 (地質與環境 2, 大氣、海洋及天文 2).

confirmed_facts.claim: The 115 自然 paper is 110 minutes. Part 1 (Q1–36) has 單選 and 多選 items at 2 points each (72 points). Part 2 has 6 題組 (56 points), and answers must show calculations or reasoning. Q50–53 is a tides and tidal-power/induction 題組; Q54–56 is a meteorite-dating and crater 題組 whose table gives the C-14 half-life as ～6千年.

115 had 8 non-choice items at 4 points each (32 points): 物 Q49, Q53; 化 Q42, Q46; 生 Q38, Q41; 地 Q50, Q54. Q50 asks for a plot plus the tidal range 1.75−(−1.5)=3.25. Q54 asks learners to tick 碳14 and give a reason (半衰期太短…) in no more than 20 characters.

114 (第347期, 114-04-28):
- Part 1: 生 1–9, 地 10–18, 物 19–27, 化 28–36.
- Part 2: 12 choice and 9 non-choice items (56 points); 生/地 Q40–43 (ocean colour and climate change); 地 Q44–46 (中央氣象署 typhoon forecast data); 物/化 Q50–54.
- Item statistics: Q44 P=42%, D=0.27; Q45 P=76%, D=0.46.

113 (第342期, 113-04-15):
- Part 1: 生 1–9, 化 10–18, 物 19–27, 地 28–36.
- Q31 (earthquake early warning): P=55%, D=0.59. Q34 estimates cloud-base height from temperature and dew point.
- Part 2: 物/生 Q40–43 (Q43 is a direct 探究與實作 item on variables and predicting results); 化/地 Q50–53 (大氧化事件 and banded iron formations); 地 Q54–56. Total 128 points.

112 (第336期, 112-04-17):
- Part 1: 地 Q1–9.
- Part 2: 地 Q41–44 (Mars-settlement context; Q44 on absolute magnitude); 物/地 Q51–54 (environmental lead); 16 choice items (32 points) and 8 non-choice (24 points).
- The article says the 地科 items 融入探究與實作 (分析資料和呈現證據、解釋和推理、提出結論或解決方案).

115 (第351期, 115-04-15, official):
- Part 1: 地 1–9, 物 10–18, 化 19–27, 生 28–36.
- Part 2: 37–39 生, 40–43 生/化, 44–46 化, 47–49 物, 50–53 地/物, 54–56 地; 12 choice items (24 points) and 8 non-choice (32 points); total 128.
- 地科 highlights: Q4 (everyday context), Q5 (data from a figure), Q7–8 (311 earthquake), Q9 (pollen/spore climate record), Q50 (plotting), Q54 (dating question changed to non-choice).

115 非選 rubric article (第351期): on Q50 most students plotted correctly but only about half computed the tidal range correctly. On Q54 about 60% ticked C-14, and about half left the reason blank or gave a wrong one.
聯合報 2026-01-17 (secondary, teacher opinion): 地科 rated 中間偏難, high discrimination, chart-based items about half the section. The article treats Q34 and Q50–53 as drawing on 地科.

corrections.original: The NAER 課程手冊 states 必修地科 is 2 學分 (evidence: 拾、課綱Q&A A16–A17).
corrections.correction: The claim is right but the citation is off. The '高中地科必修科目（2學分）' wording is in A15. A17 says each subject is 2~4 學分, which leaves room for the 領綱. The 4-學分 探究與實作 figure is on p.317. Formally, the 總綱 and 領綱 allow 2–4 per subject with a minimum of 2.

corrections.original: The CWA website content is licensed for any purpose including commercial use; some audio, video, images and commissioned articles are excluded.
corrections.correction: The CWA page itself does not use the word 'commercial'. It allows use to develop products or services, and the linked 政府資料開放授權條款 says 'any purpose'. Only works the agency specifically marks as needing consent are excluded, not all audio, video or images.

corrections.original: Unit 27 depends_on: 國中 探究與實作 experience (1/3 of 國中 自然 time).
corrections.correction: The 領綱 says 國中 should have one third of periods as 實作體驗課 (實施要點). Separately, each 國中 semester must include at least one cross-subject 探究與實作 unit. It does not say 探究與實作 is one third of 國中 自然 time. The 1/3 figure for 探究與實作 applies to the 高中 必修 credits.
corrections.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

corrections.original: 大考中心 does not test 探究與實作 as a separate section; it is built into subject items.
corrections.correction: Partly right: there is no separate section. However, some 考試說明 sample items are tagged with 探究與實作 sub-items only and no subject 學習內容 code (Part 2 外傘頂洲 Q1: 發現問題－蒐集資訊、提出可驗證的觀點; 規劃與研究－擬定研究計畫). So 探究與實作 can be the sole content target of an item.

corrections.original: Typhoon misconception: near the surface the circulation is counter-clockwise.
corrections.correction: This is true for the Northern Hemisphere (Taiwan). The 考試說明 explanation is set in that context, so the lesson should state the hemisphere.

corrections.original: Unit 4 depends_on 國中 Ia-Ⅳ-2 (crust/mantle/core, lithosphere); bridging Hb-Ⅳ-1/2 labelled 疊置與截切關係.
corrections.correction: Not wrong, but the code texts alone do not say this. Ia-Ⅳ-2 reads only 岩石圈可分為數個板塊, and Hb-Ⅳ-2 only 解讀地層、地質事件. The crust/mantle/core layering and the 原始水平/疊置/截切 rules come from the 國中 學習內容說明 in the appendix (PDF p.158). Cite the appendix, not the code text.
corrections.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

corrections.original: Bridging prereq 數學基礎：科學記號、比例… with codes not verified.
corrections.correction: Scale, scientific notation, choosing units and ratio reasoning are verified in the 國中 cross-subject theme 從原子到宇宙 (INc-Ⅳ-1 to INc-Ⅳ-4). Only exponential decay / half-life still has no verified curriculum code.

research.subject: 歷史 (History), as tested in the 學測 (GSAT) 社會考科 (Social Studies paper). Target sitting: 116學年度學測, 2027-01-22 to 2027-01-24.
research.scope_summary:
The 116學年度學測 is confirmed for 116年1月22日（五）to 1月24日（日）. Source: 大考中心 116學年度考試簡章, 初版 dated 115年8月4日. The 社會 paper is 110 minutes. Its scope is 必修歷史, 必修地理 and 必修公民與社會 (108課綱), and the three subjects are meant to carry roughly equal points ("占分比例相當為原則"). So history is about one third of the paper, which has been 144 points in 111, 114 and 115. The 加深加廣選修 history courses are NOT in the 學測. They are tested only in the 分科測驗 歷史 (116/7/10–11): 族群、性別與國家的歷史, 科技、環境與藝術的歷史, and 探究與實作：歷史學探究.

Governing curriculum: 十二年國教 社會領域課綱 (中華民國107年10月, promulgated 107/10/26 by 臺教授國部字第1070116490B號). The MOE law database lists no later amendment. 部定必修 歷史 is 6 學分 and must be finished within 10–11 年級. It uses a 分域 structure with three 分域 of 2 學分 each:
- 臺灣: themes A–E
- 中國與東亞: themes F–J
- 世界: themes K–O
Each 分域 has four themes plus one 歷史考察, and the themes are designed along a chronological thread (依時序脈絡). 大考中心's 社會考科考試說明 (111學年度起適用, 108年9月) lists all 15 history themes, including 歷史考察（一）–（三）, as the test scope, and tags its sample items with these 學習內容 codes (e.g., 歷 Bb-Ⅴ-1).

Because senior-high history is thematic, the chronological backbone a beginner needs is the 國中 history. It is a 長時段通史, also split into three equal 分域 (主題 A–R, codes 歷X-Ⅳ-n), plus 國小 社會 items Cb-Ⅱ/Ⅲ and Cd-Ⅲ. Recent papers (111–115) emphasize several skills:
- source reading (史料判讀)
- chronology and cause/change (時序、因果變遷)
- distinguishing fact, evidence and interpretation
- comparing historians' viewpoints
- reading charts, maps and images
They also show a rising share of cross-subject (合科) and mixed or written items: 第貳部分 rose from 52 points (111) to 60 (114) to 68 (115).
research.exam_format:
Source: 116 簡章, unless noted.

Overall:
- 學測 is 116/1/22 (五) to 1/24 (日). 社會 is 110 minutes. My reading of the timetable puts 社會 on 1/24 (日), 12:50–14:40.
- Allowed item types: 選擇題 (單選題, 多選題), 混合題 (a 題組 that mixes choice and written items) and 非選擇題.
- The 社會考科考試說明 (111起適用) adds two rules: written items should carry about 20–30% of the points, and history, geography and civics should be balanced.

Actual papers:
- 111學測: 67 items. 第壹部分 had 46 單選 (92 pts, including 10 題組). 第貳部分 had 9 混合題組: 11 單選 (22 pts) and 10 非選 (30 pts), 52 pts in total. The sum is 144 pts.
- 114學測: 第貳部分 had 8 混合題組: 12 單選 (24 pts) and 10 非選 (36 pts), 60 pts in total. History had 18 choice items and 3 written items. Cross-subject (合科) items were about 56% of all items.
- 115學測: 第壹部分 was Q1–38 單選 at 2 pts each, 76 pts. 第貳部分 was 11 題組 (Q39–65): 16 單選 and 11 非選, 68 pts. Total 144.
- 115 history items: single-subject choice Q7–15 (9 items); two history 混合題組 (Q43–46); about 8 more history items inside 合科題組 (e.g., 30–33 史地公, 53–54 史地, 61–63 史地公).

Scoring rules:
- 多選題: answering k options wrong earns (n−2k)/n of the item's points.
- 非選擇題: graded on rubric levels 2/1/0. The 考試說明 samples give full credit only for the exact term (e.g., 「冷戰」). An approximate description (e.g., 美蘇對抗) gets partial credit.

key_facts.claim: 115學測社會: 110 minutes. 第壹部分 is Q1–38 單選 at 2 pts each, 76 pts. 第貳部分 is 11 混合/非選 題組 worth 68 pts.
key_facts.source_name: 115學年度學測社會考科試題

key_facts.claim:
大考中心's 115 analysis rates history as moderate in difficulty, evenly spread across the three 必修 volumes and the eras, with charts, maps and images as materials. Selected items:
- Q8: 清代 place-name statistics table, 得分率 43%
- Q44: the 'impact–response' (衝擊—反應) viewpoint applied to the Boxers, 40%
- Q53: 劉銘傳 railway terrain map, 75%
- Q61: ancient epidemics, 71%
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 115學年度學科能力測驗試題特色－【社會】

key_facts.claim: 114學測: history had 18 choice and 3 written items. 合科 items were about 56% of all items. Sources used included research writing, artifacts and sites, data charts, trade documents, 方志 and official notices. 第貳部分 had 8 題組 worth 60 pts.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 114學年度學科能力測驗試題特色－【社會】

key_facts.claim: 111學測 (first 108課綱 sitting): 67 items. 第壹部分 had 46 單選 (92 pts); 第貳部分 had 9 混合題組 (52 pts). History single items were Q5–17. 大考中心 described history as drawing on varied materials, using scenario-based items, stressing text reading, and emphasizing interaction between 分域 and period context.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 111年學科能力測驗試題特色－【社會】

key_facts.claim: 113學測: according to the exam-setting (闈內) teachers, history tested chronology, cause and change, and historical interpretation. Materials included statistical charts, tables, maps and photos, and there were cross-subject 題組 (coffee in the 日治 era; 《寒夜三部曲》; Turkey).

112學測: a 補教 team judged the history section 中間偏難, reading-heavy and full of source interpretation. Examples: Q9, a Persian tombstone found in 泉州 (宋元 era); Q19, Portuguese cultural mixing in the Malay Peninsula.

大考中心's 學測 sample items are tagged with 歷 codes. Examples:
- 歷 Db-Ⅴ-1: cutting the queue in 1913 臺中
- 歷 Ga-Ⅴ-2: 編戶齊民; the 資治通鑑 locust records
- 歷 Na-Ⅴ-1: Khrushchev's memoir vs a later history book on the Cuban Missile Crisis
- 歷 Ba-Ⅴ-2: Suniuo/中村輝夫/李光輝 and name rights
key_facts.source_name: 社會考科考試說明 參、試題舉例

units.title_en: Theme A: How do we know the past? (whose history, whose sources, who writes it)
key_concepts: Entry text: 誰的歷史？誰留下的史料？誰寫的歷史？
Begin thinking about history through questions: who are we, where from, and whose writing defines us
Who creates sources and why (historiography) underpins the H6–H8 skills
Suggested 2 periods
depends_on: bridge: 歷A-Ⅳ-1 紀年與分期

units.title_zh: B-a. 多元族群社會的形成：原住民族
units.title_en: Theme B(a): Formation of a multi-ethnic society: Indigenous peoples
key_concepts: Ba-Ⅴ-1: defining 'us', and the classification of 原住民 and 原住民族
How individuals, 部落（社）, groups and peoples define themselves, and how outsiders named and classified them in different periods
Briefly review 國中 coverage of each regime's indigenous policy
Ba-Ⅴ-2: the present situation of indigenous peoples and their assertion of rights; rights and cultural revival, 平埔族群 included
考試說明 example 14-3 (Suniuo's changing names → 姓名權)
Theme B: suggested 8 periods

units.title_zh: B-b. 多元族群社會的形成：移民社會的形成
units.title_en: Theme B(b): Formation of an immigrant society
key_concepts: Bb-Ⅴ-1: background and effects of early migration, focused on Qing-era migrants from 閩 and 粵: why they chose Taiwan, the sea crossing, and adapting after arrival
Bb-Ⅴ-2: post-war migrants from many places: mainland provinces, 滇緬, 大陳列島, and from the 1980s marriage migrants and international migrant workers
考試說明 examples: 粵人 settlement on the 屏東平原 and Qing 'divide and rule' ethnic policy; 金娘 and the 林爽文事件

key_concepts: Ca-Ⅴ-1: trade in Taiwan's history (the outward-facing core of an island economy)
Ca-Ⅴ-2: land questions in Taiwan's history: agriculture, forest industries and land issues, indigenous land included

key_concepts: Cb-Ⅴ-1: indigenous languages, traditional beliefs and rituals
Cb-Ⅴ-2: diverse beliefs: Buddhism, Daoism, folk religion, Christianity, Islam; conversions among indigenous and Han people and possible conflicts with their own traditions
Cb-Ⅴ-3: literature and art from traditional to modern, both indigenous and Han

key_concepts: Da-Ⅴ-1: from local to central: from local administration up to central constitutional government, and from authoritarianism to democracy, since the 17th century
Da-Ⅴ-2: the international situation and Taiwan's status, using treaties, declarations, resolutions and communiqués arising from wars (課綱 names the types, not specific documents)

Db-Ⅴ-2: post-war democratization and human-rights movements, including the rights violations of the 228 Incident and the White Terror, and the pursuit of transitional justice
Db-Ⅴ-3: post-war social movements: consumer, ethnic-equality, housing-rights, gender-equality and environmental movements

key_concepts: Choose a topic from B, C or D for deep inquiry, or plan and carry out a field visit or presentation
Suggested projects: Taiwan's 「歷史現場」; Taiwanese historical figures, paying attention to gender; cross-border marriage and migrant workers

key_concepts: How has the meaning of 「中國」 changed over history?
Did Chinese history develop in isolation?
How can Chinese history be studied?

units.title_zh: G-a. 國家與社會：國家的統治
units.title_en: Theme G(a): State and society: how states rule
key_concepts: Ga-Ⅴ-1: types of traditional political authority and how regimes justify their rule; example: the Han empire building authority through 祖宗家法, 儒術 or 律令, compared across periods and regions
Ga-Ⅴ-2: household registers, land or taxes-and-labor service, and state rule: registering households, measuring land, levying taxes and labor as ruling techniques
The 說明 says not to go into detail on the evolution of institutions
考試說明 examples: 編戶齊民 (from 封建 to 郡縣); 資治通鑑 juxtaposing locust reports (H8)

units.title_zh: G-b. 國家與社會：社會的組織
units.title_en: Theme G(b): Social organizations and the state
key_concepts: Gb-Ⅴ-1: forms of non-state (民間) social organization
Gb-Ⅴ-2: interaction between social organizations and the state
Use cases of organizations forming or dissolving to show state–society interaction
Consider people's possible fates under traditional political structures

units.title_zh: H-a. 人群的移動與交流：近代以前

key_concepts: Ha-Ⅴ-1: East Asian migration from 漢、晉 to 宋、元, driven by war, epidemic, trade or religion (Daoism, Buddhism)
Ha-Ⅴ-2: 明、清 migration, both state-directed internal moves and voluntary moves overseas; compare mid/late-Ming migration to Southeast Asia with Qing migration to Taiwan, 關東 and Inner Mongolia
Cultural effects: shifts of political and economic centers; spread of culture and religion
Theme H: suggested 10 periods
depends_on: bridge: 歷Ha-Ⅳ-2, 歷Hb-Ⅳ-1, 歷Hb-Ⅳ-2, 歷Ia-Ⅳ-1, 歷Ia-Ⅳ-2

units.title_zh: H-b. 人群的移動與交流：近代以後的移民
units.title_en: Theme H(b): Migration in East Asia since the 19th century
key_concepts: Koreans moving to China; Japanese settlement of Hokkaido and emigration mainly to the Americas; after 甲午 (Sino-Japanese War), planned Japanese migration to Taiwan, Northeast China and Korea
Chinese out-migration: laborers to the Americas, Europe and Southeast Asia; merchants to Japan and Korea
Muslim–Qing conflicts in 雲南, 甘寧青 and Xinjiang leading to emigration to Southeast Asia, Central Asia and Russia (考試說明 example 3-2: 雲南 Muslims → Burma)
Effects: cultural exchange (localization, cultures flowing back home), anti-migrant backlash, shifts in national identity
114 試題特色 calls 人群的移動與交流 a new perspective of 108 history

Ia-Ⅴ-2: responses to Western imperialism, compared: China's 自強運動, 變法運動, 立憲運動 and 辛亥革命; Japan's 明治維新; Vietnam's revolutionary movements

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 時間感：紀年與分期、年代圖表
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Sense of time: calendar eras, periodization, timelines
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Senior-high history is thematic, so learners must place each theme's examples on one timeline. The 國小 說明 recommends building chronology with year charts, using both 民國 and 公元 dating. 歷A-Ⅳ-1 compares calendar systems with the 公元 system and shows how periodization differs by region and viewpoint.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 世界地理定位（經緯度、海陸分布）
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Basic world map literacy (latitude/longitude, land and sea)
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Many history items sit inside 史地 or 史地公 合科 題組 and rely on maps (e.g., 115 Q53 terrain map, 考試說明 climate-chart items).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 臺灣史前文化與原住民族
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Taiwan's prehistory and Indigenous peoples
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Ba-Ⅴ assumes archaeology and oral tradition as sources, plus Austronesian migration and where the peoples live.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 大航海時代的臺灣
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Taiwan in the 16th–17th-century maritime East Asia
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Background for trade (Ca-Ⅴ-1) and for contact between indigenous peoples and outsiders. The 國中 說明 lists Europeans, indigenous peoples, and Chinese and Japanese smuggling traders.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 清帝國時期的臺灣
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Taiwan under the Qing Empire
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Bb-Ⅴ-1 (early migrants), Ca-Ⅴ-2 (land) and the 考試說明 items on 粵人 and the 林爽文事件 assume Qing ethnic policy, the farming–trade economy, and land loss among indigenous peoples.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 日本帝國時期的臺灣
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Taiwan under Japanese rule
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed for Da-Ⅴ-3 (education, language, 皇民化), Db-Ⅴ-1 (日治 rights and movements) and 115 Q30 (land and forest surveys and indigenous traditional territory).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 當代臺灣
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Contemporary Taiwan (post-1945)
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed for Bb-Ⅴ-2, Da-Ⅴ-1/2 and Db-Ⅴ-2/3. The 國中 說明 covers the ROC system moving to Taiwan, 228 and the White Terror, indigenous policy, Kinmen and Matsu, and Taiwan's diplomatic difficulties since the 1970s.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 從古典到傳統時代（商周至宋元）
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: China and East Asia from Shang–Zhou to Song–Yuan
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Ga-Ⅴ (types of authority, 編戶齊民) and Ha-Ⅴ-1 assume a basic dynastic timeline that the 高中 themes do not re-teach.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 從傳統到現代（明清、晚清）
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: From tradition to modernity: Ming–Qing and the late Qing
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Ha-Ⅴ-2 and Ia-Ⅴ compare reform movements and assume the late-Qing contacts and conflicts with the West, plus the post-甲午 political reforms.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 現代國家的興起與當代東亞
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Rise of modern states; contemporary East Asia
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Ib-Ⅴ-2/3 (communism in East Asia, regional integration) assume the founding of the ROC and PRC, Japanese expansion, and Cold War rivalry in East Asia.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 古代文化的遺產與普世宗教
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Ancient civilizations and the universal religions
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: La-Ⅴ and Ma-Ⅴ assume Greece, Rome, Africa and West Asia, and the origins of Buddhism, Christianity and Islam (e.g., 115 Q12 Egyptian tomb painting, Q45–46 Bamiyan Buddhas).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 近代世界的變革
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Early-modern transformations
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Lb-Ⅴ-1 and Mb-Ⅴ assume the Renaissance, the Reformation, the Scientific Revolution and Enlightenment, and European overseas expansion (Columbus, the Jesuits, the Mughals, the East India Companies).

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 現代世界的發展
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: The modern world: revolutions, imperialism, world wars
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Lb-Ⅴ-2/3, Mb-Ⅴ-3 and Na-Ⅴ assume the American and French revolutions, the Industrial Revolution, nationalism, imperialism, WWI, the interwar totalitarian regimes, WWII and the US–Soviet bipolar order.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 歷史思考入門：事實與解釋、史料因果
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Intro to historical thinking: fact vs interpretation; causal analysis with sources
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: These skills grow into the 高中 歷1b-Ⅴ-3, 歷1c-Ⅴ-1 and 歷3b-Ⅴ-3 skills that the 學測 objectives H6–H8 test directly.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 國小：臺灣歷史變遷、文化資產與民主化
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Primary school: Taiwan's historical change, cultural heritage, democratization
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Gives absolute beginners the first story: key events and figures, many cultures leaving heritage in Taiwan, migration and intermarriage, and the struggle for rights leading to democracy.

recent_trends.trend: Written and mixed items keep growing. 第貳部分 points went from 52 (111) to 60 (114) to 68 (115) out of 144, so written answers with exact terms matter more.
Cross-subject integration is now the main mode. In 114, 合科 items were about 56% of all items, and some items with historical texts actually tested civics or geography.

Source and data reading over memorization. 115 Q8 asked students to infer Qing governing priorities from a statistics table. 大考中心 advised against keyword-spotting and for building space–time context and evidence-based reasoning.
Historiographical viewpoints are tested. 115 Q44 applied the 'impact–response' (衝擊—反應) thesis to the Boxers (得分率 40%). 111 Q6 asked students to recognize a people-centered (social-history) viewpoint.
Varied source types: research writing, artifacts and sites, data charts, trade documents, 方志 and official notices (114); political cartoons; maps, photos and paintings (115).
Chronology, cause and change, and interpretation were the core targets named for 113, according to the exam-setting teachers (secondary report).

Human movement and exchange across seas and cultures is recurring: 112 Q9 (Persian tombstone in Quanzhou) and Q19 (Portuguese in Malaya), per a secondary 補教 report. 114 called 人群的移動與交流 a new perspective of 108 history.
Coverage across the three 分域 is described as even: 115 says distribution across the three 必修 volumes was 頗為平均, spanning all eras.

pedagogy_notes: Structure the course as 'backbone first, themes second'. 國中 history is a chronological 長時段通史, while 普高必修 history is thematic. A beginner should first get a compact chronological spine for each 分域 (國中 codes 歷A–R-Ⅳ), then the 15 senior-high themes. Each senior unit can reopen a 'timeline drawer' that links to the 國中 entries it assumes; the 課綱 itself tells teachers to review 國中 indigenous-policy coverage before Ba-Ⅴ-2.

Respect the official order but don't fake it. The 課綱 says the 學習內容 order is not textbook chapter order, and each 分域 is 4 themes + 1 歷史考察 designed along a chronological thread. Keep A→O as the canonical sequence and tag every lesson with its 歷 code, matching how 大考中心 tags sample items (e.g., 測驗內容：歷 Bb-Ⅴ-1).

Budget lesson length from the 建議節數: themes B–D, G–I and L–N are 8–12 periods each; A, F and K (2 periods) are framing-question lessons; E, J and O (4 periods) are inquiry or project lessons. That gives roughly 36 periods per 分域.

Frame contested topics through the 課綱's own questions:
- 歷A-Ⅴ-1 (誰的歷史？誰寫的歷史？)
- 歷F-Ⅴ-1 (in what context should Chinese history be discussed; how the meaning of 「中國」 changed)
- 歷K-Ⅴ-1 (why world history)
The learning-performance codes explicitly endorse examining contested events: 歷2c-Ⅴ-1 asks students to examine major disputed events and history's role as shared memory, and 歷3b-Ⅴ-3 asks them to explain why interpretations differ. So the professor–student dialogue format suits presenting two cited historians' positions and letting the student compare them.

Material guidance from the 課綱: include multiple perspectives; avoid stereotypes, bias, discrimination and authoritarian content; never write from a single ethnic or gender viewpoint; reflect current scholarship. The 說明 repeatedly asks for attention to historical figures of different genders.

Follow the 課綱's own wording:
- 「清帝國」 (not 滿清)
- 「日本帝國時期的臺灣」 (國中 theme E) and 「日治時期」 (高中 歷Db-Ⅴ-1)
- 「中華民國統治體制的移入與轉變」
- 「理蕃」 and 「國語」運動 in quotation marks
- 「西方」與「反西方」 in quotes
- 「原住民族」 including 平埔族群 and other indigenous groups
- 戰後 for post-1945
Where other terms exist in scholarship or public debate, name them as alternatives with citations rather than silently choosing one.

For 歷Da-Ⅴ-2 (國際局勢與臺灣地位), the 課綱 lists only document types: treaties from wars, declarations, resolutions, communiqués. The course should present the actual texts from primary archives with citations and set out the differing interpretations side by side. Do not assert a single legal conclusion.

For 歷Db-Ⅴ-2, the 課綱 explicitly includes the rights violations of 228 and the White Terror and the pursuit of transitional justice. The 國中 說明 adds victims of different genders and ethnic groups, effects on families, and the relation between truth and reconciliation. Use archival sources (e.g., 國史館 二二八事件檔案資料庫) and testimony with clear provenance.

Model the dialogues on 大考中心's sample-item types: change and continuity (queue cutting, 1913); historians' opposite judgments (Alexander); two sources with different aims (Khrushchev memoir vs a later book); a chronicle juxtaposing records to imply a judgment (資治通鑑 locusts). Each maps to H1–H9, so every dialogue can end with a 'which objective did we just practice' tag.

Teach written-answer technique explicitly. 大考中心 rubrics are 2/1/0 levels, and full credit often requires the precise historical term (e.g., 冷戰, 太平洋戰爭, 高砂義勇隊); paraphrases earn partial credit. Include bilingual glossary drills, but stress that the exam requires the zh-TW standard term.

Tell beginners not to over-memorize institutions. The Ga-Ⅴ 說明 says not to recite the evolution or details of institutions, and 115 analysis praised items that need no scattered facts. Emphasize mechanisms and comparisons instead, such as how household registration let states tax and conscript.

Build cross-subject 'bridges' into history units (historical maps, migration push–pull, economic concepts like comparative advantage or transaction costs), since recent papers place many history items inside 史地公 題組 (114: about 56% 合科).
Only the 部定必修 content is in scope for the 學測. Mark any 加深加廣 material (族群、性別與國家的歷史 etc.) as 'beyond GSAT / 分科' so learners aren't misled.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Senior-high history follows dynasties in order, like old textbooks.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: 108 必修 history is thematic within three 分域 (臺灣; 中國與東亞; 世界). Only the 國中 course is a chronological 通史, which is why learners need a chronological backbone.

common_misconceptions.misconception: A source written closer to the event is automatically more accurate.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: In 考試說明 example 12 the 'closer in time, so more correct' option is wrong. Both the memoir and the later book have their own argumentative purposes and must be judged as evidence (H7).

common_misconceptions.misconception: If two historians use sources, their judgments must agree.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Example 11 shows two historians giving opposite interpretations of Alexander. Both are interpretations, one negative and one positive (H6).

common_misconceptions.misconception: 「原住民族」 in the curriculum means only the legally recognized peoples.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The 課綱 defines it from a historical-cultural angle to include the legally recognized peoples, the 平埔族群, and other indigenous groups.
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/819/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-社會領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: The 學測 社會 history section includes the 加深加廣選修 history courses.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The 學測 covers only 必修歷史. The three history electives are in the 分科測驗 歷史.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Scoring well means memorizing policy names and spotting keywords.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: 大考中心's 115 analysis advises moving from memorizing policy names to structured analysis, avoiding keyword-spotting, and reading statistics and charts.

common_misconceptions.misconception: In 合科 題組, the history text is just background.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: In 114 several items used historical texts but actually tested civics or geography, and distractors mixed geographic terms with historical-narrative styles. Integrated reasoning is required.

open_questions: Which semester teaches each 分域 (臺灣 / 中國與東亞 / 世界, commonly called 冊一 / 二 / 三) is set by schools and publishers. The 課綱 only requires 6 學分 within 10–11 年級, and I could not open a primary source for the 冊-to-semester mapping (a 麗山高中 學校日 PDF returned 404).

No 116-specific change to the 社會 format was found. The 116 簡章 (初版 115/8/4) keeps the same scope and item types, but exact item counts and points for 116 will only be known after the exam. 大考中心 has not published a newer 社會考科考試說明 than the 111起適用 edition (108年9月), as far as I found.
大考中心's 112 and 113 試題特色 pages for 社會 returned HTTP 302 and could not be read. Trends for those years rely on secondary news (CNA for 112, a 補教 view; 1111/產經 for 113).

Exact history point totals and per-分域 item counts for each year (111–115) are not given in the official pages I read. 翰林's figure of 48 history points in 115 (24 from written and mixed items) is unverified.
The mapping of the 附錄三 建議節數 column to each theme was read from PDF layout. It sums correctly to 36 per 分域, but should be double-checked against the printed page.

樂詞網 has no entries for 二二八事件, 白色恐怖, 平埔族, 南島語族, 辛亥革命, 朝貢, 地理大發現, 歷史考察 or 加深加廣選修. 樂詞網 renders 轉型正義 as 'transitional equity' (行政學名詞). English for these terms comes from other official or secondary sites and needs editorial confirmation. Terms not checked: ASEAN, APEC, SEATO, 自強運動, 皇民化運動 (the English Wikipedia URL I tried returned 404).
The 國家教育研究院 社會領域課程手冊（定稿版） exceeded the 10 MB fetch limit, so its teaching examples and history guidance were not reviewed.
Reuse licences for the NAER 課綱 PDF, 樂詞網, 國家人權博物館 and 原民會 content were not verified. The 國家文化記憶庫 licence is per item.
The 歷史考察 themes (E, J, O) are listed in 考試說明 表1, but their content is open-ended. How (or whether) the 學測 tests them beyond general inquiry skills is not documented.
The research hit the per-turn web-search limit, so some planned checks (more terminology, 113 official analysis, publisher tables of contents) were not done. A follow-up run can continue them.

verification.subject: 歷史 (History) as tested in the 116學年度學測 社會考科 (GSAT Social Studies, 2027-01-22 to 01-24)
verification.corrected_scope_summary:
Checked against primary PDFs, extracted locally with pdftotext: the 116 簡章, the 社會考科考試說明 (111起適用), the 社會領綱 (107年10月), and the 115 試卷 and 非選評分原則. Also checked the 大考中心 試題特色 pages for 111, 114 and 115.

Exam basics (116 簡章, 初版 115/8/4):
- The 116學測 runs 116/1/22 (五) to 1/24 (日).
- 社會 is 110 minutes, on 1/24 (日) 12:50–14:40.
- Scope is 必修歷史, 必修地理 and 必修公民與社會 under the 108課綱, with the three subjects carrying roughly equal points (占分比例相當為原則).
- The three 部定加深加廣 history electives are tested only in the 分科測驗 歷史 (116/7/11 (日) 08:40–10:00, 80 minutes):
  - 族群、性別與國家的歷史
  - 科技、環境與藝術的歷史
  - 探究與實作：歷史學探究
- The 簡章's reference list still points to the 111學年度起適用 考試說明 (113/07/29 更新). Only English (115起) and 分科數學 (114起) have newer guides, so the 社會考科考試說明 (108年9月) is still current.

Test scope per the 考試說明:
- It covers the 高一 and 高二 必修 courses, with items built from 學習內容 codes.
- 表1 lists all 15 history themes, A 如何認識過去 through O 歷史考察（三）.
- Written (非選) items should be about 20–30% of the points.
- History objectives are H1–H9; cross-subject objectives are S1–S5.

Curriculum structure (社會領綱, 臺教授國部字第1070116490B號, 107/10/26; no amendment listed in the MOE law database):
- 普高必修歷史 has 3 分域 (臺灣 A–E, 中國與東亞 F–J, 世界 K–O), each 2 學分.
- Each 2 學分 has 4 themes plus 1 歷史考察, designed 依時序脈絡.
- The 必修 courses are recommended (建議) to be taught 於兩學年內.
- There are 51 條目 in all. Every code and title in the report matches the official table.
- 建議節數: A2 B8 C10 D12 E4 | F2 G10 H10 I10 J4 | K2 L10 M10 N10 O4, i.e. 36 per 分域.
- 國中 history (themes A–R, 歷X-Ⅳ-n) is a 長時段通史 split into 3 equal 分域, with 2 歷史考察 each. It is the chronological backbone that the thematic senior course assumes.

Recent papers:
- All three sittings checked were 144 points: 111 (92+52), 114 (84+60), 115 (76+68).
- Choice items in all three were 單選 only. No 多選 were used, although the rules allow them.
- Written points were 30 (111), 36 (114) and 36 (115). The growth of 第貳部分 from 60 to 68 came from more 單選 inside 題組, not from more written items.
- History was 48 of the 144 points in 115 (翰林). Its written items were Q44, Q46 and Q52, 4 points each (official 評分原則).
- 大考中心 described 合科 items in 114 (about 56%) as similar to recent years, and counted 8 合科 history items in 115.
- Skills emphasized:
  - 史料判讀
  - 時序 and 因果
  - fact vs interpretation
  - historiographical viewpoints (115 Q44 衝擊—反應)
  - reading maps, statistics and images

corrections.original: 部定必修 歷史 is 6 學分 and must be finished within 10–11 年級.
corrections.correction: The 課綱 says each 部定必修 subject is 6 學分 and is recommended (建議) to be taught 於兩學年內 (授完); the 時間分配 table places it in 十、十一年級. The 考試說明 defines the scope as the 高一、高二必修 courses. So 'recommended within two years', not a hard 'must'.

corrections.original: Recent papers show a rising share of cross-subject (合科) items.
corrections.correction: 大考中心's 114 試題特色 says 合科 items were about 56% of all items, similar to recent years (與近年比例相近), i.e. stable rather than rising. The 115 試題特色 counts 8 合科 history items, slightly more than the previous year (比去年略多).

corrections.original: Written and mixed items keep growing (第貳部分 52→60→68), so written answers with exact terms matter more.
corrections.correction: Written (非選) points were 30 (111: 10 items × 3), 36 (114) and 36 (115: 11 items, 3 or 4 points each), about 21–25% of 144. The rise of 第貳部分 from 60 to 68 points came from more 單選 inside 題組 (12 → 16 items). 112 and 113 were not verified, so 'keep growing' is not established.

corrections.original: Scoring rule: 多選題 answering k options wrong earns (n−2k)/n (listed as part of the 社會 exam format).
corrections.correction: The (n−2k)/n rule is correctly quoted from the 116 簡章, but the 111, 114 and 115 社會 papers used only 單選 for choice items (115 試卷: 第1–38題 單選; 第貳部分 單選題每題2分). 多選 is permitted but has not appeared in these sittings.

corrections.original: 非選擇題: the 考試說明 samples give full credit only for the exact term (e.g., 「冷戰」); full credit often requires the precise historical term.
corrections.correction: This holds for 例題12-2(2), where only 「冷戰」 is full credit and 美蘇對抗 is partial. Other rubrics give full credit to 意義相近 historical terms: in 14-1, 高砂義勇隊/高砂特別志願兵/高砂義勇軍 are all full credit, while 臺籍日本兵 is partial. In 9-2, 平埔族群 or 馬卡道族 are both full credit. The 115 official 評分原則 also uses 等級2/1/0 mapped to points: a 3-point item scores 3 / 1–2 / 0, and the history items Q44, Q46 and Q52 are 4 points each, built from 2-point parts.

corrections.original: In 114 several items used historical texts but actually tested civics or geography.
corrections.correction: The official 114 page says 多題看似取材歷史文本，實則測驗重要的公民學科知能. Q31 and Q34 had geography or history-narrative distractors but tested civics concepts. The official text says civics, not geography.

corrections.original: 翰林's 115 figure (history 48 pts, 24 of them from written and mixed items) is unverified, seen only as a search summary.
corrections.correction: Opened the 翰林 PDF (text extracted). It states 歷史科總分 48 分中，非選擇題與混合題占了 24 分，比例高達 50％. This is publisher analysis (secondary). The official 115 評分原則 confirms the history 非選 items are Q44, Q46 and Q52 at 4 points each (12 points).
The 分科測驗 runs 116/7/10 (六) to 7/11 (日), all papers 80 minutes. 歷史 is on 7/11 (日), 08:40–10:00.

corrections.original: The 國小 說明 recommends building chronology with year charts, using both 民國 and 公元 dating.
corrections.correction: The 國小 說明 says making 年代圖表 is one effective way to build 時序概念, and that learning 也可以採取民國、公元等紀年方式. Using these dating systems is optional, not a requirement to use both.

corrections.original: 歷2c-Ⅴ-1 asks students to examine major disputed events and history's role as shared memory.
corrections.correction: Official text: 審視重要的歷史爭議事件，理解歷史作為共同記憶的政治意涵. It is specifically about the political meaning of history as shared memory.

corrections.original: 111 history single items were Q5–17.
corrections.correction:
Correct, but incomplete. The official 111 page also lists:
- a single-subject history 題組, Q26–27
- a history 混合題組, Q57–58
- a 史地公 題組, Q61–63, where Q63 is a history 非選 item (日治 集團移住)
In 111 Q6 (people-centred / social-history viewpoint), 答對率 was 79%.

corrections.original: 114 exam format gives only 第貳部分 details.
corrections.correction: 114 第壹部分: 42 單選 at 2 points each, 84 points, including 6 題組. 114 第貳部分: 8 混合題組, with 12 單選 (24 points) and 10 非選 (36 points), 60 points in all. Total 144.

corrections.original: Open question: no newer 社會考科考試說明 than 111起適用 was found.
corrections.correction: Supported by a primary source. The 116 簡章 (參考資訊) lists the 111學年度起適用 「考試說明」 (113/07/29 更新) as current. Only 學測英文 (115起) and 分科數學 (114起) have newer 考試說明.

corrections.original: Open question: the 冊-to-分域 mapping could not be confirmed.
corrections.correction: Partly resolved, from a secondary source. 翰林's 115 analysis labels 臺灣史 as 第一冊, 東亞史 as 第二冊 and 世界史 as 第三冊, and its chapter tags put 歷史(1) on 臺灣, (2) on 東亞 and (3) on 世界. Its 歷史(1) chapter order (原住民族, 移民社會, 帝國的邊陲, 臺澎金馬成為一體, 經濟的多元發展, 多元文化的形成) shows that publishers reorder themes, as 教材編選（二） allows. Which semester teaches each 冊 remains school-dependent.

corrections.correction:
Added these bridges:

- C-b: B-b, because Cb-Ⅴ-2 includes Han beliefs

corrections.original: 115 第壹部分 described only as Q1–38 單選, 76 pts.
corrections.correction: Add two details: 第壹部分 includes 5 題組, and the 11 非選 items total 36 points. 翰林 (secondary) also lists 34–35, 36–38, 50–52 and 55–56 as integrated groups with history content.
