confirmed_facts.claim: The 116學測 runs 116年1月22日（五）to 1月24日（日）. 社會 and 自然 are 110 minutes each. 國綜 and 國寫 are 90 minutes each; 英文, 數A and 數B are 100 minutes each. The 簡章 is the 中華民國115年8月4日 初版.
學測 社會 scope is 必修歷史, 必修地理 and 必修公民與社會 (108課綱). 註2: 三科試題以占分比例相當為原則. Allowed item types: 選擇題型（單選題、多選題）, 混合題型 (choice plus written, in 題組 form) or 非選擇題型. 多選 scoring is (n−2k)/n.
分科測驗 歷史 covers 必修歷史 plus 族群、性別與國家的歷史, 科技、環境與藝術的歷史 and 探究與實作：歷史學探究. It runs 80 minutes on 116/7/11 08:40–10:00.

The 考試說明 (111學年度起適用, 中華民国108年9月) defines the scope as the 高一、高二必修 courses, with items built from 學習內容. 表1 lists all 15 history themes, including 歷史考察（一）–（三）. 非選 should be about 20–30% (填充, 問答, 繪圖, 製表), and the three subjects balanced.
The report's paraphrases of H1–H9 and S1–S5 match the official wording.

confirmed_facts.claim:
115學測社會:
- 110 minutes.
- 第壹部分 Q1–38 單選, 76 points.
- 第貳部分 11 題組 (Q39–65), 16 單選 and 11 非選, 68 points.
- History single-subject items Q7–15.
- History 混合題組 Q43–46.

115 試題特色: history 難易適中 and evenly spread across the three 冊.

Item statistics:
- Q8: 43%
- Q30: 66%
- Q44 (衝擊—反應 / 義和團): 40%
- Q53 (劉銘傳 railway): 75%
- Q61 (古代疫病): 71%

There were 8 合科 history items. Advice: move from memorizing policy names to structured analysis, and avoid keyword-spotting.

114 試題特色:
- History had 18 choice and 3 written items.
- 合科 items were about 56%.
- Sources included 研究論著, 文物遺址, 數據圖表, 貿易憑證, 方志 and 諭告.
- 人群的移動與交流 is called a new perspective.
- Q39, a 1950 cartoon, had 答對率 70%.
- Q54–56 were on 大小租.
- 第貳部分 had 8 題組 worth 60 points.

111 試題特色: 67 items. 第壹部分 had 46 單選 (92 points). 第貳部分 had 9 混合題組 with 11 單選 and 10 非選 (52 points). History single-subject items were Q5–17. 大考中心 described the history items as 取材多元、情境入題、注重文本閱讀、強調分域互動與時代脈絡.
113 (secondary report, citing 闈內 teachers): history stressed 時序、因果變遷 and 歷史解釋. 合科 題組 examples were coffee (Q39–40), 《寒夜三部曲》 (Q47–50) and Turkey (Q51–53).
112 (secondary report): 補教 teacher 曾泰輯 judged history 中間偏難. Q9 was a Persian tombstone found in 泉州 (宋元); Q19 was Portuguese cultural mixing in the Malay Peninsula.
The 大考中心 歷年試題 page offers 學測 papers from 83 to 115 學年度, with 試題, 答題卷, 選擇題答案 and 非選擇題評分原則. Footer: 版權所有 © 2026.

verification.exam_format_verified:
Verified from the 116 簡章 (115/8/4 初版):
- 學測 runs 116/1/22 (五) to 1/24 (日).
- 社會 is 110 minutes, on 1/24 (日) 12:50–14:40.
- Allowed item types: 單選, 多選, 混合題 (a 題組 combining choice and written items) and 非選.
- 多選 scoring is (n−2k)/n of the item's points, floored at 0.
- 計分方式與滿分以試題本為準, so 144 points is customary, not fixed by rule.

考試說明 (111起適用, still current per the 116 簡章):
- Written items should carry about 20–30% of the points.
- History, geography and civics should be balanced.

Actual papers:
- 111: 67 items. 第壹部分 46 單選 = 92 points (10 題組). 第貳部分 9 題組 = 11 單選 (22 points) + 10 非選 (30 points) = 52. Total 144.
- 114: 第壹部分 42 單選 = 84 points (6 題組). 第貳部分 8 題組 = 12 單選 (24 points) + 10 非選 (36 points) = 60. Total 144. History had 18 choice and 3 written items. 合科 were about 56%, similar to recent years.
- 115: 第壹部分 Q1–38 單選 = 76 points (5 題組). 第貳部分 11 題組 (Q39–65) = 16 單選 (32 points) + 11 非選 (36 points) = 68. Total 144.

History in 115:
- Single-subject items Q7–15.
- History 混合題組 Q43–46.
- History 非選 Q44, Q46 and Q52, 4 points each.
- 8 合科 history items (official count).
- History was 48 points in all, 24 of them from 混合/非選 (翰林, secondary).

Recent 社會 papers have had no 多選 items.

非選 rubrics use 等級2 (完全給分), 等級1 (部分給分) and 等級0, mapped to points. Precise terms are sometimes required for full credit (例12 「冷戰」), but meaning-equivalent historical terms are often accepted (例9-2, 例14-1).

research.subject: 地理 Geography: the geography part of the 學測 (GSAT) 社會考科, 116學年度 sitting
research.scope_summary: The 116學年度學測 is on 116/1/22–1/24 (2027). 社會 is on Sunday 1/24 and lasts 110 minutes. Geography is examined only as 必修地理 under the 108課綱 (部定必修 學習內容 of the 普通型高中 社會領綱). The three 加深加廣 geography electives (空間資訊科技, 社會環境議題, 探究與實作：地理與人文社會科學研究) are tested only in the 分科測驗, not in 學測. In the 社會 paper, 歷史, 地理 and 公民與社會 are meant to carry about equal weight. Non-choice items make up 20–30% of the paper, and many questions combine subjects. 必修地理 is 6 學分 to be finished within two school years. It is built on three 主題: A 地理技能 (Aa 研究觀點與方法, Ab 地理資訊, Ac 地圖), B 地理系統 (Ba 氣候, Bb 地形, Bc 人口, Bd 聚落/流通/中地, Be 都市, Bf 產業, Bg 世界體系) and C 地理視野 (Ca 臺灣, Cb 東亞, Cc 東南亞或南亞, Cd 澳紐, Ce 伊斯蘭世界, Cf 歐洲, Cg 美國, Ch 中南美洲或漠南非洲, Ci 全球化). 田野實察 sits alongside these. One school's real schedule (師大附中 113學年度, 龍騰 textbooks) teaches A + 地形 + 氣候 in 高一上, B人文 + Ca + Cb in 高一下, and Cc–Ci in 高二上. Foundations a beginner needs come from 國中地理 (經緯度, 臺灣地形/氣候/人口/產業, world regions), 國中自然 (營力, 板塊, 氣團/鋒面/季風, 洋流, 四季) and 國小/國中數學 (比例尺, 統計圖表, 坐標). 大考中心's 111–115 試題特色 reports keep stressing map, chart and image reading (contours, hillshade/DTM, satellite images, climate charts, place-name maps), scenario and current-events contexts, cross-subject groups, and hand-written answers that include drawing.
research.exam_format: Source: the 116 簡章 and the 學測社會考科考試說明 (111學年度起適用, dated 108年9月). 社會考科: 110 minutes, on 116/1/24 (Sun) afternoon. Question types may be 選擇 (單選/多選), 混合題 (choice plus non-choice inside one group) or 非選擇. Non-choice formats can include 填充, 問答, 繪圖 and 製表. Non-choice items are 20–30% of the score as a principle, and 歷史/地理/公民 are meant to be about equal in weight. Actual totals, all 144 points: 111 = 46 單選 (92 pts) + 9 mixed groups (52 pts). 112 = 45 單選 (90) + 54. 113 = 35 單選 (70) + 9 mixed groups (74, of which 36 non-choice). 114 = 42 單選 (84) + 8 mixed groups (60, of which 36 non-choice). 115 = 38 單選 (76) + 11 mixed groups (68). Geography appears in three places: a geography-only 單選 block (e.g., 114 Q18–28), geography 題組, and many 合科 groups. 合科 share was about 56% of questions in 114 and about 40% of the score in 115. Geography non-choice tasks seen so far: tick a concept and justify it in 20–35 characters (e.g., 114 Q58 垂直分工), draw a symbol on a contour map (114 Q53), choose a climate chart and explain a hazard (114 Q63), draw a graduated-symbol map with a legend (112 Q62), draw an arrow on a map (111 Q64), draw a line graph of carrying-capacity change (115 Q63), and draw a rank-size curve (考試說明 example).

key_facts.claim: 112學測: over half of the geography items were chart or map items. Q62 asked students to draw a graduated-symbol map and design its legend. Q50–51 used 壽山 macaques with latitude/longitude, landform and carrying capacity. Overall difficulty was medium-hard, and some options used 課綱 terminology.

key_facts.claim: 111學測 was the first 學測 under the 108課綱 and introduced 混合題 (21 items). Geography kept map, chart and photo reading at its core. 地理系統 units appeared most, and the paper did not favour any textbook version. Q20 was a 問題探究 scenario using old telephone directories.

common_misconceptions.misconception: 學測地理 also tests the elective courses 空間資訊科技, 社會環境議題 and 地理與人文社會科學研究.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: 學測 geography covers only 必修地理. Those three 加深加廣選修 are in the 分科測驗 地理 scope only.

common_misconceptions.misconception: GIS, remote sensing and aerial-photo interpretation are the same thing.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: In 考試說明 例題3-1, analysing mobile-phone location data to see clustering is a GIS analysis function (answer A). Remote sensing and aerial photos are different options, not the analysis system.

common_misconceptions.misconception: A primate-city distribution is drawn like any declining curve, concave-up shapes included.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The rubric for drawing Venezuela's rank-size pattern needs a concave-down line with the first city far above the second. A concave-up line scores 0. The explanation must link 殖民地式（依賴式）經濟 to 假性都市化.

common_misconceptions.misconception: On map-drawing items, a rough mark near the right place is enough.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: In 114 Q53, full credit needed a symbol matching the legend's shape and size, placed inside the 3920 m contour ring. A wrong size or position lost points.

common_misconceptions.misconception: 垂直分工, 垂直整合, 水平分工 and 水平整合 are interchangeable, and copying the question text counts as an explanation.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: In 114 Q58, 垂直分工 is identified by the cross-border upstream raw material → downstream product relation (Chinese barrel tomato paste as the raw material for Naples canned paste). Answers that only restate the stem got partial credit.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Vague everyday wording (e.g., 'transport disrupted', 'workers') is good enough in non-choice answers, and drawing extra arrows is harmless.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: CEEC's 111 rubric required the precise concept (國際分工, 勞力). Answers like 'low capital' for San Diego were wrong, and drawing two or more arrows when one was asked scored zero.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Map projections are a list of names to memorise.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The 課綱 says to teach projections by the distortion each one causes and when each is appropriate to use.
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/819/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-社會領域.pdf

common_misconceptions.misconception: 學測 geography is pure reading comprehension, so studying content is unnecessary.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: CEEC noted that in 112 some options used 課綱 terminology, so reading skill alone could not earn a high score. Familiarity with the course content was needed.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Geography only appears in the geography-only section of the 社會 paper.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Cross-subject groups are large: about 56% of all questions in 114 and about 40% of the score in 115. Many of them need geographic reasoning (e.g., 115 Q63, Q64–65).

common_misconceptions.misconception: Seasons are caused by Earth's changing distance from the Sun. (How common this belief is among Taiwanese students was not checked in any source.)
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: 國中自然 Id-Ⅳ-3: the four seasons are mainly caused by the tilt of Earth's axis relative to its orbital plane. Id-Ⅳ-2: sun angle changes the energy each unit of ground area receives.
common_misconceptions.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/820/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等校-自然科學領域.pdf

pedagogy_notes: Base the course spine on the 課綱 three-theme structure: 地理技能 → 地理系統 → 地理視野. Each 項目 ends in a 問題探究, which fits naturally as a professor–student dialogue capstone for every unit.
Size units with the 課綱 附錄三 suggested periods. 氣候 (8-9) and 產業 (7-8) are the largest, then 地形 (6-7), then 地圖 and Cc (5-6 each). 人口 is the smallest (2-3).

Teach maps before GIS. The real 龍騰/師大附中 sequence is 地圖 then 地理資訊, even though Ab comes before Ac in code order. 龍騰 also teaches 地形 before 氣候. Either works, but climate needs the 國中自然 Ib/Ic/Id bridge first.
Cover both options for each either/or item: Cc (東南亞 and 南亞) and Ch (中南美洲 and 漠南非洲). CEEC says papers avoid favouring a textbook version (111), and how either/or content is examined is unconfirmed.

Build an explicit chart and map reading strand that recurs in every unit: contour lines, hillshade/DTM, satellite images, photos of landforms, climate charts, place-name distribution maps, flow maps and statistical charts. These are the core of 111–115 geography items.

CEEC's 115 teaching advice: have learners turn information into charts and maps, and ask questions of a map (what causes this pattern, who is affected). Add 'draw it yourself' tasks: a symbol on a contour map, a graduated-symbol map with a legend, a line graph, a rank-size curve.
Practise CEEC's non-choice formats: tick the concept, then justify it within a character limit (20–35 字). The rubrics reward the precise concept word plus the causal link, not copied stem text.

Use the CEEC G1–G9 測驗目標 as a progression ladder for exercises. Start with recognising concepts (G1–G2), then applying them to new scenarios and reading data (G3–G6), then judging issues and proposing strategies (G7–G9).
Plan cross-subject bridges with 歷史 and 公民 modules, e.g., colonial economy (Ch) with 歷 Mb-Ⅴ-2/3, and trade policy with 公 Df-Ⅴ-2. Recent papers rely heavily on 合科 groups.
For total beginners, revisit the 國中 world-region basics (地 Ba-Ⅳ–Bi-Ⅳ) before the high-school 地理視野 units, and the 國小/國中 math chart and scale skills before 地理技能.
For bilingual terms, use 樂詞網's 高中以下地理學名詞 entries where they exist so the English matches Taiwanese textbook usage. Note any mismatch with 課綱 wording, e.g., 課綱 環境負載力 vs 樂詞網 負載力.

recent_trends.trend: 111 (first 108課綱 學測): 混合題 introduced (21 items). Geography stayed centred on map, chart and photo reading, with 地理系統 most frequent. Non-choice formats were explain, match and draw-on-map. 問題探究 scenarios appeared, and the paper did not favour any textbook version.

112: over half of the geography items were chart or map items. A new item type asked students to draw a graduated-symbol map and design its legend (Q62). Overall difficulty was medium-hard, and options used 課綱 terminology. Current events appeared (TSMC and supply chains, Solomon Islands).

113: the paper shifted toward Part 2 (74 of 144 pts in mixed groups). Non-choice share and 合科 share both rose slightly. Geography demanded more reading and integration (place names, the Russia–Ukraine war and Turkey, Los Angeles).

114: geography items built on basic concepts placed in new contexts. Items included a karst photo, a contour-map viewshed choice, and drawing a peak symbol. Non-choice items covered drawing, short argument and open causal analysis. 合科 was about 56% of all questions.

115: more emphasis on map and chart reading, following a read map → infer → state view sequence. Many map types appeared: a 崙 place-name map, flow data, satellite images, DTM, hillshade with contours, and climate charts. Context came from current events (US–China trade war, Russia–Ukraine war). 合科 was about 40% of the score, and one task was drawing a line graph.

open_questions: No 學測社會考科考試說明 newer than the 108年9月 version (111學年度起適用) was found. Confirm with 大考中心 that it still governs 116 and that no 116-specific adjustment notice exists. The web-search budget ran out before an exhaustive check of 2025–2026 announcements.
How does 學測 handle the either/or content: Cc (東南亞 or 南亞, choose one 問題探究) and Ch (中南美洲 or 漠南非洲)? Are items limited to shared concepts, or can either case appear? No official statement was found.

How the 6 學分 of 必修地理 are split across semesters varies by school. Evidence comes from one school (師大附中 113, 龍騰) and one publisher table: 高一上 / 高一下 / 高二上. Per-semester credits (e.g., 2+2+2) were not verified.
License terms for 國土測繪中心's WMTS / 國土測繪圖資服務雲 tile services (beyond the data.gov.tw MBTiles dataset) were not verified.
The 氣象資料開放平臺 (opendata.cwa.gov.tw) own terms, API-key rules and rate limits were not read directly. The page did not render.
Can past 學測 questions and figures be reproduced on a (possibly commercial) course website? The 考試說明 permits non-profit use with attribution, but terms for 試題 PDFs specifically were not confirmed.
Reuse license for 課綱 documents and for 樂詞網 term data was not verified.
樂詞網 had no entry for 時空壓縮 (time-space compression), 反吸/擴散效應 (backwash/spread effect) or 南島語族 (Austronesian). An alternative authoritative bilingual source is needed for these 課綱 terms.
合科 metrics are inconsistent across years: 114 reports about 56% of questions, 115 about 40% of score, and 111–113 give no percentage. Exact geography point totals per year were not computed.
Per-item answer statistics (選擇題答題分析) beyond the figures quoted in 試題特色 were not compiled. Geography items in the 113 試題特色 table could not be fully parsed.
Teacher and media commentary on 115 geography (e.g., udn reports calling it 中偏難 or saying Q49 was unclear) appeared in search snippets but was not opened. It is secondary and unverified.

verification.subject: 地理 Geography: the geography part of the 學測 (GSAT) 社會考科, 116學年度 sitting (exam on 116/1/24, i.e., 2027-01-24)
verification.corrected_scope_summary:
The 116學年度學測 runs 116/1/22 (Fri) to 1/24 (Sun). 社會 is on Sunday 1/24 afternoon, 12:50–14:40, and lasts 110 minutes (116簡章, 初版 115/8/4). The 學測 社會 scope is 必修歷史 + 必修地理 + 必修公民與社會 under the 108課綱, and the three subjects follow the principle of 占分比例相當. Geography is examined only from the 普通型高中 部定必修 地理 學習內容.

The geography 加深加廣選修 are tested only in the 分科測驗 地理. These are 空間資訊科技 (3學分), 社會環境議題 (3學分) and 探究與實作：地理與人文社會科學研究 (2學分; the 課綱 files it under the 探究與實作 category).

必修地理 is 6 學分. The 課綱 recommends 4–6 學分 of 部定必修 per semester and 2–3 學分 per subject, all finished within two school years. The exact semester split is decided by each school.

The 課綱 organises high-school geography under three 主題. Every 項目 ends in a 問題探究 條目:
- A 地理技能: Aa 研究觀點與研究方法 (Aa-Ⅴ-1~5), Ab 地理資訊 (Ab-Ⅴ-1~3), Ac 地圖 (Ac-Ⅴ-1~3).
- B 地理系統: Ba 氣候系統 (Ba-Ⅴ-1~5), Bb 地形系統 (Bb-Ⅴ-1~4), Bc 人口與環境負載力 (Bc-Ⅴ-1~3), Bd 聚落、流通路線與區域 (Bd-Ⅴ-1~4), Be 都市與城鄉關係 (Be-Ⅴ-1~4), Bf 產業活動 (Bf-Ⅴ-1~4), Bg 世界體系 (Bg-Ⅴ-1~4).
- C 地理視野: Ca 臺灣與世界 (Ca-Ⅴ-1~4), Cb 東亞文化圈 (Cb-Ⅴ-1~4), Cc 東西文化的接觸與區域發展 (以東南亞或南亞為例; Cc-Ⅴ-4 has two alternative 問題探究, 可擇一執行), Cd 澳紐 (Cd-Ⅴ-1~4), Ce 伊斯蘭世界 (Ce-Ⅴ-1~4), Cf 歐洲 (Cf-Ⅴ-1~4), Cg 美國 (Cg-Ⅴ-1~4), Ch 南方區域 (中南美洲或漠南非洲, 二選一; Ch-Ⅴ-1~5), Ci 全球化 (Ci-Ⅴ-1~5).

田野實察 appears three times in the 課綱 table: after Bb, after Cb and after Ci. Its periods are 依實際教學自行配置.

大考中心's 學測社會考科考試說明 (111學年度起適用) lists 地理技能、地理系統、地理視野、田野實察 as the geography 測驗主題. Items are drawn from coded 學習內容. Non-choice items carry 20–30% of the score as a principle.

The currently posted version of that 考試說明 is the 108.11.08更新 file, not the original 108年9月 file the report cited. In the update, 例題2-3 was changed: it now asks for Argentina's city-size curve on log–log axes, and the rubric requires a concave-up (凹口向上) primate curve.

Papers 113–115 each had 144 points, of which 36 were non-choice (25%). Geography appears in three places: a geography-only 單選 block (e.g., 114 Q18–28), geography 混合題組 and many 合科 groups (114: about 56% of questions; 115: about 40% of the score). Items keep stressing map and chart reading (contours, hillshade/暈渲圖, DTM, satellite images, climate charts, place-name maps, flow maps) and hand-drawn answers (symbols, arrows, graduated-symbol maps, line graphs).

Beginners need these foundations:
- 國中地理: 地 Aa-Ⅳ to Af-Ⅳ (Taiwan), Ba-Ⅳ to Bi-Ⅳ (world regions), Ca-Ⅳ/Cb-Ⅳ.
- 國中自然: Fa-Ⅳ-1~4, Ia-Ⅳ-1~4, Ib-Ⅳ-1~6, Ic-Ⅳ-1~4, Id-Ⅳ-1~3.
- 國小/國中數學: S-6-2 地圖比例尺, n-III-9, D-3-1/D-4-1/D-5-1/D-6-1, G-7-1, D-7-1/D-7-2.
- 高一數學: N-10-4 常用對數, needed for log-scale rank-size graphs.

corrections.correction: CEEC's 考試說明 page (111學年度起適用 entry) now links the 學測社會考科 file labelled '108.11.08更新' (file 0J305554304528923536 …-1101.pdf). Its cover is still dated 中華民國108年9月. A text comparison shows three geography changes: (1) 例題2-3 now asks for 阿根廷 (not 委內瑞拉) on log–log axes, with a reversed rubric; (2) 例題5-2's content label was fixed to 地Ba-V-5 問題探究：氣候、水資源與人類生活; (3) the 例題21 Turkey stem was rewritten. Use the 108.11.08 file.

corrections.original: Misconception item: the primate-city rubric needs a concave-down line, and a concave-up line scores 0 (Venezuela).
corrections.correction: This follows the superseded file. In the current 108.11.08 version, 例題2-3 asks for 阿根廷 with 都市人口數（對數值） vs 都市等級（對數值）. Full credit (等級2) needs the largest city to show primacy, with the overall curve 凹口向上 (concave up): a steep drop from city 1 to city 2, then flatter after city 3. 等級0 is given for 整體圖形凹口向下 or no primacy. The explanation keywords are unchanged: 殖民地式（依賴式）經濟 + 假性都市化.

corrections.original: Unit 10: 資訊革命與知識經濟 (Bf-Ⅴ-3) (例題16 烏龍茶 knowledge economy).
corrections.correction: 考試說明 例題16 (烏龍茶, testing whether students understand 知識經濟) is coded 地Bf-V-4 問題探究：產業發展與變遷, not Bf-Ⅴ-3.

corrections.original: Unit 19: 殖民地式經濟 (Ch-Ⅴ-4) (考試說明 例題2: Argentina/Venezuela raw-material dependence).
corrections.correction: No 例題2 sub-item is coded Ch-Ⅴ-4. 2-1 is 歷Mb-Ⅴ-3, 2-2 is 公Df-Ⅴ-2 and 2-3 is 地Be-Ⅴ-1. The colonial-economy idea appears in the stem and the 2-3 rubric only, so it can be used as an illustration, not as a coded Ch-Ⅴ-4 example.

corrections.original: 114 Q52: a viewshed / best viewpoint choice (44% correct).
corrections.correction: CEEC's 114 試題特色 describes Q52 only as a 選擇題 that 評量考生等高線判讀的能力, on a 玉山金門峒斷崖 contour map (得分率44%, 鑑別度0.34, 中偏難). The 'viewshed/best viewpoint' description is not in the CEEC text.

corrections.original: Unit 11 exam link: 115 Q49 (term 區域互賴).
corrections.correction: CEEC says Q49 (in the Q47–49 線量圖 group) asks students to infer changes in Russia's 互賴關係: trade with the EU and US falls, and trade with China and India rises. The phrase 區域互賴 is not used. The link to Bg-Ⅴ-1 is an inference.

corrections.original: Unit 1: 111 Q20 問題探究 scenario (inferring the inquiry topic from telephone-directory data); 'old telephone directories'.
corrections.correction: CEEC says 本題以某小組利用電話簿進行都市議題的探究, assessing information extraction and the use of directory data 探究都市發展. It is an urban (Be) inquiry item. 'Inferring the inquiry topic' and 'old' are not stated.

corrections.original: Misconception item: CEEC's 111 rubric required the precise concept (國際分工, 勞力).
corrections.correction: For Q60, the keywords are 技術 and 資本 (San Diego) and 勞工 (Tijuana). 勞（動）力 and 勞動資源 are accepted for 勞工. 工人, 人工 and 人力 are not credited, misspelled keywords get no credit, and 資本低 is wrong. Q60 is worth 3 points. Q64 is worth 3 points, and drawing two or more arrows scores 0.

115 學測: Part 1 = 38 單選 (76 pts, 5 題組). Part 2 = 11 混合題組 (16 單選 = 32 pts, 11 非選 = 36 pts; total 68). 合科 ≈ 40% of the total score. Geography 難易適中. Confirmed items: Q16 崙 map, Q18 flow/生活圈, Q19 satellite image, Q20 DTM, Q23 coffee climate chart, Q54 暈渲圖 + 等高線, Q63 carrying-capacity 折線圖. Teaching advice: turn data into charts and maps, and ask questions of maps.
114 學測: Part 1 = 42 單選 (84 pts, 6 題組). Part 2 = 8 groups (12 單選 + 10 非選 = 60 pts). 合科 ≈ 56% of question count. 表1: Q18–28 地理單題, Q52–53 地理混合題組, Q57–58 地公合科混合題組. Q24 karst photo 58%. Q28 Syria 52%.

114 non-choice: geography items are Q53 (3 pts; symbol must match the legend's shape and size, inside the 3920 m contour), Q58 (5 pts; 垂直分工 + explanation ≤30 字) and Q63 (4 pts; tick 丙, name 寒害/旱災/水災 in ≤5 字, give the cause in ≤20 字). All non-choice items total 36 points.

113 學測: Part 1 = 35 單選 (70 pts). Part 2 = 9 groups (19 單選 = 38 pts + 10 非選 = 36 pts; 74 total). CEEC notes 閱讀理解、概念整合與判斷的題數增加 and a rising non-choice and 合科 share. Confirmed items: Q14, Q16 (46%), Q17–18, Q53, Q63.

112 學測: Part 1 = 45 單選 (90 pts). Part 2 = 8 混合題組 + 1 非選 (11 單選 + 10 非選; 54 pts). Geography is 中等偏難, with options using 課綱 terms and over half chart/map items. Q50 uses 經緯度 to judge habitat landform and 景觀帶, Q51 is a non-choice 環境負載力 item, and Q62 asks students to draw a map and design the legend.
111 學測: Part 1 = 46 單選 (92 pts). Part 2 = 9 混合題組 (52 pts). 21 of 67 items were in 混合題. Geography is 地圖、圖表、影像判讀 centred, 取材以地理系統最高, and 不偏版.
111 non-choice: Q58 國際分工 with a basis. Q60 San Diego = 技術, 資本 and Tijuana = 勞工 (3 pts). Q64 one arrow from the 立霧溪流域 to the 布農族 traditional territory (3 pts; two or more arrows = 0).

verification.exam_format_verified:
The 116簡章 confirms the following for 社會: 110 minutes on 116/1/24 (Sun), 12:50–14:40. Item types may be 選擇 (單選/多選), 混合題 (a 題組 mixing choice and non-choice) or 非選擇.

The 考試說明 (current file: 108.11.08更新) confirms three rules: the three subjects are 均衡, non-choice carries 20–30% of the score as a principle, and non-choice may be 填充/問答/繪圖/製表.

Totals confirmed from CEEC 試題特色 (144 points every year):

| Year | Part 1 | Part 2 |
|---|---|---|
| 111 | 46 單選, 92 pts | 9 混合題組, 52 pts (21 of 67 items in 混合題) |
| 112 | 45 單選, 90 pts | 8 混合題組 + 1 非選; 11 單選 + 10 非選; 54 pts |
| 113 | 35 單選, 70 pts | 9 groups; 19 單選 (38 pts) + 10 非選 (36 pts) |
| 114 | 42 單選, 84 pts | 8 groups; 12 單選 (24 pts) + 10 非選 (36 pts) |
| 115 | 38 單選, 76 pts | 11 groups; 16 單選 (32 pts) + 11 非選 (36 pts) |

Non-choice was therefore 36/144 = 25% in each of 113–115. No 多選 items were reported in the 112–115 structure descriptions.

The 114 架構表 confirms Q18–28 as 地理單題, Q52–53 as the 地理混合題組 and Q57–58 as a 地公合科 group. 合科 was about 56% of questions in 114 and about 40% of the score in 115.

Geography non-choice tasks confirmed:
- 111: Q58 tick 國際分工 and justify it; Q60 match locational factors to cities (3 pts); Q64 draw one migration arrow (3 pts).
- 112: Q51 explain with 環境負載力; Q62 draw a map and design the legend.
- 114: Q53 legend symbol inside the 3920 m contour (3 pts); Q58 垂直分工 with a ≤30 字 reason (5 pts); Q63 pick a climate chart, name a hazard (≤5 字) and give the cause (≤20 字) (4 pts).
- 115: Q63 draw a 折線圖 of carrying capacity; Q54 write the map information after reading the 暈渲圖 and contours.
- 考試說明 examples: 例題2-3 draw Argentina's city-size curve on log–log axes (concave-up primate shape) and 例題3-4 draw a push–pull diagram.

The report's '20–35 characters' range is consistent with the observed 20/25/28/30/35-字 limits across 114 items.
verification.notes:
Method: I opened all cited primary URLs with WebFetch. The PDFs (課綱 社會/數學/自然, 116簡章, both versions of the 考試說明, the 114 rubric, the 師大附中 schedules and the 三貝德 comparison table) were text-extracted locally with PyMuPDF from the WebFetch-cached copies, using read-only stdout output.

My one attempted Traditional-Chinese WebSearch failed because the shared search budget was exhausted. I navigated CEEC's site directly instead (homepage → 考試說明 listing → attachment page). That is how I found that the 社會 考試說明 currently posted is the 108.11.08更新 file.

The biggest finding is the reversed rank-size rubric. Under the current file, 例題2-3 is about Argentina, uses log–log axes and requires a concave-up primate curve. Any 'misconception' card or practice item based on the old file would teach the wrong answer.

Everything else in the report checked out: all 19 high-school 項目 and their codes and titles, the 附錄三 periods, the time allocation, the 116 dates and scope, the paper structures for 111–115, and the 國中/數學/自然 bridging codes. The remaining errors are small mis-attributions of example items to codes, plus two over-specific item descriptions (114 Q52, 115 Q49).

Unit order follows the 課綱 except that maps (Ac) come before GIS (Ab), following the 龍騰/師大附中 sequence and the conceptual dependency. Climate (Ba) is kept before landforms (Bb), as in the 課綱, although 龍騰 teaches 地形 first. 田野實察 was split into the three checkpoints the 課綱 actually lists.

Exam links in key_concepts are inferred unless they cite a 考試說明 例題 code. The terminology list and the misconceptions were not re-verified beyond the items noted above.

research.subject: 公民與社會 (Civics & Society), as tested in 學測 社會考科 (GSAT Social Studies), 116學年度 sitting
research.scope_summary:
The 116學年度 學測 takes place 116年1月22日–24日 (2027-01-22 to 01-24). The official 116 簡章 (initial edition 115-08-04) defines 社會考科 scope as 必修歷史、必修地理、必修公民與社會 under the 108課綱, with history, geography and civics weighted about equally ("以占分比例相當為原則"). The CEEC 社會考科考試說明 (111學年度起適用, dated 108年9月) adds three points. (1) The scope is the 高一 and 高二 必修 courses. (2) Test knowledge is limited to coded 學習內容 items. (3) The 公民 部定必修 「延伸探究」 prompts may be used only as question context. 部定加深加廣選修 civics courses (現代社會與經濟, 民主政治與法律, 探究與實作:公共議題與社會探究) belong only to 分科測驗 公民與社會, not 學測.

Credits: the 社會領綱 (107年10月) gives 普高 社會 部定必修 18學分, 6學分 per subject, recommended to be finished within two school years. So 公民與社會 部定必修 = 6學分 in grades 10–11, with the exact grade placement set by each school.

Curriculum structure: 公民 學習內容 has four 主題.
- A 公民身分認同及社群 (Aa–Ad)
- B 社會生活的組織及制度 (Bb–Bq; Ba and Bp are 國中-only)
- C 社會的運作、治理及參與實踐 (Ca–Cg)
- D 民主社會的理想及現實 (Da–Df)

Topic B mixes sociology, government, law (Bf–Bk) and economics (Bl–Bq). Economics continues in C (Ce–Cg) and D (Df).

Exam style: recent papers (111–115) are 素養-oriented and context-heavy. They feature 合科 (cross-subject) groups, mixed/non-choice items, and chart/data reading. Civics questions often wrap legal or economic concepts in historical or geographic contexts. The full paper has 110 minutes, and the 112/114/115 papers each total 144 points. Non-choice items are 20–30% by policy; in 113, civics non-choice items were worth 3 points each.

Time-sensitive facts verified from 全國法規資料庫 and agencies:
- 民法成年 18 (in force since 2023-01-01).
- 選舉權 still 20 (憲法§130 / 選罷法§14); the 2022 修憲複決 to lower it failed.
- 公投權 18.
- 公投法§23 amended 2025-12-03: votes are held 3–6 months after the case is announced, on the same day as any national election in that window.
- 最低工資 rises to NT$30,900/month and NT$205/hour from 2027-01-01.
- 民法§1223 amended 2026-08-17 to abolish siblings' 特留分, in force 6 months after promulgation (after the 116學測).
- The 2024/2025 憲法訴訟法 quorum amendment and the contested 114年憲判字第1號 (2025-12-19) must be taught neutrally.
research.exam_format: 學測 社會考科 (116學年度): 110 minutes; exam day schedule within 116-01-22 to 01-24; score reported on 15-級分 scale (60-級分 when used for 分發入學採計); scores released 116-02-25. Question types allowed (116 簡章): 選擇題型 (單選、多選), 混合題型 (題組 combining choice and non-choice), 非選擇題型. 多選 scoring: all options judged independently; k wrong options earns (n−2k)/n of the item score, floor 0. 考試說明: non-choice share 20–30% of the paper; 歷史/地理/公民 balanced. Observed structures: 111 = 67 items, 46 單選 (10 題組) + 9 混合題組; mixed items introduced and first civics non-choice items. 112 = 第壹部分 45 單選 (90 pts) + 第貳部分 混合/非選 54 pts. 113 = 10 non-choice items (36 pts); civics non-choice = items 38, 46, 49, 57 at 3 pts each (history/geography 4 pts each); graded by 等級 rubric (等級2/1/0). 114 = 42 單選 (84 pts, 6 題組) + 8 混合題組 (60 pts; 12 單選 + 10 非選 = 36 pts). 115 = 65 items: 38 單選 (76 pts, 5 題組) + 11 混合題組 (68 pts; 16 單選 + 11 非選 = 36 pts). 合科 share: ~56% of items (114), ~40% of total score (115). Answer sheet: A3 double-sided folded to A4; Part 1 choice bubbles, Part 2 mixed/non-choice writing area.

中華民國憲法增修條文 (修正日期 94-06-10) key provisions:
- §1: LY-proposed constitutional amendments and territorial changes go to a 公民複決 (referendum).
- §2: direct presidential election; 4-year term, one re-election; emergency decrees need LY ratification within 10 days.
- §3: premier appointed by the president; LY may pass a no-confidence vote.
- §4: LY has 113 seats (73 district, 6 indigenous, 34 at-large/overseas by party list); 5% threshold; at least half of each party list must be women.
- §5: 15 大法官, 8-year non-renewable terms; 憲法法庭 handles impeachment and party dissolution.
- §7: 監察院 has 29 members.
- §12: amendment = 1/4 of legislators propose, 3/4 attend, 3/4 of attendees agree, then a 6-month announcement and a referendum where yes votes exceed half of all eligible voters.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Since the age of majority is 18, 18-year-olds can vote in elections.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: 民法 makes 18 the age of majority (since 2023-01-01), but 憲法§130 and 選罷法§14 keep 選舉權 at 20, and the 2022 constitutional amendment to lower it failed. The 公投權 age is 18 (公投法§7). Keep the three ages separate.

common_misconceptions.misconception: A referendum and a constitutional-amendment referendum have the same passing threshold.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: An ordinary referendum passes if yes > no and yes ≥ 1/4 of all eligible voters (公投法§29). A constitutional-amendment 複決 needs yes votes above half of all eligible voters (增修條文§12).

common_misconceptions.misconception: Referendums are always held on a fixed date every two years in August.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: 公投法§23 was amended on 2025-12-03. A vote is now held 3–6 months after the case is announced as established, on the same day as any national election in that window. Older study materials describing a fixed referendum day are outdated.

common_misconceptions.misconception: An online opinion poll carries the same legal weight as a referendum.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: A referendum is a form of direct democracy whose result has legal effect. Polls have no legal effect and may suffer unequal information access (digital divide).

common_misconceptions.misconception: Changing a law immediately changes behavior; if most children still take the father's surname, the law must require it.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: The 民法 lets parents agree on a child's surname in writing. Persistent customs can shape behavior more strongly than law, which shows the limits of law (考試說明 例題23, 公Bc-Ⅴ-1).

common_misconceptions.misconception: A court can punish behavior that is morally or religiously wrong even if no law prohibits it.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Under 罪刑法定 (刑法§1), only acts expressly punishable by law at the time can be punished (考試說明 例題25).

common_misconceptions.misconception: Minors (under 18) who commit crimes are never punished.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Under 刑法§18, acts by those under 14 are not punished. For ages 14 to under 18, punishment 'may be reduced' (得減輕), not excused. Juvenile cases also follow a different procedure (公Bk-Ⅴ-1).

common_misconceptions.misconception: After the 2026 amendment, siblings can no longer inherit.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Only siblings' 特留分 (forced share) is deleted. Their 應繼分 under intestacy remains. The change takes effect 6 months after the 2026-08-17 promulgation, and estates opened before that still follow the old rule.

common_misconceptions.misconception: 基本工資 is still the legal term, set under the 勞動基準法.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Since the 最低工資法 (enacted 2023-12-27), the legal concept is 最低工資. References to 基本工資 in other laws now apply to 最低工資 (§18). The rate rises to NT$30,900/month and NT$205/hour on 2027-01-01.

common_misconceptions.misconception: A rise in price causes demand to fall (the demand curve shifts left).
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: A change in the good's own price moves along the curve (change in quantity demanded). Other factors shift the curve (change in demand). The curriculum tests this distinction explicitly in 公Bo-Ⅴ-3 and 公Bo-Ⅴ-6.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Government price controls always help consumers and improve outcomes.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: 公Ce-Ⅴ-4 asks why price controls reduce economic efficiency. Teach efficiency losses alongside the fairness goals behind them.

common_misconceptions.misconception: Constitutional questions are still answered by 大法官 'interpretations' (釋字).
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Since the 憲法訴訟法 took effect (full text 2019-01-04, effective three years later), the 憲法法庭 issues judgments (e.g., 114年憲判字第1號). The 2024/2025 quorum amendment and the contested 2025-12-19 judgment should be taught as an ongoing dispute, not as settled fact.

common_misconceptions.misconception: A 學測 社會 question with a history or geography context is not a civics question.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: CEEC reports that many items 'look historical' but test civics knowledge, e.g. 114 item 62 (Tang relief vs social assistance) and 115 items 50–51 (puppet-show ban). Cross-subject items made up about 40–56% of recent papers.

common_misconceptions.misconception: 「延伸探究」 content is tested knowledge.
common_misconceptions.correct_idea: Per the 考試說明, 延伸探究 prompts may appear as question context, but the tested knowledge is limited to coded 學習內容 items.

recent_trends.trend: 111: mixed-question groups were introduced, civics had non-choice items for the first time, and chart/data reading entered civics (items 49–50, female-candidate table → infer a 複數選區 system). Questions move up to Bloom's 'analysis' level (item 23 on 長照 policy).

112: the non-choice share rose slightly. Civics non-choice item 66 asked students to tell factual evidence from theory and to apply 比例原則. Cross-subject groups (e.g., 1918 flu / COVID, 媒體再現) were common.
113: 10 non-choice items; civics items 38, 46, 49, 57 at 3 points each. Rubric-based 等級 grading rewards checking the right concept AND explaining the background, facts or consequences.

114: cross-subject items ≈56% of items. AI entered civics (generative AI, AI parole tools, media literacy non-choice item 46). Some legal-concept items were very hard, e.g. item 4 on pay transparency and civil rights (8% correct). CEEC advises aligning teaching with 領綱 條目.

115: cross-subject items ≈40% of total score. Current-affairs contexts: gene therapy and 健保, AI supply-chain labor, echo chambers, delayed retirement, indigenous land and 轉型正義, anti-eviction, oil-supply charts. Themes stress recognizing and empathizing with disadvantaged groups.

Recurring 111–115 themes: indigenous rights and autonomy, media and public opinion, social security and health insurance, labor rights, technology and AI, fairness for disadvantaged groups. Economics appears through everyday scenarios plus data and charts.

pedagogy_notes: Map every lesson to official codes (公Xx-Ⅴ-n) and show them in the UI. CEEC explicitly recommends aligning teaching with 領綱 條目, and tested knowledge is limited to coded items.

The curriculum is framed as questions (e.g., '為什麼罪刑法定主義是刑法的最高原則？'). This fits the professor–student dialogue style: each lesson can open with the 條目 question the student asks and close with the answer.

Suggested teaching order (prerequisites first, curriculum codes kept):
- A themes
- Law: Bf → Bg → Bh → Bi → Bj → Bk
- Government and politics: Bd → Be → Ca → Cb → Cc
- Economics: Bl → Bm → Bn → Bo → Ce → Cf → Cg → Bq → Df
- Labor: Cd after Bj and Ce
- D themes last.
The curriculum lists economics inside theme B, but it depends on 國中 Bl–Bn.

Add 國中 bridge mini-lessons before each 高中 unit. Two 國中-only items (公Ba family and kinship, 公Bp money) have no 高中 counterpart but are silently assumed by inheritance law (Bj-Ⅴ-4) and by national income and trade.

Keep a 'time-sensitive facts' panel with the effective date and an official source link for each fact:
- age of majority
- voting age and referendum age
- 公投法§23
- minimum wage
- 特留分
- 憲法訴訟法 status
Re-verify each sitting. Note that the 民法§1223 change takes effect after the 116學測 date.

Present contested political or constitutional issues neutrally, with multiple positions and primary documents: 國家主權 controversies (公Bd-Ⅴ-1), cross-strait relations (公Dd-Ⅴ-2), and the 2025 憲法法庭 judgment.

Practice non-choice answers with CEEC-style rubrics. 113 civics non-choice items were worth 3 points and graded 等級2/1/0: pick the right concept, then justify it with background, facts or consequences in your own words.
Train chart and data reading inside civics (tables of candidates, oil-production charts, wage data from 勞動部 and 主計總處). Include math bridges for percentages and coordinate graphs.
Use cross-subject scenarios (history and geography contexts with civics concepts) in exercises, since 40–56% of recent papers are cross-subject. Make the civics concept explicit after each scenario.
Use 延伸探究 prompts as enrichment or scenario material only; label them as 'not directly tested knowledge' per the 考試說明.
Avoid reproducing CEEC question text at length. Link to the official PDFs and write original practice items that mirror the style. 考試說明 copyright allows non-commercial use with attribution.

verification.subject: 公民與社會 (Civics & Society), as tested in 學測 社會考科 (GSAT Social Studies), 116學年度 sitting
verification.corrected_scope_summary:
The 116學年度 學測 runs 116-01-22 (Fri) to 01-24 (Sun). 社會 is on 116-01-24, 12:50–14:40, and lasts 110 minutes.

Scope (116 簡章 initial edition 115-08-04, p.4): 社會考科 covers 必修歷史、必修地理、必修公民與社會 under the 108課綱. Note 2 says the three subjects are weighted 「以占分比例相當為原則」.

The CEEC 學測社會考科考試說明 (111學年度起適用, dated 108年9月) adds four rules:
- The scope is the 高一、高二必修 courses.
- Questions are drawn from the 社會領綱 學習內容.
- 公民 部定必修 「延伸探究」 prompts may be used only as question context. Tested knowledge is limited to coded 學習內容 items.
- Non-choice items are worth 20–30% of the paper.

The 部定加深加廣選修 courses are 分科測驗 公民與社會 only, not 學測 (簡章 p.9 table, legible): 現代社會與經濟(3學分), 民主政治與法律(3學分), 探究與實作：公共議題與社會探究(2學分).

Credits (社會領綱 107年10月, 參): 普高 社會 部定必修 is 18學分, 6學分 per subject, taught within two school years. The 4–6學分 per semester recommendation is for the whole 社會 domain; each subject offered is 2–3學分 per semester. 加深加廣 is suggested for 高二、高三.

Civics 學習內容 (verified line by line, PDF pp.31–40) has four 主題:
- A 公民身分認同及社群: Aa, Ab, Ac, Ad. Ac exists only at 高中.
- B 社會生活的組織及制度: 高中 has Bb–Bo and Bq. Ba 個人、家庭與部落 and Bp 貨幣的功能 are 國中-only. Bo and Bq are 高中-only.
- C 社會的運作、治理及參與實踐: Ca–Cg. Ce and Cg are 高中-only.
- D 民主社會的理想及現實: Da–Df. Df is 高中-only.

That gives 32 coded 項目 in 必修. All 32 appear in final_units; the report invented none and left none out.

Exam style:
- 111–115 papers each total 144 points: Part 1 is single-choice, Part 2 is 混合題組 / non-choice.
- 合科 items are about 56% of items (114) and about 40% of total score (115).
- Civics non-choice items were worth 3 points each in 113. They are graded on an 等級 rubric.

Time-sensitive law, verified on 全國法規資料庫 (data cutoff 115-11-06):
- Age of majority is 18 (民法§12, in force 112-01-01).
- Voting age is 20 (憲法§130, 選罷法§14).
- Referendum age is 18 (公投法§7).
- 公投法§23 (114-12-03): a vote is held 3–6 months after a case is announced as established, on the same day as any national election in that window.
- 公投法§29: passes if yes > no and yes ≥ 1/4 of eligible voters.
- 民法§1223 (115-08-17) removes siblings' 特留分, effective 6 months after promulgation, i.e. after the 116學測.
- 憲法訴訟法 was amended 114-01-23 to add the 10/9 quorum. 114年憲判字第1號 (2025-12-19) declared that amendment unconstitutional, and its validity is disputed.

Minimum wage: NT$30,900/month and NT$205/hour from 2027-01-01 (勞動部 2026-09-24; announced 2026-10-16). The labor-market effects of a wage floor are explicitly 分科-only content (公Fb-Ⅴ-3). In 學測 it fits only as a price-control example under 公Ce-Ⅴ-4.
verification.exam_format_verified:
116學測 社會考科 facts below come from the 116 簡章 and the press release dated 115.08.03.
- 110 minutes, on 116-01-24 (Sun), 12:50–14:40.
- Allowed question types: 選擇題型 (單選、多選), 混合題型 (題組 combining choice and non-choice), 非選擇題型.
- 多選 scoring: each option is judged independently. A student with k wrong options earns (n−2k)/n of the item score, floor 0.
- Answer sheet: one A3 double-sided sheet folded to A4. Part 1 is the choice bubble area; Part 2 is the 混合/非選 writing area.
- Score: 15級分 for 繁星/申請/分發檢定; 60級分 when used for 分發入學採計.
- Scores released 116-02-25 (Thu); score notices mailed 116-02-26.
- Correct answers announced 116-02-17.

考試說明 (108年9月): the three subjects are balanced, and non-choice items are worth 20–30% of the paper.

Observed paper structures (CEEC 試題特色 pages and the 113 rubric):
- 111: 67 items. Part 1 = 46 單選 (92 pts, 10 題組). Part 2 = 9 混合題組 (11 單選 + 10 非選, 52 pts). First year of 混合題; civics non-choice items appeared for the first time.
- 112: Part 1 = 45 單選 (90 pts, 10 題組). Part 2 = 8 混合題組 + 1 非選 (11 單選 22 pts + 10 非選 32 pts = 54 pts). The non-choice share rose slightly.
- 113: 10 non-choice items, 36 pts in total. Civics items 38, 46, 49, 57 are 3 pts each; history/geography items 40, 43, 50, 53, 60, 64 are 4 pts each. Grading uses 等級2/1/0 levels with partial-point sub-levels; for item 38, 等級1 = 2 or 1 分.
- 114: Part 1 = 42 單選 (84 pts, 6 題組). Part 2 = 8 混合題組 (12 單選 24 pts + 10 非選 36 pts = 60 pts). 合科 about 56% of items.
- 115: Part 1 = 38 單選 (76 pts, 5 題組). Part 2 = 11 混合題組 (16 單選 32 pts + 11 非選 36 pts = 68 pts), 65 items in total. 合科 about 40% of total score.
- Totals of 144 points are confirmed for 111, 112, 114 and 115. The 113 total was not checked.

- §2: directly elected president; emergency decrees need LY ratification within 10 days
- §3: the president appoints the premier; the LY may pass a no-confidence vote
- §4: LY has 113 seats (73 district, 6 indigenous, 34 at-large/overseas); 5% threshold; at least half of each party list must be women
- §5: 15 大法官 with 8-year non-renewable terms
- §7: 監察院 has 29 members
Be-Ⅴ-2: principles of central–local power sharing, and how powers are divided in Taiwan
延伸探究 (context only): indigenous autonomy claims vs current 地方自治

final_units.title_zh: 法律的位階、制定與適用
final_units.title_en: Hierarchy of law; making, amending, repealing, interpreting and applying law

Bf-Ⅴ-2: how laws are interpreted and applied
Builds on the 國中 憲法 > 法律 > 命令 hierarchy and on 法治 vs 人治

final_units.title_zh: 憲法與人權保障
final_units.title_en: Constitution and protection of fundamental rights
final_units.gsat_track: 學測 社會考科 (公民與社會)
key_concepts: Bg-Ⅴ-1: how the Constitution relates to fundamental rights, how far rights may be limited, and how the state promotes them
Bg-Ⅴ-2: how the Constitution regulates public power to protect human rights
延伸探究 (context only): limits on rights need legislative authorization; limits that violate human dignity are never allowed
Constitutional review now comes as 憲法法庭 judgments (憲判字) under 憲法訴訟法 (in force 3 years after 108-01-04). Present the 114-01-23 quorum amendment and 114年憲判字第1號 as a live dispute.
Exam examples: 112 non-choice item 66 (applying 比例原則 to a fictionalized event); 115 items 34–35 (anti-eviction movements and protection of basic rights)

final_units.title_zh: 干涉、給付行政與救濟
final_units.title_en: Administrative law: regulatory and benefit administration, procedure, remedies

key_concepts: Bh-Ⅴ-1: how administrative law affects daily life, and its key principles
Bh-Ⅴ-2: why substantive justice needs fair procedure first; basic principles of administrative procedure (考試說明 例題29)
Bh-Ⅴ-3: how people seek 行政救濟 when unlawful or improper public power harms their rights
Exam examples: 114 item 34 (行政救濟, 41% correct, D=0.33); 115 items 26–27 (red-line illegal parking, 行政處分 and economic efficiency)

final_units.title_zh: 犯罪與刑罰
final_units.title_en: Crime and punishment

Bi-Ⅴ-2: why 罪刑法定 is the supreme principle of criminal law (刑法§1, verified)
Bi-Ⅴ-3: prosecution and punishment; presumption of innocence; rights of defendants and victims
Bi-Ⅴ-4: fact-finding by courts and 自由心證主義
延伸探究 (context only): 刑法的最後手段性 / 謙抑思想
刑法§18 (verified): under 14 不罰; 14 to under 18 得減輕其刑; 80 and over 得減輕其刑
Exam examples: 考試說明 例題25; 114 item 5 (Good Samaritan dilemma vs 罪刑法定, 81%); 115 item 62 (a legal scholar's view on using punishment, 66%/0.44)

final_units.title_zh: 民事權利的保障與限制

final_units.gsat_track: 學測 社會考科 (公民與社會)
key_concepts: Bj-Ⅴ-1: why freedom of contract is limited in consumer-protection and labor contracts (on the employer side), and how to judge whether a limit is reasonable
Bj-Ⅴ-2: property-right features of 所有權 and how it is protected
Bj-Ⅴ-3: how property between spouses should be regulated
Bj-Ⅴ-4: how current 民法 inheritance rules protect property
延伸探究 (context only): reconciling private property (incl. IP) with the public interest

TIME-SENSITIVE: the 民法§1223 amendment (promulgated 115-08-17, in force 6 months later, i.e. after the 116學測) removes siblings' 特留分. 配偶, 直系血親卑親屬 and 父母 keep 1/2 of 應繼分; 祖父母 keep 1/3. Only §1223 was amended.
Basics from 國中: 成年 at 18 (§12); under 7 無行為能力, minors 7+ 限制行為能力 (§13)
Exam examples: 114 item 4 (pay-transparency rule tested as a 民事權利 concept, 8% correct); 114 items 54–56 (清代大小租, using 交易成本 and 所有權)

final_units.title_zh: 兒童及少年的法律保障

Cc-Ⅴ-2: other important forms and channels of participation besides elections (考試說明 例題24 contrasts 公投 with an online poll; the specific channels to teach are a textbook choice)

TIME-SENSITIVE (verified):
- 選舉權 at 20 and 被選舉權 at 23 (憲法§130 / 選罷法§14), plus 4 months' residence (選罷法§15)
- 公投權 at 18 (公投法§7)

final_units.title_zh: 勞動參與
final_units.title_en: Labor participation and labor rights

key_concepts: Cd-Ⅴ-1: why labor participation drives social development and a sustainable economy
Cd-Ⅴ-2: 個別勞動權益 vs 集體勞動三權, and why government uses individual and collective labor law to protect equal labor-market participation
延伸探究 (context only): why autonomous labor relations matter and how to build them

TIME-SENSITIVE (verified):
- 最低工資法 (制定 112-12-27): §4 sets monthly and hourly rates; §9 bases review on CPI change; §10 has the council meet in Q3; §18 maps 基本工資 references in other laws to 最低工資
- 2027 rates: NT$30,900/month and NT$205/hour from 116-01-01

Exam examples: 115 items 41–42 (a delayed-retirement policy that looks fair but structurally exploits manual laborers); 115 item 2 (East-African AI data-labeling workers: global inequality and labor rights)
depends_on: 公Bj-Ⅴ-1 (limits on freedom of contract in labor contracts)
公Bg-Ⅴ (basic rights behind the collective labor rights)
公Ce-Ⅴ (for analyzing the minimum wage as a price floor)

final_units.title_zh: 公平正義
final_units.title_en: Fairness and justice

key_concepts: Da-Ⅴ-1: how individual rights relate to justice (procedural, corrective); why non-differential treatment matters for justice
Da-Ⅴ-2: how group rights relate to justice; when differential treatment of a group becomes a positive principle
Da-Ⅴ-3: why different groups' understandings and pursuit of justice conflict

Exam example: 115 items 32–33 (indigenous land in 花東 and legal measures for 轉型正義). Mapping this to Da is our inference.

Db-Ⅴ-2: common dilemmas and debates in Taiwan's system, weighing fairness, responsibility and efficiency
延伸探究 (context only): how 全民健保 can ensure reasonable access while avoiding abuse
Exam examples: 114 item 62 (Tang-dynasty relief vs modern social assistance, 41%/0.46); 115 item 1 (adding expensive gene therapy to 健保, 67%/0.25)

final_units.title_zh: 多元文化
final_units.title_en: Multiculturalism

key_concepts: Dc-Ⅴ-1: why friction or conflict arises between cultures
Dc-Ⅴ-2: Taiwan's current policies that promote equality between cultures
延伸探究 (context only): consistency and tension between cultural equality and universal human rights
Exam example: 114 item 1 (Southeast-Asian mother-tongue classes at school, 42%/0.32)

final_units.title_zh: 全球關連

key_concepts: Dd-Ⅴ-1: governance challenges that globalization brings, and the issues Taiwan faces
Dd-Ⅴ-2: Taiwan's position in global competition and cooperation, and how cross-strait relations affect its international standing (考試說明 例題28; teach neutrally)
Dd-Ⅴ-3: ideas of global sustainable development and their tension with globalization
延伸探究 (context only): what international NGOs (incl. indigenous and environmental groups) do on sustainability

final_units.title_zh: 科技發展

延伸探究 (context only): why technology development must attend to 科技風險治理
Exam example: 114 items 43–46 (generative AI: biased output, unfair AI-assisted parole assessment, environmental impact)

final_units.title_zh: 貿易自由化
final_units.title_en: Trade liberalization and the WTO

key_concepts: Df-Ⅴ-1: why trade liberalization happens
Df-Ⅴ-2: who gains and who loses from trade regulation vs opening (考試說明 例題2, Argentina/Venezuela context)
Df-Ⅴ-3: the roles the WTO plays internationally
depends_on: 公Ce-Ⅴ (equilibrium-price reasoning for who gains and who loses)

final_units.title_zh: （加深加廣選修）現代社會與經濟
final_units.title_en: (Elective; 分科測驗 only) Modern society and economy
final_units.grade_level: 11–12 (加深加廣選修, 3學分; 領綱 suggests 高二、高三)
final_units.gsat_track: 分科測驗 公民與社會 only (116 簡章 p.9)
key_concepts:
E 社會不平等與社會運動:
- Ea: stratification theories; economic, cultural and social capital; family SES and educational opportunity; ethnicity, gender and disability
- Eb: social movements in Taiwan; how they differ from parties and pressure groups

F 景氣波動與經濟成長:
- Fa 物價膨脹: growth rate, PPP, cost of living, causes of inflation
- Fb 薪資與勞動市場: wage determination; real vs nominal wages; effects of a statutory wage floor (領綱 wording still says 基本工資); automation and migrant labor
- Fc 景氣波動與失業: unemployment types and measurement; discouraged workers
- Fd 利率與固定投資: loanable-funds market
- Fe 中央銀行與貨幣政策: monetary policy and side effects of easing

final_units.title_zh: （加深加廣選修）民主政治與法律
final_units.title_en: (Elective; 分科測驗 only) Democratic politics and law
final_units.gsat_track: 分科測驗 公民與社會 only (116 簡章 p.9)
key_concepts:
G 民主政治與世界秩序:
- Ga: deliberative vs representative democracy; civil disobedience
- Gb: China's politics; regional peace and cross-strait relations
- Gc: international organizations; international conflict and how it is resolved; alliances and world order

H 法律與社會生活:
- Ha 釋憲制度與人權保障 (領綱 wording 「聲請大法官解釋」 predates 憲法訴訟法; now 憲法法庭 判決)
- Hb 行政行為與法律救濟: whether a 行政處分 is lawful; 訴願 and 行政訴訟 requirements; 國家賠償 vs 補償
- Hc: civil-law protection of property, status and personality rights
- Hd: information life and criminal law

final_units.title_zh: （加深加廣選修）探究與實作：公共議題與社會探究
final_units.title_en: (Elective; 分科測驗 only) Inquiry and practice: public issues and social inquiry
final_units.grade_level: 11–12 (加深加廣選修, 2學分; may be 2學分 in one semester or 1學分 in each of two)
final_units.gsat_track: 分科測驗 公民與社會 only (116 簡章 p.9). Not 學測 scope, although the 學測 integrated objectives S4/S5 test general inquiry skills.
key_concepts: No coded 學習內容. Four required inquiry steps: 發現與界定問題, 觀察與蒐集資料, 分析與詮釋資料, 總結與反思
Four 實作取徑: 社會參與行動方案, 日常生活的意義理解與探究, 經驗事實的描繪與量化探究, 規範或論述的反思探究 (領綱 example topics include market price surveys, 基本工資 vs actual wages, opinion-poll credibility)

corrections.original: Unit 35 (探究與實作：公共議題與社會探究) in_gsat = "partial"
corrections.correction: in_gsat = "no". The 116 簡章 limits 學測 社會 to 必修歷史/地理/公民與社會, and the 考試說明 limits it to 高一、高二必修. The 簡章 p.9 table lists this course only under 分科測驗 公民與社會. Overlap with the S4/S5 inquiry objectives does not bring the course content into 學測 scope.

corrections.original: 分科測驗 elective course names for 公民與社會 were 'inferred from the layout' of column-scrambled 簡章 text
corrections.correction: Confirmed directly. The 簡章 p.9 (PDF p.15) table text reads: 公民與社會 | 必修公民與社會 | 現代社會與經濟、民主政治與法律、探究與實作：公共議題與社會探究.

corrections.original: Credits: 'each subject = 6學分, recommended 4–6學分 per semester'
corrections.correction: The 領綱 says 「部定必修課程建議一學期配置4-6學分、所開設科目每科目以2-3學分為原則，並於兩學年內授完」. So 4–6學分 per semester applies to the whole 社會 domain, and each subject offered gets 2–3學分 per semester. 加深加廣選修 (24學分 in total) is suggested for 高二、高三.

corrections.original: Unit 33 (現代社會與經濟) codes: 公Ea-Ⅴ-1~4, 公Fb-Ⅴ-4, 公Fc-Ⅴ-1~4, 公Fd-Ⅴ-1~3, 公Fe-Ⅴ-1~3 (partial)

Note that 公Fb-Ⅴ-3 (effect of a statutory wage floor on the labor market) is elective, 分科-only content.

corrections.original: Unit 34 (民主政治與法律) codes: 公Ga-Ⅴ-1~2, 公Gb-Ⅴ-1~2, 公Hc-Ⅴ-1~2, 公Hd-Ⅴ-1~2 (partial)
corrections.correction: Add 公Gc-Ⅴ-1~3 (國際政治與世界秩序), 公Ha-Ⅴ-1~2 (釋憲制度與人權保障) and 公Hb-Ⅴ-1~3 (行政行為與法律救濟: 行政處分 legality, 訴願/行政訴訟, 國家賠償/補償). The Ha-Ⅴ-1 wording 「聲請大法官解釋」 predates the 憲法訴訟法 regime.

corrections.original: Bridging prereq 'Choice, opportunity cost, prices' cites 國小 Da-Ⅲ-1

verification.notes:
Method: the NAER 社會領綱 PDF, the 116 簡章, the 116 press release, the 考試說明 and the 113 rubric were downloaded through WebFetch. Their text was extracted read-only with PyMuPDF and checked line by line: civics 學習內容 pp.31–40, electives pp.46–50, 國小 table pp.19–21, 簡章 pp.3, 4, 9 and 33. Law facts were checked on 全國法規資料庫 (data cutoff 115-11-06). CEEC 試題特色 pages for 111, 112, 114 and 115, plus MOL, CNA, 報導者, data.gov.tw and the 憲法法庭 press release, were fetched directly. The shared WebSearch budget was already used up when this check began, so no independent Traditional Chinese keyword searches could be run. Facts that needed discovery, rather than fetching a known URL, are listed under unverifiable.

Verdict: the report is accurate on all structural points:
- 學習內容 codes: all 32 必修 項目 and every code number match; nothing is invented or missing.
- Exam dates and timings, and the 簡章 and 考試說明 rules.
- Paper structures for 111–115.
- Every statute checked.

The main errors were scope and completeness:
- Unit 35 marked in_gsat 'partial'.
- Elective code lists incomplete.
- A mis-cited 國小 code (Da-Ⅲ-1).
- One mislabeled 項目 name (Ba = 個人、家庭與部落).
- Cd placed before Ce despite the report's own pedagogy note.
- A few unverified exam-item mappings.

Teaching implications:
1. Two 領綱 elective items use outdated legal wording: 公Fb-Ⅴ-3 says 基本工資, and 公Ha-Ⅴ-1 says 聲請大法官解釋. Both are 分科-only, but write course text in current legal terms (最低工資, 憲法法庭判決).
2. 113 non-choice item 49 directly tested 機會成本, a 國中 concept, so the 國中 bridge lessons are not optional.
3. Mappings of exam items to 學習內容 codes are our inference unless CEEC states the code. The 考試說明 例題 do state their codes (例題2 Df-V-2, 例題3 Ac-V-3, 例題4 Bn-V-2, 例題5 Bm-V-1 + Ce-V-2, 例題23 Bc-V-1, 例題24 Cc-V-2 + De-V-1, 例題25 Bi-V-2, 例題26 Cb-V-2, 例題27 Cb-V-1, 例題28 Dd-V-2, 例題29 Bh-V-2), so they are the safest anchors for examples.
4. For the 116學測 the law in force is the pre-amendment 民法§1223; the amendment takes effect afterwards. 憲法訴訟法 status should be presented as disputed.

Final order keeps the curriculum sequence A → B → C → D, with one change: Ce, Cf and Cg now come before Cd. Every depends_on now points only to earlier units or to bridging items.

research.subject: 國語文 Chinese (beta): 學測 國文考科, made up of 國語文綜合能力測驗 (國綜) and 國語文寫作能力測驗 (國寫)
research.scope_summary:
Target sitting: the 116學年度學科能力測驗, held 116年1月22–24日 (Jan 22–24, 2027). Registration ran 115/10/27–11/10. Both 國綜 and 國寫 fall on Jan 23 (Saturday) afternoon. The 116 簡章 sets the 國文 scope as「必修國文」under the 108課綱. The governing CEEC exam guide is 學測國文考科考試說明（111學年度起適用, 108年9月）; I found no 116-specific revision.

Scope basis: the 國語文 課綱 (十二年國教 國民中小學暨普通型高級中等學校語文領域－國語文, 中華民國107年1月). Its 學習內容 has three 主題:
- 文字篇章 A: Aa 標音符號, Ab 字詞, Ac 句段, Ad 篇章
- 文本表述 B: Ba 記敘, Bb 抒情, Bc 說明, Bd 議論, Be 應用
- 文化內涵 C: Ca 物質, Cb 社群, Cc 精神
學習表現 has six categories (1 聆聽 … 6 寫作). Stage Ⅴ (grades 10–12) is the GSAT layer. 必修國文 is 16學分, including 中華文化基本教材 2學分. 加深加廣選修 (語文表達與傳播應用、各類文學選讀、專題閱讀與研究、國學常識) is explicitly outside the 國綜 scope.

Classical texts: textbooks must average 35%–45% 文言 over three years, excluding 中華文化基本教材, and 國綜 文言 sampling follows that ratio. 課綱 附錄四 lists 15 recommended 文言 selections (推薦選文15篇, by 左丘明 … 張李德和). CEEC caps sampling from textbook selections by how many publishers share them: B類 ≤40%, C類 ≤10% of textbook-based points; A類 has no cap.

What 國綜 tests: objectives A1–A6 (knowledge: 字形字音字義, 語詞成語, 語法, 表現手法, 文學知識, 學術文化) and B1–B5 (reading: 檢索, 理解比較分析統整, 延伸反思, 形式推究, 詮釋鑑賞).

What 國寫 tests: two tasks, 知性的統整判斷 and 情意的感受抒發, each worth 25 points and graded on a 三等六級 scale.

Recent papers (111–115) are about 80% passage reading and about 20% basic-knowledge items (per teachers' reports). They feature large multi-text 混合題 sets, with the non-choice part worth 18 points in 111–112 and 20 points in 113–115. There is heavy 對讀 anchored on the 15篇, plus cross-disciplinary popular-science and Taiwan material.

A total beginner needs 國小/國中 bridging first: 注音, 部首/部件, 標點, 詞類/句型, the 4 造字原則, and 常用文言 虛字/古今義變 (Ab-Ⅳ-6/7).
research.exam_format:
116學測 schedule (CEEC press release 115.10.23 and 116 簡章):
- 國文 is split into two 90-minute sessions on 116/1/23 (Sat): 國文（一）國綜 12:50–14:20 and 國文（二）國寫 15:20–16:50.
- Scoring: 國綜 is out of 100 and 國寫 out of 50, each worth 50%. 國文原得總分 = 國綜×0.5 + 國寫. The result is reported as 級分 (max 15). The 級距 is the mean raw score of the top 1% divided by 15.

國綜 format:
- Question types: 單選題, 多選題, and 混合題 (題組 that mix choice and non-choice items).
- The guide planned 20–28 of 100 points for the non-choice part. Actual non-choice points by year: 111 = 18 (Q34–36), 112 = 18 (Q33, 35, 37), 113 = 20 (Q32, 33, 36), 114 = 20 (Q34–36), 115 = 20 (Q32–34).
- 115 paper (Taipei teachers' report): 36 items in total.
  - 24 單選, 48 pts
  - 7 多選, 28 pts
  - 混合題: 2 choice items (4 pts) + 3 short-answer items (20 pts)
- Non-choice items are short answers with suggested lengths (e.g., 20–50字). They are scored full/partial/zero at 2 or 4 points each.
- Texts may include 圖表/圖形/表單, not just prose.

國寫 format:
- All non-choice, two 大題 of 25 pts each.
- 第一大題 = 知性的統整判斷. In 112–115 it was split into (一) about 80字 for 4 pts and (二) about 400字 for 21 pts. In 111 the limits were 5 lines and 21 lines.
- 第二大題 = 情意的感受抒發, 25 pts. It is a prompted essay based on materials such as 圖文, 科普, or poetry.
- Grading: graders pick the 等, then the 級, then the score.
  - Full 25-point scale: A+ 22–25, A 18–21, B+ 14–17, B 10–13, C+ 6–9, C 1–5, 0.
  - Split question (一): A 3–4, B 2, C 1, 0.
  - Split question (二): A+ 19–21, A 15–18, B+ 12–14, B 8–11, C+ 5–7, C 1–4.
- Rules that recur:
  - Blank, off-topic, or copying the prompt scores 0.
  - Unfinished essays (or single-paragraph essays in Q2) are capped at B+.
  - Writing outside the answer area costs −1.
  - Punctuation and 錯別字 are deducted at graders' discretion.
  - Answers must be in 正體中文.
- 國寫 also gets a separate 成績通知單 with A/B/C 表現描述, which universities may use in 個人申請.
- Question-writing rules: quoted material is preferably ≤800字, and obscure jargon is avoided.

key_facts.claim: 116學年度學測 runs 116年1月22日（五）–1月24日（日). Registration ran 115/10/27–11/10. The six subjects are 國文, 英文, 數學A, 數學B, 社會, 自然. 國文 is given in two sessions: 國綜 and 國寫.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心新聞稿 115.10.23「116學年度學科能力測驗報導」
key_facts.evidence: Press release states the exam dates, the registration window, and the 國綜/國寫 split.

key_facts.claim: 國綜 and 國寫 are 90 minutes each. On 1/23 (Sat), 國綜 runs 12:50–14:20 and 國寫 runs 15:20–16:50. Except for 國寫, which is all non-choice, every subject has choice items plus non-choice or 混合題. Scores are 級分 with a max of 15; the 級距 is the top-1% mean divided by 15.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心新聞稿 115.10.23
key_facts.evidence: Times were read from the timetable in the extracted PDF text. Column alignment was imperfect, but the times match the 90-minute durations.

key_facts.claim: The 116 學測 scope for 國文 is 必修國文 under the 108課綱. 國綜 and 國寫 are each worth 50% and given in separate sessions. 國文原得總分 = 國綜得分×0.5 + 國寫得分. 國寫 answers must be written in 正體中文.
key_facts.source_name: 116學年度考試簡章 (大考中心, 115年8月公告)
key_facts.evidence: 測驗範圍 table: 國文 → 必修國文, 課綱依據 108課綱. 附錄三 adds that only 正體中文 may be used.

key_facts.claim: The governing 國文 exam guide is 「學科能力測驗國文考科考試說明－111學年度起適用」, dated 中華民國108年9月. 國綜 uses 單選, 多選, and 混合題 (choice + non-choice). 國寫 is all non-choice. Each session is 90 minutes.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 學測國文考科考試說明（111學年度起適用）
key_facts.evidence: Sections 貳 測驗題型 and 參 測驗時間 of the guide.

key_facts.claim: The 學測 tests 部定必修 only. 國文 questions are written to the 國語文課綱 普通型高中 部定必修 curriculum, covering language ability plus literary and cultural literacy.
key_facts.source_name: 考試說明 前言
key_facts.evidence: The basis is the 111學年度起適用之大學多元入學方案, which limits the 學測 to 部定必修.

key_facts.claim: 國綜 objectives fall into two dimensions. 國語文知識的認知與應用: A1 字形、字音、字義; A2 語詞、成語; A3 語法; A4 表現手法、表述方式; A5 文學作家、作品、體類、流派; A6 學術思想、文化. 文本的理解與探究: B1 訊息檢索擷取; B2 文意理解、比較、分析、統整; B3 內容延伸與反思; B4 形式推究與分析; B5 結合文學文化知識的詮釋與鑑賞.
key_facts.source_name: 考試說明 國文（一）壹、測驗目標
key_facts.evidence: Codes A1–A6 and B1–B5 as printed.

key_facts.claim: 國綜 命題重點 are: (一) 字詞語法: 字形, 字音, 字義, 六書基本原則, 語詞意義與結構, 詞性, 句型. (二) 文學知識: 作家, 作品, 體類, 流派. (三) 文本涵義: 文句邏輯與深層、象徵意義; 段落篇章的主旨、結構、寓意、分析與評述. (四) 寫作方式與手法. (五) 文化內涵: 物質、社群、精神文化. Source texts are 古今各類文本 at high-school level.
key_facts.source_name: 考試說明 貳、測驗內容

key_facts.claim: 國綜 文言 sampling follows the 課綱 rule that 文言 makes up a three-year average of 35%–45% of lessons, excluding 中華文化基本教材. Textbook selections are classed A (shared by 4–5 versions), B (2–3 versions), or C (1 version). B類 items should be ≤40% and C類 items ≤10% of textbook-based points; A類 is uncapped. At the time there were 5 審定 versions, so for example 30 textbook-based points allow ≤12 from B類 and ≤3 from C類.
key_facts.source_name: 考試說明 取材原則 and 附錄一 Q7

key_facts.claim: CEEC does not fix a share of 國綜 points that must come from textbook selections; its source texts span classical, modern, and cross-disciplinary material. The 「文本」 can include 圖表, 圖形, 圖解, and 表單. The 加深加廣選修 courses (語文表達與傳播應用, 各類文學選讀, 專題閱讀與研究, 國學常識) are excluded from the scope.
key_facts.source_name: 考試說明 附錄一 Q2, Q6, Q8

key_facts.claim: The guide sets the 混合題 non-choice share at 20–28 of 國綜's 100 points (10%–14% of the 國文 total). 混合題 answers are more convergent and shorter than 國寫, and test reading comprehension rather than writing.
key_facts.source_name: 考試說明 附錄一 Q4–Q5

key_facts.claim: CEEC's 111 briefing says 國綜 contains 單選, 多選, and 2–3 混合題 sets, with more than 30 items and about 20 non-choice points. The 110 試辦 paper had 25 單選 (with 7 題組) and 7 多選 worth 78 points, plus 2 混合題 sets worth 22 points (18 of them non-choice), for 39 items in total. CEEC promised 基本題 and a text volume similar to recent exams, and said it would not go beyond the curriculum.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心「111學測簡介─國文考科」(民國110年11月)

key_facts.claim: 國寫 has two objectives. 知性的統整判斷: (1) read text or charts accurately, analyze, summarize, and describe; (2) reason about an issue and give a personal view and judgment; (3) organize and express ideas in writing. 情意的感受抒發: (1) write concretely about personal experience, with association and creative expression; (2) express feelings sincerely within the prompt's situation; (3) organize and express ideas in writing.
key_facts.source_name: 考試說明 國文（二）壹、測驗目標

key_facts.claim: 國寫 uses 三等六級. A 25-point question maps A+ 25–22, A 21–18, B+ 17–14, B 13–10, C+ 9–6, C 5–1, 0 = 0. Graders decide the 等 first, then the 級, then the score. Prompt rules: quoted material should stay under 800字, avoid obscure jargon, and need no specialist subject knowledge.
key_facts.source_name: 考試說明 國文（二）貳、測驗內容 and 附「評閱等級與分數」說明

key_facts.claim: 國寫 表現描述 by 等第. 知性 A: grasps the prompt precisely, thinks deeply, argues clearly, structure is tight. 情意 A: imaginative, deep insight, moving language. B: the prompt is mostly grasped and the writing is plain and smooth. C: partly off-prompt, loose structure, awkward language (for 知性, also 缺乏己見). 0: blank, off-topic, or only copies the prompt.
key_facts.source_name: 116簡章 附錄三 國寫成績說明

key_facts.claim: The 國語文課綱 (dated 中華民國107年1月) divides 學習內容 into 文字篇章 (Aa 標音符號, Ab 字詞, Ac 句段, Ad 篇章), 文本表述 (Ba 記敘, Bb 抒情, Bc 說明, Bd 議論, Be 應用), and 文化內涵 (Ca 物質, Cb 社群, Cc 精神). Each code is 主題/項目 + 學習階段 (Ⅰ–Ⅴ; Ⅴ = grades 10–12) + serial number. ◎ marks content repeated across stages.
key_facts.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/806/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等學校語文領域-國語文.odt
key_facts.source_name: 國家教育研究院 國語文課綱 (107年1月)

key_facts.claim: The 普通型高中 time allocation is 必修 16學分, which includes 中華文化基本教材 2學分. Schools offer 8學分 of 加深加廣選修 and students take at least 4. Each 必修 textbook volume must include one 文化經典 lesson, and each year at least one modern and one classical poetry lesson. Modern selections should mainly be 臺灣新文學作家.
key_facts.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/806/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等學校語文領域-國語文.odt
key_facts.source_name: 國語文課綱 參、時間分配 and 陸、二、教材編選

key_facts.claim:
課綱 附錄四 lists the 普通型高中（第五學習階段）推薦選文15篇, offered as a reference for textbook selection:
1 燭之武退秦師（左傳）, 左丘明, 先秦
2 大同與小康, 禮記, 先秦
3 諫逐客書, 李斯, 先秦
4 鴻門宴（史記）, 司馬遷, 漢魏六朝
5 出師表, 諸葛亮, 漢魏六朝
6 桃花源記, 陶淵明, 漢魏六朝
7 師說, 韓愈, 唐宋
8 虯髯客傳(太平廣記), 杜光庭, 唐宋
9 赤壁賦, 蘇軾, 唐宋
10 晚遊六橋待月記, 袁宏道, 明清
11 項脊軒志, 歸有光, 明清
12 勞山道士(聊齋誌異), 蒲松齡, 明清
13 勸和論, 鄭用錫, 臺灣古典散文
14 鹿港乘桴記, 洪繻, 臺灣古典散文
15 畫菊自序, 張李德和, 臺灣古典散文
key_facts.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/806/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等學校語文領域-國語文.odt
key_facts.source_name: 國語文課綱 附錄四

key_facts.claim: In 國中 the 文言 share should rise each year: 10%–20% in grade 7, 20%–30% in grade 8, 25%–35% in grade 9. In 高中 必修 it is a three-year average of 35%–45%, excluding 中華文化基本教材.
key_facts.source_url: https://www.naer.edu.tw/upload/1/16/doc/806/十二年國民基本教育課程綱要國民中小學暨普通型高級中等學校語文領域-國語文.odt
key_facts.source_name: 國語文課綱 教材編選

key_facts.claim: 115 國綜 混合題, themed 「聽見她的聲音」. Non-choice items Q32–34 total 20 points (10 of the 國文 total). 甲 is 歸有光 (〈項脊軒志〉〈先妣事略〉〈祭外姑文〉), 乙 is a modern essay on parenting, 丙 is an oral-history interview with a 媳婦仔. Items are scored 2/0 or 4/2/0. Common errors: omitting one required dimension (考量 vs 行動), vague answers, mixing up subject and object, and miswritten key characters (閨→閏, 閑→閉).
key_facts.source_name: 選才電子報 第351期 (115.04.15), 大考中心研究員潘莉瑩

key_facts.claim: 115 國寫 第一題 adapts 《就算牠沒有臉》 and Levinas's ethical 「臉」. (一) Within 80字, explain why the heroine refuses the piglet but eats the fish: 4 pts, A 3–4, B 2, 1, 0. (二) Within 400字, give examples of evading or taking on ethical responsibility, with views and reflection: 21 pts, A+ 19–21 … C 1–4. 第二題 uses 幾米 picture-texts on 「隔在我們之間的種種」 for 25 pts. Results: Q1 A 9.09%, B 76.79%, C 13.81%; Q2 A 14.5%, B 75.48%, C 8.83%. Unfinished essays are capped at B+, writing outside the area costs −1, and punctuation and 錯別字 are deducted.
key_facts.source_name: 選才電子報 第351期 (115.04.15), 大考中心研究員曾佩芬

key_facts.claim: 114 國綜 混合題 uses a three-person dialogue on 〈虯髯客傳〉 with 《西遊記》 plot points, testing 「概念框架」 and 「身分框架」. Non-choice items Q34–36 total 20 points. Both 虯髯客 and 虬髯客 are accepted; other miswritten key terms are deducted.
key_facts.source_name: 選才電子報 第347期 (114.04.28), 潘莉瑩

key_facts.claim: 114 國寫. 第一題 adapts 《泛科學》 on 擬社會互動: (一) 80字 explaining its features; (二) about 400字 on its positive and negative effects, capped at B+ (14) if only one side is covered. 第二題 is 「關於52赫茲，我想說的是……」 for 25 pts. Results: Q1 A 9%, B 74.36%, C 13.31%; Q2 A 6.77%, B 71.6%, C 16.99%. A common error was misreading 擬社會互動 as 擬社會運動.
key_facts.source_name: 選才電子報 第347期 (114.04.28), 曾佩芬

key_facts.claim: 113 國綜 混合題 is themed on memory (回憶), with four texts: a literary overview of voluntary and involuntary memory, a brain-science text, 李煜〈浪淘沙〉, and 辛棄疾〈破陣子〉. Q32 also draws on 琦君〈髻〉. Non-choice items Q32, 33, 36 total 20 points. Errors included miswriting 杏仁核 and 海馬迴.
key_facts.source_name: 選才電子報 第342期 (113.04.15), 潘莉瑩

key_facts.claim: 113 國寫. 第一題 is on 「標籤」: (一) up to 80字 (5 lines) on its positive and negative effects; (二) up to 21 lines with examples. 第二題 uses 禹鐘榮《樹木教我的人生課》 (a forest needs gaps → does life need gaps?). A self-created title that still fits the prompt was capped at B+ (17). Results: Q1 A 6.46%, B 80.6%, C 12.65%; Q2 A 7%, B 75.01%, C 16.48%.
key_facts.source_name: 選才電子報 第342期 (113.04.15), 曾佩芬

key_facts.claim: 112 國綜 混合題 sets center on 古典. One pairs two modern texts on the classics; the other links 《獅子王》 and 《哈姆雷特》 with Adam Grant's 《反叛,改變世界的力量》 (Originals). Non-choice items Q33, 35, 37 total 18 points.
key_facts.source_name: 選才電子報 第336期 (112.04.17), 潘莉瑩

key_facts.claim: 112 國寫. 第一題 is on Holmes and Watson: (一) 80字, 4 pts, on Watson's two mistakes; (二) about 400字, 21 pts, comparing their attitudes to life. 第二題 is 「花草樹木的氣味記憶」, 25 pts. 115,021 candidates. The average score rate was 52.3%, down 1.1 points from 111.
key_facts.source_name: 選才電子報 第336期 (112.04.17), 大考中心研究員詹乃凡

key_facts.claim: 111 國綜 混合題: one set uses 文言 texts on 奇門遁甲 (a 必修 selection plus two 志怪 tales); the other is a cross-disciplinary climate-change text. Non-choice items Q34–36 total 18 points (2 + 4 points each).
key_facts.source_name: 選才電子報 第330期 (111.04.15), 潘莉瑩

key_facts.claim: 111 國寫. 第一題 compares Taiwan's 不老騎士 with Copenhagen's Cycling Without Age: (一) 5 lines; (二) an essay titled 「樂齡出遊」 within 21 lines, capped at B+ if set outside Taiwan. 第二題 is 「當我打開課本」. Results: Q1 A 9.86%, B 78.47%, C 11.68%; Q2 A 13.34%, B 74.38%, C 12.29%.
key_facts.source_name: 選才電子報 第330期 (111.04.15), 曾佩芬

key_facts.claim: Taipei teachers' 115 國綜 report gives the paper as 24 單選 (48 pts), 7 多選 (28 pts), and 混合題 of 2 choice items (4 pts) plus 3 short answers (20 pts). About 20% of items are basic: 字音 Q1, 字形 Q2, 應用文 Q3, 文意重組 Q5, 文法/量詞 Q14–15, 字義 Q25, 成語 Q26, 國學常識 Q28. About 80% are passage reading and literary technique. The 文白 ratio is about 1:1. Cross-disciplinary topics include 臺灣杉 botany, 懷素〈自敘帖〉 calligraphy, soap and 皂化, and music. No 新詩 appeared.
key_facts.source_name: 115學年度學科能力測驗國綜試題分析報告 (臺北市高中國文科教師群: 中山女高、中正、成功、建中)
key_facts.evidence: The item-count table extracted with garbled layout. The counts sum to 36 items and 100 points, consistent with numbering up to Q36.

key_facts.claim: The 15篇 recur heavily in 115 國綜. Q4 reads 〈鴻門宴〉〈燭之武退秦師〉〈諫逐客書〉 against 《韓非子》. Q25 compares 字義 across 〈大同與小康〉〈晚遊六橋待月記〉〈鴻門宴〉〈燭之武退秦師〉〈赤壁賦〉〈桃花源記〉〈虯髯客傳〉〈諫逐客書〉〈畫菊自序〉. Q30–31 use 〈出師表〉 on 「表」 as a genre. Q32–36 use 〈項脊軒志〉. Q1–2 and Q14–15 draw on 〈虯髯客傳〉〈項脊軒志〉〈勸和論〉.
key_facts.source_name: 115國綜試題分析報告 (臺北市教師群) 玖、各題測驗內容及出處

key_facts.claim: 114 國綜 drew more directly on textbook selections than any of the previous four years, about 30 points. Q15–19 linked 田曉菲《赤壁之戟》 with 杜牧〈赤壁〉, 曹操〈短歌行〉, and 蘇軾〈赤壁賦〉. Most items targeted 統整與解釋 or 反思與評價; few were pure 擷取與檢索.
key_facts.source_name: 1111產經新聞 2025-01-19 (quoting 臺北市高中國文科教師)

key_facts.claim: 113 國綜: a cram-school teacher put the 文白 ratio at 1:1 and reading at about 80%, with no 國學常識 or 應用文 items that year. The paper ran about 10,000+ characters.

112 國綜: material was cross-disciplinary (national defense, astronomy, medicine) and included 洪繻〈籌海議〉, a different work by the author of the 15篇 selection 〈鹿港乘桴記〉. Teachers said direct textbook content fell and extended reading on textbook authors rose.
大考中心 published 12 國寫 佳作 from 115 (6 per 大題), with short evaluative comments.
key_facts.evidence: Secondary report. The original CEEC page and PDFs were not opened.

key_facts.claim: 著作權法 第9條第1項: 依法令舉行之各類考試試題及其備用試題 are not copyrightable. 第30條: the term is the author's life plus 50 years. 第52條: published works may be quoted within a reasonable scope for reporting, commentary, teaching, or research. 第64條: such uses must cite the source. 第65條: the fair-use factors are purpose (incl. nonprofit education), nature of the work, amount used, and market effect. The law was last amended 111年6月15日.
key_facts.source_name: 全國法規資料庫 著作權法

key_facts.claim: TIPO e-mail ruling 1111221 says 學測/指考 mock-exam questions given under law are not copyrightable and may be used to build course materials. The exclusion covers the questions only, not answers; original answers remain protected.
key_facts.source_name: 經濟部智慧財產局 解釋資料 電子郵件1111221

key_facts.claim: TIPO's 著作權審議及調解委員會 (93年第1次會議) adopted the 折衷說: a work that becomes part of a statutory exam question stays protected on its own. Only the question presented as a whole is unprotected.
key_facts.source_name: 智慧財產局 著作權審議及調解委員會 93年第1次會議紀錄 案由一 決議

key_facts.claim: CEEC asserts copyright over its own documents. The 考試說明 says copyright belongs to the CEEC foundation, use is limited to non-profit purposes with attribution, and for-profit use needs prior written consent. The 111 briefing slides welcome citation with attribution but require written consent for large-scale copying and exclude commercial use.
key_facts.source_name: 大考中心 111學測簡介─國文考科 (and 考試說明 cover page)

key_facts.claim: MOE's 《重編國語辭典修訂本》 is released under CC BY-ND 3.0 TW (創用CC 姓名標示-禁止改作 3.0 臺灣), commercial use included. Users may not modify entry content (詞目, 部首, 筆畫, 字形, 音讀, 釋義) or convert it to 簡化字. Required attribution: 中華民國教育部 (Ministry of Education, R.O.C.), 《重編國語辭典修訂本》, version number, and URL. Redistributors must keep the 使用說明. The same license covers 《國語辭典簡編本》, 《國語小字典》, and 《成語典》.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 注音符號與聲調
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Zhuyin (Bopomofo) phonetic symbols and tones
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: 字音題 (A1) and dictionary look-ups rely on 注音. English-speaking or zero-background learners need it first.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 部首、部件的表音表義功能；多音字與多義字
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Radicals and components as sound/meaning cues; polyphonic and polysemous characters
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Grounds 字形 and 字音 discrimination (same-component reading traps) and later 六書.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 常用字詞量與字辭典運用
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Core character and word vocabulary; using print and digital dictionaries
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: The 課綱 target for 國中 is recognizing 4,000 common characters and 6,500 common words. Dictionary skills support self-study with the MOE dictionaries.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 基本造字原則：象形、指事、會意、形聲
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Basic character-formation principles: pictograph, indicative, compound-ideograph, phono-semantic
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Direct prerequisite for Ab-Ⅴ-1 六書的基本原則.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 詞類、構詞規則與量詞
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Parts of speech, word-formation rules and measure words
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: 語法題 (A3) uses parts of speech. 115 Q14–15 tested 量詞 usage in textbook classical texts.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 標點符號的用法與效果
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Punctuation: usage and expressive effect
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Poor punctuation is deducted in 國寫, and punctuation affects how 文言 sentences are parsed.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 基本句型與複句；文句的邏輯
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Basic sentence patterns, complex sentences, sentence logic
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Needed for 語意邏輯關係 items (e.g., 「縱使……卻依然……」 in 考試說明 例題5) and for Ac-Ⅴ-1.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 常用文言文的詞義、語詞結構、虛字、古今義變
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Common Classical Chinese word meanings, structures, function words and semantic change
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Direct prerequisite for Ab-Ⅴ-2 and Ab-Ⅴ-3. 國中 文言 share rises from 10–20% (grade 7) to 25–35% (grade 9), so beginners should follow a similar ramp. The 課綱 does not publish a fixed list of 虛字.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 意義段、篇章結構、主旨與寓意
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Meaning-based paragraphs, text structure, main idea, implied message
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Foundation for Ad-Ⅴ-1 and for the roughly 80% of 國綜 that is passage reading.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 古典詩文、韻文與非韻文入門
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Intro to classical poetry and prose; verse vs non-verse genres
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Ad-Ⅴ-3 and Ad-Ⅴ-4 add 辭賦, 散曲, 戲曲 and assume the 國中 genre map is already known.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 記敘、抒情、說明、議論、應用文本的國中基礎
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: 國中 foundations of the five text types
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: Stage Ⅴ items build on these, e.g., Bd-Ⅴ-2 歸納/演繹 after Bd-Ⅳ-2 比較/比喻.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 閱讀策略：摘要、推論、自我提問
bridging_prereqs.topic_en: Reading strategies: summarizing, inferencing, self-questioning
bridging_prereqs.why_needed: 混合題 and 國寫 Q1(一) reward precise summary and inference in one's own words.

bridging_prereqs.topic_zh: 寫作歷程：審題、立意、取材、組織、修改
